The ablations are most informative around three points: structured visual abstractions outperform text-only memory; separating retrieval from execution is useful; optimizing the abstraction module for retrieval success is better aligned with long-horizon interaction than optimizing it only for caption quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough. Read the motivation around visual-token growth and cross-turn reference failures, then inspect the architecture diagram and the interfaces among PAE, EVM, CoRE, and MEC. The benchmark construction is worth more attention than the headline score: difficulty stratification and hard-negative design are directly reusable. For multimodal pretraining work, the useful question is whether the perceptual abstraction should be learned during native pretraining instead of being added as an agent-side memory layer.

recommendation.zh: 多模态Agent的分层视觉记忆架构有参考价值，感知抽象+选择性检索的思路可迁移到多模态长上下文建模，重点看§3的记忆机制设计
recommendation.en: The hierarchical visual memory architecture for multimodal agents offers reference value; the perception-abstraction plus selective retrieval approach can be transferred to multimodal long-context modeling. Focus on §3 memory design.

paper.title: Formal Disco: Scalable Open-Ended Generation of Formally Verified Programs
paper.abstract: The cost of producing code is rapidly diminishing with increasingly capable AI agents, while quality assurance of generated programs has not kept pace. Formal verification provides the strongest possible guarantees, but the ability of AI models to work with verification-aware languages is hindered by the scarcity of human-written examples of programs in those languages. To tackle this prevalent data scarcity issue, we propose Formal Disco: a distributed system for coordination of LLM-based worke

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是“形式化验证代码数据极度稀缺，导致开源模型很难学会 verification-aware 编程”这个瓶颈。问题不只是样本少，而是少在三个层面：一是语言本身稀有，像 Dafny、Verus、Frama-C 这类语言公开仓库很少；二是高质量样本必须同时包含规格、实现和证明，生成难度远高于普通代码；三是如果只靠单轮 LLM 直接生成，往往会陷入主题坍缩、程序过短、验证不过、分布单一。作者要解决的不是单个 verified program 的生成，而是如何构造一个可扩展的、持续产出多样化 verified programs 的合成数据系统，并把这些数据真正转化为开源模型在验证相关任务上的能力提升。
summary.importance: 对预训练和数据研究的意义主要有两层。第一层是方法论：它把“合成数据生成”从一次性离线采样，推进到带任务分工、共享状态、可记录轨迹、可自改进的多 agent 数据工厂。这对稀缺语种、稀缺模态、稀缺格式的预训练数据构造都有参考价值。第二层是数据观：作者明确指出，数据规模本身不是好数据的充分指标，因此引入 feature entropy 去衡量规格、注释、循环结构、lemma proof 等结构性特征的多样性。这一点对 today 的 pretraining data mixture 很有启发，因为很多合成数据工作只优化通过率，不优化分布覆盖，最后容易把模型推向窄分布。量级上，这篇工作把公开 verified program 数据从几百文件扩到 10 万级完整程序，且下游训练能把 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 在若干验证任务上推到接近 Claude 4.5 Opus 的水平，说明这不是只停留在数据集发布，而是形成了可验证的能力迁移。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案的核心是 Formal Disco 这个分布式 agenda 系统。它不是简单地并行调用多个 LLM，而是把数据生成拆成对象数据库和任务队列两层：系统维护程序对象、任务状态、agent 轨迹，不同类型的 worker 围绕共享 agenda 协作。具体有三类 agent。Initiator 负责从随机 GitHub README 和语言文档片段中抽取主题，先生成一个与主题相关的 verified program 草稿。这里用 README 作为外部熵源，是为了避免模型自举时反复回到少数熟悉题材。Fixer 负责处理编译失败或验证失败的程序，根据 verifier 返回的错误信号迭代修补。Extender 则在已有可工作的程序上继续打补丁，增加函数、规格、循环、lemma、proof 结构，让程序复杂度逐步增长。这个设计背后的取舍很清楚：如果一开始就要求 initiator 直接写复杂程序，成功率会很低；先写小而可修的程序，再通过 fixer 和 extender 逐步爬升，能兼顾通过率和复杂度。

另一个关键点是把 verifier 当成外部可执行判别器。系统不依赖人工逐条审核，而是用编译/验证结果作为强约束信号，既用于筛选样本，也用于后续 agent 自改进和蒸馏。作者还强调轨迹记录：agenda 中保留了从草稿到修复再到扩展的过程，这些 trace 可用于 distillation，让较强闭源模型的生成过程迁移到开源模型上，也可用于训练专门的 initiator/fixer/extender。相比只保留最终成功样本，轨迹数据更适合学会“如何修”和“如何扩”。

论文里另一个有意思的技术贡献是 entropy maximization 框架。作者不是只统计 token-level 多样性，而是定义程序层面的 feature entropy，例如规格形式、注释模式、循环结构、proof/lemma 形态等，用这些结构特征来比较不同数据集，并在生成时把“成功率”和“多样性”一起作为优化目标。这样做的原因是 verified code 的价值不在表面语法，而在逻辑结构；如果只看 token entropy，很容易被变量名和表面改写误导。这个思路和一般代码预训练里的去重、cluster balancing、mixture reweighting 是同一类问题，只是这里把质量信号换成了 verification-specific structure。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最重要的结果有三类。第一类是数据规模与数据集构建结果。作者发布了三个语言的数据集：dafny-disco、framac-disco、verus-disco，总量超过 100k 个完整 verified programs。对 Dafny 和 Frama-C 来说，公开数据规模相对已有资源是数量级提升；文中举的对照是 DafnyBench 只有不到 800 个去重后的 Dafny 文件。第二类是数据质量分析。作者没有停在“生成了很多程序”，而是用 feature entropy 去比较 Formal Disco 数据与现有人类数据集、不同生成策略之间的差异，说明随机 README 作为主题源、fixer/extender 的多阶段生成，以及显式多样性优化，都会提高结构覆盖，而不是只增加近重复样本。第三类是模型训练结果。作者用这些合成数据训练开源模型，重点提到 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 在多种 verification-relevant 任务上有明显提升，包括为方法补 assertion / invariant、证明 lemma 等；在部分设置下，训练后的开源模型已经能接近 Claude 4.5 Opus。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但从全文叙述看，提升不是局部小涨，而是跨语言、跨任务都成立。

更值得看的是消融逻辑。论文强调三点：一，若没有外部主题熵源，生成主题会塌缩到模型熟悉的少数模式；二，fixer 和 extender 让系统能从“容易成功的小程序”逐步长成“更复杂的大程序”，这是成功率和复杂度之间的关键桥梁；三，只追求 verifier pass rate 会得到保守、单一的数据，加入 feature entropy 约束后，数据更适合训练泛化能力。对做合成预训练数据的人来说，这三点比单个 benchmark 分数更重要。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓系统设计，再看数据质量度量，最后看训练收益。优先看 Introduction 里对数据稀缺问题的界定，以及 Formal Disco 三类 agent 的分工，这部分决定了整篇工作的价值边界。然后重点看介绍 agenda、对象数据库、trace 记录和 verifier feedback 的章节，理解它为什么不是普通的 self-play 或 rejection sampling。接着看 feature entropy 的定义和数据集比较图表，这是论文里最有方法味道的部分，也是最容易迁移到别的预训练数据场景的部分。最后看训练实验，重点关注：训练任务具体是什么、合成数据如何混入、不同语言上收益是否一致、与闭源模型的差距缩小了多少。预计 35 到 50 分钟可以完成一轮有效泛读；如果你做合成数据或稀缺格式预训练，值得再回头细看 entropy 指标和 agent trace 的使用方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck: open models are weak at verification-aware programming because the training data for formal languages is extremely scarce. The scarcity is not just about file count. These languages are rare in public repositories, high-quality examples must jointly contain specifications, implementations, and proofs, and one-shot LLM generation tends to collapse into short, repetitive, or unverifiable programs. The real problem is therefore not “generate a verified program once,” but “build a scalable system that can continuously produce diverse, verifier-checked programs and turn them into measurable gains on verification tasks.”
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly in data methodology. First, it reframes synthetic data generation as a persistent multi-agent production system with shared state, task decomposition, trace logging, and self-improvement, rather than a one-off sampling pipeline. That is relevant well beyond formal methods, especially for scarce languages, scarce modalities, and structured targets. Second, it argues that dataset size alone is a poor proxy for usefulness and introduces feature entropy over program structures such as specifications, annotations, loops, and lemma proofs. That is a useful correction for synthetic pretraining work, where optimizing only pass rate often leads to narrow distributions. In scale terms, the work expands public verified-program data from hundreds of files to more than 100k complete programs, and the resulting training materially improves Qwen2.5-Coder-32B on verification-related tasks, in some settings making it competitive with Claude 4.5 Opus.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core system is Formal Disco, a distributed agenda-based framework. It is not merely parallel prompting. The system maintains an object database and a shared task agenda, and different worker types operate over that shared state while all traces are recorded. There are three main agent roles. Initiators read random GitHub READMEs and language documentation snippets, then draft an initial verified program aligned with that theme. The README sampling acts as an external entropy source, preventing the model from repeatedly falling back to a small set of familiar topics. Fixers take programs that fail compilation or verification and patch them using verifier feedback. Extenders operate on already working programs and grow them by adding functions, specifications, loops, lemmas, and proof structure.

This decomposition is a practical design choice. Asking a single model to directly produce large, complex, fully verified programs has low success rate. Starting from smaller drafts and then iteratively repairing and extending them gives a better trade-off between validity and complexity growth. Another important component is the verifier itself, which serves as an executable discriminator. Instead of relying on expensive human review, the system uses compile/verify outcomes as hard signals for filtering, improvement, and training. The recorded traces are also central: they preserve not just successful end states but the trajectory from draft to repair to extension, which is useful for distillation from stronger proprietary models and for training specialized open models to imitate the generation process.

A second technical contribution is the entropy-maximization framework. Rather than measuring diversity only at the token level, the paper defines feature entropy over program-level structures, including specification forms, annotation patterns, loop structures, and proof-related constructs. This is the right level of abstraction for verified code, where logical structure matters more than superficial lexical variation. The generation process is then pushed to optimize both success and structural diversity. That makes the dataset less prone to near-duplicate, conservative samples that merely satisfy the verifier.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story has three main parts. First is dataset construction. The authors release three synthetic datasets—dafny-disco, framac-disco, and verus-disco—with more than 100k complete verified programs in total. For Dafny and Frama-C, this is orders of magnitude larger than prior public resources; the paper explicitly contrasts with DafnyBench, which has fewer than 800 deduplicated Dafny files. Second is dataset quality analysis. The paper does not stop at volume claims. It compares Formal Disco data against existing human-written datasets and against alternative generation strategies using feature entropy, showing that external theme sources plus the fixer/extender pipeline improve structural coverage rather than just sample count. Third is downstream training. The synthetic data is used to train open models on verification-relevant tasks such as adding assertions and loop invariants and proving lemmas. The headline result is that Qwen2.5-Coder-32B improves substantially, and in some settings becomes competitive with Claude 4.5 Opus.

The ablation logic is especially useful. Without external entropy from READMEs, topic diversity collapses. Without fixer/extender stages, the system struggles to move from easy drafts to more complex verified programs. And if optimization focuses only on verifier pass rate, the resulting dataset becomes too conservative and narrow. Adding feature-entropy pressure produces data that is better suited for generalization.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the problem framing in the introduction and the description of the three worker roles. That gives the main idea quickly. Then read the sections on the agenda/object database, trace collection, and verifier feedback to understand why this is more than rejection sampling or simple self-play. After that, spend time on the feature-entropy definition and the dataset comparison figures; that is the part most likely to transfer to other synthetic pretraining settings. Finally, inspect the training experiments with attention to what tasks are used, how the synthetic data is mixed into training, and how much of the gap to strong proprietary models is closed. A useful first pass should take around 35–50 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多Agent迭代+形式验证自动校验的代码数据合成方案，做预训练代码数据合成/清洗的研究员值得看系统设计部分。
recommendation.en: A code data synthesis scheme combining multi-agent iteration and formal verification; researchers working on pretraining code data synthesis should check the system design section.

paper.title: When Does Generating More Help? Disentangling Fixed-Source Synthesis from Source Expansion in Synthetic Data Scaling
paper.abstract: Synthetic data can be scaled along two routes: Source Expansion (SE), which enlarges the source by adding seed materials or generators, and Fixed-Source Synthesis (FSS), which holds the source fixed and scales the generation budget. Existing scaling studies typically expand the source as the data grows, conflating SE with FSS and leaving FSS underexplored. We isolate FSS by holding the seed-question pool and teacher model fixed, varying only the per-question response budget under Rejection Sampl

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是合成数据 scaling 研究中的一个混淆：数据变多到底是因为 source expansion，还是 fixed-source synthesis。前者扩大信息源，例如增加真实 seed question、增加源文档、换更强 teacher；后者固定 seed pool Q 和 teacher T，只对同一批 seed 反复生成更多 response。已有工作通常同时扩大源和生成量，因此无法判断“对同一批题多采样几次”究竟有多少收益。
summary.importance: 这篇值得精读，因为它把合成数据扩展拆成了两个可控变量，并给出一个清楚的实验结论：固定源反复采样有收益，但收益递减，而且受源覆盖上限约束；预算变大后，扩大真实 seed set 比对固定 seed 做更多 rejection sampling 更可靠。这个结论对 SFT 数据构建、蒸馏、推理数据生成都有直接影响。很多训练 pipeline 会把 teacher inference budget 继续砸到同一批题上，希望通过多样采样、筛选、改写得到更多有效样本。这篇论文的结果说明，当 Q 和 T 不变时，protocol p 的空间没有想象中大，真正扩展信息源往往更重要。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把合成数据 pipeline 表示为三元组 (Q, T, p)：Q 是 seed-question set，T 是 teacher，p 是合成协议，包括 prompt 模板、解码参数、过滤、选择、改写等。Source Expansion 改变 Q 或 T；Fixed-Source Synthesis 固定 (Q, T)，只改变每题生成预算 r 或协议 p。核心实验使用 rejection sampling：对每个 seed question 生成多个候选 response，经过过滤后形成 SFT 数据。论文把 rectified scaling law 改写到 FSS 场景，出发点是固定源上的重复采样会逐渐覆盖可获得的有效样本空间，因此曲线应当有上限，边际收益随 r 增大而下降。这个建模和普通“数据量越大越好”的幂律不同，因为 FSS 的有效新信息不是线性增长，而是受固定 Q 和固定 T 的支持集限制。论文还控制总样本预算比较 SE 与 FSS，并在固定 (Q, T) 下评估多种常见协议：不同采样温度、embedding-based selection、persona prompting、不做过滤、trace-level repair，以及从已有 seed 合成新问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Mathematics 和 Physics 两个领域。合成数据构建消耗约 2B teacher-inference tokens，其中 1.6B 来自 DeepSeek-V3.1 rollouts；随后进行了 500 多次 student SFT，总计超过 2,000 GPU-hours。关键结果有三点。第一，固定 (Q, T) 下增加每题 response budget r 可以提升 student accuracy，但提升随 r 明显递减，并且在最大预算下仍保留清楚的 teacher-student gap。作者提出的 FSS scaling 形式只用低预算点拟合，就能预测每个 teacher-student pair 在 held-out 最高预算下的表现。第二，在相同 total-sample budget 下，小预算时 SE 和 FSS 的收益接近；预算变大后，扩大真实 seed-question set 更稳定。第三，从已有 seed 合成额外问题没有超过 plain rejection sampling；多样化、选择、persona、不筛选、trace 修复等协议在固定源控制下也没有稳定优于 plain RS。这个结果把很多看似有效的合成技巧重新归因：它们在非控制设置下的收益，可能来自更大的源或更强 teacher，而不是协议本身。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Section 3、Section 5–7。Introduction 给出 SE/FSS 的变量拆分和三组研究问题，是理解贡献的关键。Section 3 的 (Q, T, p) 形式化定义很重要，它决定了后面实验的可解释性。Section 5 重点看 FSS scaling law 的推导、低预算拟合到高预算预测的图表，以及不同 teacher-student pair 的一致性。Section 6 重点看 matched total-sample budget 下 SE vs FSS 的比较，尤其是预算从小到大时哪条轴更可靠。Section 7 建议看 protocol ablation，因为它直接回答很多合成数据工程中的常见选择：温度、多样性选择、persona、repair 是否真的增加有效信息。值得深挖的点是 FSS 曲线的上限如何随 teacher 强度、seed 难度分布、过滤器质量变化；这会影响实际训练中 teacher inference budget 应分配给“多采样”还是“找新源”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a confound in synthetic-data scaling: larger synthetic datasets may come from two different routes. Source Expansion changes the information source by adding real seed questions, adding documents, or using a stronger or additional teacher. Fixed-Source Synthesis keeps the seed pool Q and teacher T fixed, and only increases the number of generated responses per seed. Prior scaling studies usually expand the source while also increasing data size, so they do not isolate the return from repeatedly sampling a fixed source.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful paper for anyone building SFT or distillation datasets. Its main contribution is the clean separation between source expansion and repeated synthesis from a fixed source. The empirical message is direct: fixed-source sampling helps, but the return decays and remains bounded by the fixed source; as the budget grows, expanding the real seed-question pool becomes the more reliable axis. This matters for allocating teacher-inference budget. Many pipelines spend more generations on the same prompts and then rely on filtering, diversity selection, or rewriting. The results suggest that once Q and T are fixed, protocol-level changes add limited information compared with expanding the source.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes a synthetic-data pipeline as (Q, T, p), where Q is the seed-question set, T is the teacher model, and p is the synthesis protocol, including prompt templates, decoding settings, filtering, selection, or rewriting. Source Expansion modifies Q or T. Fixed-Source Synthesis fixes (Q, T) and changes only the per-question budget r or the protocol p. The main FSS experiment uses rejection sampling: for each seed question, the teacher generates multiple candidate responses, and filtered responses become SFT examples. The authors adapt the rectified scaling law to the FSS setting. The key modeling assumption is coverage: repeated sampling from a fixed source gradually covers the available useful samples, so the performance curve should saturate and marginal gains should decline with r. This differs from ordinary data-scaling intuition because effective new information does not grow linearly under a fixed Q and fixed T. The paper then compares SE and FSS at matched total-sample budgets, and evaluates common fixed-source protocols such as alternative sampling temperatures, embedding-based selection, persona prompting, unfiltered sampling, trace-level repair, and generating additional questions from existing seeds.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover Mathematics and Physics. Synthetic-data construction uses about 2B teacher-inference tokens, including 1.6B tokens from DeepSeek-V3.1 rollouts. The study then runs more than 500 student SFT jobs, totaling over 2,000 GPU-hours. The key findings are consistent. First, increasing the per-question response budget r under fixed (Q, T) improves student accuracy, but the gains diminish and a clear teacher-student gap remains even at the largest budget. The proposed fixed-source scaling form, fitted only on low-budget points, predicts performance at the held-out highest budget for every evaluated teacher-student pair. Second, under matched total-sample budgets, SE and FSS are comparable at small budgets, but expanding the real seed-question set becomes more reliable as the budget increases. Third, generating additional questions from existing seeds does not improve over plain rejection sampling, and common protocol changes such as diversity selection, persona prompting, no filtering, or trace repair do not consistently beat plain RS under the fixed-source control. This reassigns part of the apparent benefit of sophisticated synthesis protocols: in less controlled setups, gains may come from a larger source or stronger teacher rather than from the protocol itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction, Section 3, and Sections 5–7 carefully. The Introduction defines the SE/FSS split and frames the three research questions. Section 3 is important because the (Q, T, p) decomposition makes the later comparisons interpretable. In Section 5, focus on the fixed-source scaling-law derivation, the low-budget fit to high-budget prediction, and whether the pattern holds across teacher-student pairs. In Section 6, inspect the matched-budget comparison between SE and FSS, especially how the preferred scaling axis changes with budget. In Section 7, read the protocol ablations because they map directly to practical dataset-construction choices: temperature, selection, persona conditioning, filtering, and repair. A useful follow-up question is how the FSS saturation point changes with teacher strength, seed difficulty distribution, and filter quality, since that determines whether teacher-inference budget should be spent on more samples per seed or on finding new sources.

recommendation.zh: 把“多采样”与“扩来源”拆干净并能外推到高预算，这比又一篇合成数据经验曲线更有用；优先看law推导与SE>FSS分界实验。
recommendation.en: Cleanly disentangles “more samples” vs “more sources” and shows extrapolatable scaling—more actionable than yet another synthetic-data curve; focus on the law derivation and the SE>FSS regime split.

paper.title: Decomposer: Learning to Decompile Symbolic Music to Programs
paper.abstract: Musical performance involves executing a set of high-level musical instructions, yet recovering those instructions from the performance is a challenging inverse problem. We present Decomposer, a post-training framework for symbolic music decompilation: the task of recovering executable, editable music programs from symbolic music. We instantiate the task as MIDI-to-Strudel decompilation, where the model takes symbolic MIDI as input and produces a program in Strudel, a music programming language,

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是低资源程序语言下的“符号音乐反编译”：给定 MIDI，生成可执行、可编辑的 Strudel 程序，并且执行后能尽量还原原始音乐。难点不只是匹配音符，而是在 faithful reconstruction 和 readable program abstraction 之间取平衡；简单逐音符转写很准，但代码不可读、不可编辑。
summary.importance: 这不是通用 LLM 预训练论文，但对 post-training 有清楚启发：当目标可以通过执行器验证时，SFT 可以提供语法和结构 warm start，RL 可以用无标注执行反馈继续提升 grounding。它展示了一个低资源代码/DSL 场景中的训练闭环：先用合成 paired data 学会输出合法程序，再用 execution-based reward 适配真实输入分布。对代码模型、工具调用、程序合成类 RL 数据构造有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: DECOMPOSER 将 MIDI-to-Strudel 建成两阶段后训练框架。第一阶段用合成的 MIDI–Strudel paired data 做 SFT，让模型先学会 Strudel 语法、常见音乐结构和可执行输出格式。第二阶段做 execution-based RL：模型生成 Strudel 程序，执行渲染回 MIDI，再用渲染结果和输入 MIDI 的匹配程度给 faithfulness reward；同时加入 readability reward，避免模型退化为逐音符列表。奖励中显式处理两个目标：一边用 onset/frame/instrument 等指标约束音乐还原，一边用可读性 rubric 鼓励抽象结构。与直接让 frontier LLM zero-shot/ few-shot 生成代码不同，它把“执行后是否还原”变成训练信号；与 heuristic converter 不同，它不追求机械转写，而是用可读性奖励限制不可编辑输出。
summary.experiments: 主实验比较了 heuristic converter、Claude-Opus-4.6、Gemini-3.5-Flash、GPT-5.5、Qwen3-4B/8B base、SFT、SFT+RL。Qwen3 base 几乎不能直接完成任务。SFT 显著提升可执行和可读性，但真实 MIDI 上迁移弱。SFT+RL 后，Qwen3-8B 在 STRUDEL-SYNTH 上达到 Comp 0.99、Onset F1 0.73、Frame F1 0.69、Inst F1 0.72、Rubric 0.74；在 LMD 上达到 Comp 0.99、Onset F1 0.60、Frame F1 0.53、Inst F1 0.58、Rubric 0.61。相对 frontier LLM，LMD 上 Onset F1 提升明显，文中报告 8B 模型相对最佳 frontier LLM 提升 +0.32。相对 heuristic converter，faithfulness 接近，但 rubric 从 0.05/0.09 提升到 0.61–0.74 区间。消融显示 readability 权重 w2 越大，可读性越好但还原度下降，主实验取 w2=0.5；没有 SFT 初始化时，RL 很早停在低奖励退化解，说明 execution RL 需要先把策略放到能编译、能表达结构的区域。泛化实验覆盖 longer LMD、GigaMIDI、NES-MDB、Nottingham；已给出的 Best@5 结果中，STR-SYNTH 上 GPT-5.5 Onset/Rubric 为 0.70/0.37，DECOMPOSER 为 0.86/0.69；LMD <30s 上 GPT-5.5 为 0.44/0.29，DECOMPOSER 为 0.70/0.56。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看方法中的数据构造、execution reward、readability reward 定义，再看 Table 2、Figure 4、Figure 5。Table 2 说明 RL 相对 SFT 的主要收益来自真实分布 grounding；Figure 4 是 reward tradeoff 的关键；Figure 5 说明为什么不能直接从 base model 做 RL。若关注代码模型 RL 或工具执行反馈，值得细看 reward 如何避免“高还原、低抽象”的退化路径。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies symbolic music decompilation: given a MIDI performance, generate an executable and editable Strudel program whose rendering reconstructs the input. The central difficulty is the tradeoff between musical fidelity and program readability. A note-by-note converter can be accurate, but it does not produce useful code.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training methodology. It gives a concrete example of using execution feedback when paired supervision is scarce: SFT teaches syntax and structure, while RL uses label-free execution signals to improve grounding on real inputs. The pattern is applicable to code generation, DSL synthesis, and tool-based RL settings where outputs can be run and evaluated.
summary_en.technical_approach: DECOMPOSER uses a two-stage post-training pipeline for MIDI-to-Strudel. First, the model is supervised on synthetic MIDI–Strudel pairs, which gives it a workable prior over Strudel syntax and musical abstractions. Then it is optimized with execution-based RL. Generated Strudel programs are rendered back to MIDI, and the render is compared with the input using faithfulness metrics such as onset, frame, and instrument matching. A separate readability reward discourages literal note-list transcriptions and pushes the model toward more abstract, editable programs. This differs from frontier LLM prompting, which lacks task-specific grounding, and from heuristic conversion, which is faithful but tends to produce unreadable transliterations.
summary_en.experiments: The main comparison includes a heuristic converter, Claude-Opus-4.6, Gemini-3.5-Flash, GPT-5.5, and Qwen3-4B/8B with no tuning, SFT, and SFT+RL. Untuned Qwen models perform poorly. SFT improves executability and readability, but transfers weakly to real MIDI. With SFT+RL, Qwen3-8B reaches Comp 0.99, Onset F1 0.73, Frame F1 0.69, Inst F1 0.72, and Rubric 0.74 on STRUDEL-SYNTH; on LMD it reaches Comp 0.99, Onset F1 0.60, Frame F1 0.53, Inst F1 0.58, and Rubric 0.61. The paper reports a +0.32 Onset F1 gain over the best frontier LLM on LMD. Compared with the heuristic converter, DECOMPOSER keeps high reconstruction quality while moving rubric scores from 0.05/0.09 to the 0.61–0.74 range. Ablations show a clear readability–faithfulness tradeoff as the readability weight increases, with w2=0.5 used in the main setting. RL without SFT initialization plateaus at a degenerate low-reward solution, showing that execution feedback needs a syntactic and structural warm start. Generalization experiments cover longer LMD, GigaMIDI, NES-MDB, and Nottingham; reported Best@5 results include STR-SYNTH Onset/Rubric of 0.86/0.69 for DECOMPOSER versus 0.70/0.37 for GPT-5.5, and LMD <30s scores of 0.70/0.56 versus 0.44/0.29.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most LLM researchers. Focus on the synthetic-pair construction, the execution reward, the readability reward, Table 2, Figure 4, and Figure 5. Table 2 shows where RL helps beyond SFT. Figure 4 is the main evidence for the reward tradeoff. Figure 5 is useful for understanding why direct RL from a base model fails in low-resource executable-generation tasks.

recommendation.zh: 低资源结构化输出任务的后训练参考，合成数据+RL的组合思路可借鉴，无需深读正文
recommendation.en: Post-training reference for low-resource structured output tasks; synthetic data + RL combo is worth noting, no deep read required

paper.title: Search-based Testing of Vision Language Models for In-Car Scene Understanding
paper.abstract: In the automotive domain, in-car scene understanding (ISU) enables the detection of safety-critical events, such as driver distraction, and supports drivers or passengers by analyzing the in-car scene and adapting the environment (e.g., ambient lighting). The industry is increasingly exploring vision-language models (VLMs) to interpret camera-recorded in-car scenes and extract information for downstream reasoning tasks. However, VLMs may generate incomplete, erroneous, or misleading scene descri

summary.core_problem: 如何在真实数据昂贵的车内场景下，对 VLM 驱动的车内场景理解系统进行系统化、可扩展的可靠性测试。
summary.importance: 属于面向安全关键场景的 VLM 测试/评测方法；对“VLM 可靠性评估、合成场景生成用于测试”有参考，但偏垂直领域，难直接反馈到通用预训练配方。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ISU-Test：用渲染生成车内场景，并把测试用例生成表述为搜索/优化问题，通过系统性修改场景参数探索失败模式与覆盖更广的 corner cases。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 VLM/ISU 系统、搜索空间规模、发现的失败类型统计或与随机采样的对比增益；主要是方法框架描述。

summary_en.core_problem: How to systematically and scalably test VLM-based in-car scene understanding systems when real in-vehicle data is costly.
summary_en.importance: An evaluation/testing methodology for VLM reliability using synthetic rendering; informative for robustness evaluation, but domain-specific and only weakly connected to general pretraining recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: ISU-Test combines rendering-based scene generation with search-based testing, framing test generation as an optimization problem over scene parameters to explore diverse corner cases and failure modes.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify target VLMs, search budget, failure statistics, or gains over random sampling; mostly a framework description.

recommendation.zh: 把“渲染+搜索”当作 VLM 可靠性评测脚手架的思路可借鉴；只看问题建模与参数化搜索，别深挖车内细节。
recommendation.en: The render+search framing is a reusable VLM reliability testing scaffold; skim the optimization setup and parameterization, ignore in-car specifics.

paper.title: DisciplineGen-1M: A Large-Scale Dataset for Multidisciplinary Visual Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Recent image generation and editing models can produce visually appealing natural images, yet they remain unreliable when the target image is a knowledge-intensive diagram whose correctness depends on disciplinary concepts, symbolic structure, and precise spatial relations. We introduce DisciplineGen-1M, a million-scale multidisciplinary dataset that supports text-to-image generation and image editing. It contains 1.2M samples spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, geography, compute

summary.core_problem: 现有图像生成/编辑模型在知识密集型“学科图表/示意图”上不可靠，缺少大规模、可控、带结构监督的数据来训练与评测。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是百万级合成+过滤的数据集与构建流水线；对多模态生成/编辑的预训练数据配方、可控编辑监督、以及“符号结构+空间关系”建模有参考价值，但仍偏图像生成数据资产。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DisciplineGen-1M：结合矢量图渲染、OCR 驱动编辑、程序化合成、以及大规模 text-to-image 过滤，产出 1.2M 跨学科样本；提供 caption、编辑指令、结构化标注与成对图像（语义差异可控）。并在其上训练“discipline-informed reasoning-generation model”用于 T2I 与编辑（摘要未给出细节）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出训练的生成/编辑模型规模、基线与量化提升；主要信息是数据规模（1.2M）与覆盖学科（数理化生地/CS/经济/历史/音乐/体育）。

summary_en.core_problem: Current image generation/editing models are unreliable on knowledge-intensive diagrams that require disciplinary concepts, symbolic structure, and precise spatial relations; large-scale controllable data is missing.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a million-scale synthetic+filtered dataset and pipeline; useful for multimodal generation/editing pretraining data recipes and controllable edit supervision, but still a data asset for image generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: DisciplineGen-1M is built via vector-graphics rendering, OCR-based editing, curated programmatic synthesis, and large-scale text-to-image filtering, producing captions, edit instructions, structured annotations, and paired images with controlled semantic differences. A discipline-informed reasoning-generation model is trained on top (details not in abstract).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks model sizes, baselines, and quantitative gains; key reported facts are 1.2M samples and broad disciplinary coverage.

recommendation.zh: 把“可验证的图表/符号结构”做成 1M 级生成+编辑数据，这点比模型更值钱；先看数据构建与过滤流程，模型结果当弱信号。
recommendation.en: The 1M-scale diagram/symbolic-structure generation+editing data is the real value; read the pipeline/filtering, treat model claims as weak until numbers are checked.

paper.title: HaloGuard 1.0: An Open Weights Constitutional Classifier for Multilingual AI Safety
paper.abstract: We present HaloGuard 1.0, an open-weights implementation of the constitutional-classifier paradigm for input safety. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on English and multilingual prompt-safety benchmarks at roughly one-tenth the model size of current leading open guard models. The safety constitution is the organising structure of the corpus: a natural-language constitution of 46 policies and 2,940 subcategories drives synthetic data generation, with exhaustive one-to-one paired counterfa

summary.core_problem: 构建一个小参数、开源权重、多语言输入安全分类器，用于判断用户 prompt 是否违反安全政策。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全后训练/guard 模型工程与数据构造。亮点在于用自然语言 constitution 驱动合成数据，并通过成对反事实样本降低边界误判，对安全数据生成有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: HaloGuard 1.0 使用 46 条 policy 和 2,940 个子类组织安全语料；为每个安全边界构造成对 counterfactual，保持主题和词汇相近但翻转意图；同时设计两层 harmless 数据来分别压低边界 false positive 和普通 harmless false positive；覆盖 46 种语言，并把语言当作表层形式而不是攻击信号。
summary.experiments: HaloGuard 1.0-0.8B 在七个 prompt-safety benchmark 上平均 F1 达到 90.9；摘要称其优于若干开源 guard baseline，包括参数量最高到 27B 的模型，且模型尺寸约为当前领先开源 guard 的十分之一。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore。摘要未显示知名基础模型团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a compact open-weight multilingual safety classifier for detecting unsafe user prompts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly post-training safety infrastructure and synthetic safety data design. The interesting part is the constitution-driven corpus with paired counterfactuals, which is relevant to guard-model data quality rather than base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: HaloGuard uses a natural-language constitution with 46 policies and 2,940 subcategories. It generates one-to-one counterfactual pairs that keep topic and vocabulary fixed while flipping intent, adds two harmless tiers to reduce boundary and baseline false positives, and materializes the data across 46 languages.
summary_en.experiments: HaloGuard 1.0-0.8B reports an average F1 of 90.9 across seven prompt-safety benchmarks and is claimed to outperform open guard baselines up to 27B parameters, at roughly one-tenth the size of leading open guard models.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore. No major foundation-model lab affiliation is indicated in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造部分；0.8B 打过 27B 的结论要核 benchmark 泄漏和标签定义。
recommendation.en: Read the data-construction recipe only; the 0.8B-beats-27B claim needs leakage and label-boundary checks.

institutions: Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore

paper.title: MultiSynt/MT: Trillion-Token Multi-Parallel Pre-Training Data Translated Across 36 Languages
paper.abstract: Open web-scale pre-training corpora remain concentrated in English, limiting multilingual LLM development. We introduce MultiSynt/MT, an open synthetic parallel corpus with approximately 4.8 trillion target-language tokens across 36 European languages, produced by translating 100 billion high-quality Nemotron-CC tokens with Tower+ and OPUS-MT/HPLT-MT systems. For many medium- and lower-resource European languages, this is the largest openly available pre-training resource. On a broad multilingua

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是开放多语预训练里一个很现实的瓶颈：英语之外，尤其是中低资源欧洲语言，公开可用的高质量预训练语料既不够大，也不够干净，导致多语 LLM 的训练长期受限。作者选择的路径不是继续做原生网页抓取，而是把高质量英语网页语料系统性翻译成 36 种语言，构造一个可公开发布、规模达到 4.8T 目标语言 token 的 synthetic parallel pretraining corpus。论文真正要回答的不是“能不能翻译出很大数据”，而是更难的问题：翻译语料在预训练里到底能替代多少 native data，在哪些能力上有效，在哪些能力上会留下 translationese 和文化锚定的缺口，以及现有 benchmark 是否能看出这些差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要有三层。第一，它把“用机器翻译扩展多语预训练数据”从小规模尝试推进到 trillion-token 级别，并且是开放发布，这对资源稀缺语言的基座训练很实际。第二，它给出了一个比较扎实的数据效率结论：在标准多语 base-model benchmark 上，基于翻译语料训练的参考模型可以用大约少 72% 的预训练 token 追平 native-data baseline，且在同样 100B token 预算下相对提升约 15%。这说明高质量翻译数据不是简单的次优替代品，在很多任务上它反而是更高密度的训练信号。第三，论文没有把 translated data 讲成万能解，而是明确指出评测盲点和能力边界：标准多选 benchmark 对翻译质量差异不敏感，文化知识和习语类任务上 native data 仍然持续占优。这种“哪里能替代，哪里不能”对数据配比、continual pretrain、以及多语 curriculum 设计都很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有几个关键决策。数据源不是任意英文网页，而是 Nemotron-CC 的 actual high-quality split。作者引用已有基线工作说明，这个英语 HQ 子集在开放语料里有较强下游表现，因此先把源语质量抬高，避免把翻译系统的误差和源数据噪声混在一起。具体做法是从中均匀随机抽取约 1.55 亿文档，约 100B 英文 token，不再额外做主题或长度分层；这样每种目标语言都对应同一批源文档，天然形成多路平行语料。翻译系统选择上，作者没有押注单一模型家族，而是按覆盖率、质量和吞吐三者折中：高资源语言用 Tower+ 9B/72B，低资源补足靠 OPUS-MT/HPLT-MT。为了避免“拿能跑的就上”，他们先做了一个小规模人工 fluency ranking，覆盖 7 种语言、6 个候选系统、同源文档盲评，结果 Tower+ 明显最好，通用 instruction LLM 明显落后，因此生产池里去掉了后者。这个选择很重要，因为论文后面一个核心结论就是：翻译系统质量差异会真实传导到预训练效果，但常规 benchmark 未必测得出来。数据组织上，作者保留了 source-document 对齐和部分语言的多系统 row-aligned 版本，这让语料不仅能做单语预训练，也能做受控的 cross-system/cross-language 对比。论文的实验设计也比较干净：用参考 LLM 在 translated corpus 和 native baseline 上做 matched-budget 训练，分别看 token efficiency、MT system choice、benchmark blind spots，以及挪威语上的文化/习语/常识分解。
summary.experiments: 最关键的结果有四组。第一组是规模与覆盖。MultiSynt/MT 覆盖 36 种语言，总计约 4.8T 目标语言 token；对许多低中资源欧洲语言，它比公开 native 资源 HPLT 3.0 大一个数量级以上。第二组是预训练效率。在标准多语 base-model benchmark 上，参考模型用 MultiSynt/MT 训练，只需约少 72% 的 token 就能达到 HPLT 2.0 native baseline 的最终分数；在相同 100B token 预算下，translated-data 模型相对提升约 15%。这说明翻译语料的单位 token 信息密度很高。第三组是评测盲点。作者用 fluency-sensitive 的 LLM-as-judge 评估，能够稳定恢复 MT 系统质量排序；但标准 multiple-choice benchmark 基本分不出这些差异。再配合 embedding-space nearest-neighbor 诊断，发现 benchmark 题目附近往往有更多 MultiSynt/MT 文档而不是 HPLT 文档，说明 benchmark 分布更贴近翻译语料，因而高估了 translated pretraining 的泛化。第四组是能力边界。以挪威语为例，在习语和文化锚定知识任务上，native-data 模型在整个训练过程中都更强；但在 commonsense reasoning 上，translated-data 模型会逐渐追平并反超。这一点很重要，因为它把“translationese 有害”从泛泛而谈变成了可分解的现象：不是所有能力都受损，受损最明显的是文化局部性和本地表达习惯。摘要里还提到 Tower+ 72B 与 9B 在 5 语重叠上的下游差距不大，因此 9B 被作为默认生产系统，这对大规模数据构建的成本收益判断也很关键。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时建议按“数据构建—训练结果—评测反思”三段来读。先看 Section 3，重点不是流水账式的数据制作，而是三个选择：为什么源语料选 Nemotron-CC HQ，为什么翻译系统最终是 Tower+ 与 OPUS/HPLT-MT 的组合，以及如何保留 parallel alignment 以支持后续受控实验。然后看 Section 4，这是预训练研究者最该细看的部分，尤其是 token efficiency 的比较设置：训练预算是否匹配、baseline 是否公平、不同 MT 系统之间的差距有多大。再看 Section 5，这一节决定你如何解读前面的好结果。5.1 的 LLM-as-judge 与标准 benchmark 对照，5.2 的 embedding-space 诊断，5.3 的挪威语文化/习语/常识拆分，都在提醒读者不要把 benchmark 提升直接等同于“翻译语料已经替代 native 语料”。如果时间有限，优先看 Figure 1、Figure 3、Figure 6 以及 Section 4 和 5 的主表。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 translated data 与 native data 的最优 mixture 可能比二选一更重要，论文已经给出边界条件；二是 benchmark contamination 之外，还存在 benchmark distribution alignment 问题，未来多语预训练评测需要更刻意地区分 fluency、文化知识和推理能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in multilingual pretraining: outside English, especially for medium- and lower-resource European languages, openly available native pretraining corpora are often too small or too noisy to support strong LLM training. The authors take a synthetic-data route at unusual scale. They translate 100B high-quality English tokens into 36 languages, producing MultiSynt/MT, an open corpus with about 4.8T target-language tokens. The real question is not merely whether large translated corpora can be built, but how far translated pretraining data can substitute for native corpora, where it helps, where it fails because of translationese and English-centered cultural grounding, and whether current multilingual benchmarks can even detect those differences.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is threefold. First, it turns machine-translated multilingual pretraining from a small-scale idea into a trillion-token open resource. That is immediately useful for languages with weak native data availability. Second, it provides a concrete data-efficiency result: on standard multilingual base-model benchmarks, models trained on MultiSynt/MT can match a native-data baseline with roughly 72% fewer pretraining tokens, and at a matched 100B-token budget they improve by about 15% relative. That suggests high-quality translated text can be a denser training signal than existing open native corpora, not just a weaker fallback. Third, the paper is careful about the limits. It shows that standard benchmarks miss important differences, and that native data remains better for idiomatic and culturally grounded knowledge. That makes the work useful not only as a dataset release but also as guidance for data mixture design, continual pretraining, and multilingual curriculum choices.
summary_en.technical_approach: Several design choices matter. The source data is not arbitrary English web text but the actual high-quality split of Nemotron-CC, chosen because prior baseline work found it to be one of the strongest open English pretraining sources. This is important: by starting from a strong source corpus, the paper avoids conflating source-data noise with translation quality. The authors uniformly sample about 155 million documents, around 100B English tokens, and translate the same source set into each target language, which naturally creates a multi-way parallel corpus. On the translation side, they do not rely on a single model family. Instead they optimize over quality, throughput, and language coverage: Tower+ 9B and 72B for stronger-coverage higher-resource settings, and OPUS-MT/HPLT-MT for broader lower-resource coverage. Before production, they run a small human fluency study over seven languages and six candidate systems using blind ratings on matched source documents. Tower+ ranks highest, while general-purpose instruction LLMs lag clearly behind, so those are removed from the production pool. That decision matters because one of the paper’s later findings is that translation-system quality does affect downstream pretraining, even when standard benchmarks fail to expose it. The corpus preserves source-document alignment and, for some languages, multiple row-aligned translations from different systems. This makes the resource useful not only for per-language pretraining but also for controlled cross-system and cross-language experiments. The training setup is also fairly disciplined: reference LLMs are trained under matched budgets on translated data and native baselines, then compared on token efficiency, MT-system choice, benchmark blind spots, and phenomenon-specific Norwegian evaluations.
summary_en.experiments: Four result groups stand out. First is scale and coverage. MultiSynt/MT spans 36 languages and about 4.8T target-language tokens; for many lower- and medium-resource European languages it exceeds the largest comparable open native resource by more than an order of magnitude. Second is pretraining efficiency. On standard multilingual base-model benchmarks, models trained on MultiSynt/MT reach the final score of the HPLT 2.0 native-data baseline using about 72% fewer training tokens, and at a matched 100B-token budget they outperform it by roughly 15% relative. That is a strong indication that translated data can be highly information-dense. Third is evaluation blindness. A fluency-sensitive LLM-as-judge setup cleanly recovers the ranking of translation systems, while standard multiple-choice benchmarks largely fail to separate them. An embedding-space nearest-neighbor analysis further shows that benchmark items tend to sit closer to MultiSynt/MT documents than to HPLT documents, suggesting that benchmark distribution alignment may inflate the apparent strength of translated-data pretraining. Fourth is capability boundary analysis. On Norwegian tasks involving idioms and culturally grounded knowledge, native-data models remain better throughout training. On Norwegian commonsense reasoning, however, translated-data models close the gap and eventually overtake the native baseline. This is one of the most useful findings in the paper because it decomposes the usual criticism of translationese into something operational: translated data is not uniformly worse, but it is weaker on local cultural grounding and idiomatic expression. The overlap experiment between Tower+ 72B and 9B also matters: the downstream gap is small enough that 9B becomes the default production choice, which is relevant for cost-quality trade-offs in large-scale corpus construction.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good reading order is data construction, then training results, then evaluation critique. Start with Section 3. The important parts are not the mechanics of translation at scale but the choices: why Nemotron-CC HQ was used as the source, why the final production pool combines Tower+ with OPUS/HPLT-MT, and why preserving parallel alignment matters for later controlled analysis. Then read Section 4 carefully, since this is where the pretraining value is established. Pay attention to how token efficiency is measured, whether budgets are matched fairly, and how much downstream difference remains between translation systems. After that, read Section 5 with care, because it changes how the earlier gains should be interpreted. Section 5.1 compares LLM-as-judge with standard benchmarks, Section 5.2 gives the embedding-space diagnostic, and Section 5.3 breaks down Norwegian performance into cultural knowledge, idioms, and commonsense. Together they show that benchmark gains should not be read as proof that translated corpora fully replace native corpora. If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, Figure 3, Figure 6, and the main tables in Sections 4 and 5. Two deeper questions are worth carrying forward: whether the best recipe is a translated-native mixture rather than either source alone, and how multilingual evaluation should separate fluency, cultural grounding, and reasoning instead of collapsing them into a single benchmark score.

recommendation.zh: 应读实验和数据配方；它会改变“翻译语料只能补尾部”的先验，尤其看 100B token matched 对比。
recommendation.en: Read the data recipe and matched-budget results; it weakens the prior that translated corpora are only a tail-language patch.

institutions: Juelich Supercomputing Center (JSC), Research Center Juelich (FZJ)

paper.title: DataEvolver: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Data Construction for Text-Rich Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-rich image generation is one of the most challenging settings in image generation, since models must simultaneously produce visually realistic images and render legible, semantically aligned, and layout-consistent text. Existing data pipelines usually follow a static crawl-filter-freeze paradigm. They collect candidate samples, filter them once, and freeze the accepted data for training. However, rejected samples are usually discarded, although they often contain useful failure signals such

summary.core_problem: 解决文本丰富图像生成中训练数据构建静态、一次性过滤后无法利用失败样本反馈的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献在数据构建流程而非模型本身。虽然任务是 text-rich image generation，离 LLM 预训练有一层距离，但“把 rejected samples 变成下一轮数据策略信号”这个思路，对预训练数据筛选、课程式构建和合成数据闭环有可迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DataEvolver，多智能体自演化数据构建框架。Retriever 收集候选样本，Verifier 给出质量分与拒绝原因，Critic 汇总轮次级失败模式形成语义反馈，Generator/策略模块据此更新后续构建策略。与 crawl-filter-freeze 的静态管线不同，它把数据构建视为带反馈的策略演化过程。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练轮数或数据量，也未说明相对哪些 text-rich image generation baseline 提升多少；从设定看，实验重点应是数据集质量提升以及下游生成模型在文本可读性、语义一致性、布局一致性上的改进。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the static crawl-filter-freeze pipeline for text-rich image generation data, where rejected samples are discarded instead of being used as feedback.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily about data construction rather than model design. The task is image generation, but the idea of turning rejected samples into signals for the next data-construction round is transferable to pretraining data curation and synthetic-data loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: DataEvolver is a self-evolving multi-agent data construction framework: a Retriever gathers candidates, a Verifier scores quality and rejection causes, a Critic summarizes round-level failure patterns into semantic feedback, and the construction policy is updated accordingly. This replaces a static one-shot filtering pipeline with a feedback-driven loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, or exact gains over baselines. The likely evaluation focuses on improved dataset quality and downstream gains in text legibility, semantic alignment, and layout consistency for text-rich image generation.

recommendation.zh: 任务偏图像生成，但“拒绝样本别扔，拿来更新数据策略”这点值得借到 pretrain data pipeline；只看数据闭环设计即可。
recommendation.en: The task is image generation, but the key lesson is reusable: rejected samples should update the data policy rather than be discarded; read it for the data loop only.

paper.title: From Search to Synthesis: Training LLMs as Zero-Shot Workflow Generators
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel across a wide range of tasks, yet their instance-specific solutions often lack the structural consistency needed for reliable deployment. Workflows that encode recurring algorithmic patterns at the task level provide a principled framework, offering robustness across instance variations, interpretable traces for debugging, and reusability across problem instances. However, manually designing such workflows requires significant expertise and effort, limiting the

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在实例级解题上缺乏结构稳定性的问题，尝试让模型直接生成可复用的任务级 workflow，而不是一次性答案。
summary.importance: 这是一个偏后训练/元学习方向的方法工作。价值不在基座预训练本身，而在于把“工作流”作为可学习对象，给 task-level policy synthesis 提供了一个较清晰的训练框架。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 MetaFlow，把 workflow generation 表述为 meta-learning：输入任务描述和算子集合，输出解决该类任务的工作流。训练分两阶段进行：先用合成 workflow 数据做监督微调，再进一步优化泛化到新任务/新配置的能力。核心思想是从 search 转向 synthesis，让模型学习可迁移的策略模板。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、数据规模和关键 baseline 细节。可确认的是，作者将其与只生成实例级解法或受限于训练配置的方法比较，主张在跨实例鲁棒性、可解释性与可复用性上更好，但目前看更像方法论验证而非大规模结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the lack of structural consistency in instance-level LLM solutions by training models to generate reusable task-level workflows instead of one-off answers.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training / meta-learning methods paper. Its value is not in pretraining itself, but in treating workflows as learnable objects and offering a cleaner framework for task-level policy synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose MetaFlow, which formulates workflow generation as a meta-learning problem: given a task and an operator set, the model composes a solution workflow. Training has two stages: supervised fine-tuning on synthetic workflow data, followed by further optimization for generalization to new tasks and configurations. The key shift is from search to synthesis of reusable strategy templates.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or detailed baselines. What is clear is that the method is compared against instance-specific solution generators and methods that do not generalize beyond training configurations, with claimed gains in robustness, interpretability, and reuse. At this stage it reads more like a methodology paper than a scale-backed result.

recommendation.zh: 把 workflow 当可学习对象这个 framing 还行，但更像 SFT on synthetic programs；看任务表示和数据构造即可，别期待它改变 pretrain 方法论。
recommendation.en: The workflow-as-object framing is decent, but this is mostly SFT on synthetic programs; check the task representation and data construction, not for a pretraining prior update.

paper.title: Diff-Based Code Corruption using LLMs for Large-Scale Bugfix Benchmarking
paper.abstract: There are various benchmarks to evaluate bugfixing capabilities of Large Language Models. However, most widespread benchmarks do not fully reflect real-world bugfixing practices. They are small, weakening statistical reliability, and the buggy programs are often similar to one another, potentially distorting evaluation results. The range of bug types can also be narrow, failing to capture a representative range of bugs. To address these issues, we introduce MegaBugFix, a large-scale bugfixing be

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是代码修复评测集规模小、样本相似、bug 类型偏窄的问题，尤其是现有 LLM 合成 bug 容易生成语法错误或过于浅层的扰动，不能稳定衡量模型的真实修复能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接影响有限，更接近代码模型与代码智能体的评测资产。可取之处在于它把“用 LLM 生成坏样本”从直接改写代码改成生成 diff，并用人类提交中的 accepted/wrong-answer 对来训练 bug 注入器。这对构造代码训练数据、代码修复 SFT 数据和 verifier 数据有一定参考价值，但它不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一，从 Project CodeNet 中按同一用户、同一题目配对 accepted 提交和 wrong-answer 提交，并用 rapidfuzz 相似度过滤，只保留相似度至少 70% 的 correct/buggy 程序对，作为微调数据。第二，微调一个开源 LLM，让它从正确代码生成表示 bug 注入的 diff，而不是直接生成完整错误代码。这样做的动机是减少“输出与输入完全相同”的编辑失败，也减少直接改写时常见的语法级错误。第三，把训练好的 corruption model 应用于来自 6 个公开来源的正确 Python 程序，生成大规模 buggy variants，并统一不同来源的测试用例执行接口。
summary.experiments: 产物是 MegaBugFix，包含 12,629 个错误 Python 程序、对应正确版本和统一评测框架。论文指出，DebugBench 与 CodeEditorBench 中相当比例的 Python 样本不可解析，例如 DebugBench 的 832/1414，以及 CodeEditorBench Primary 的 312/716、Plus 的 193/356。MegaBugFix 的设计目标是减少这类语法错误，增加语义型 bug 和多样性。关键实验应主要看生成 bug 的可解析率、测试失败率、bug diff 规模分布，以及不同代码修复模型在该 benchmark 上的 pass@1/pass@k 表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看数据构造流程、CodeNet 配对规则、diff 生成微调设置、过滤与统一测试框架。若关注代码模型 post-training 数据，可以多看 bug diff 的分布和质量控制。若只关注 LLM 预训练，这篇的主要价值是数据合成范式，不需要细读模型评测排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical weakness in bug-fixing evaluation: common benchmarks are small, structurally repetitive, and biased toward narrow or shallow bug types. Existing LLM-based corruption methods often create syntactic failures rather than realistic semantic bugs.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect. The main contribution is an evaluation and data-generation asset for code repair models. The useful idea is to train a corruption model on human accepted/wrong-answer pairs and make it emit diffs instead of full rewritten programs. This can inform synthetic data pipelines for code repair SFT, verifier training, or code-editing evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline starts from Project CodeNet. Accepted and wrong-answer Python submissions are paired by user and task, then filtered with a rapidfuzz similarity threshold of at least 70%. These correct/buggy pairs are used to fine-tune an open-weight LLM for code corruption. Instead of producing an entire buggy program, the model generates a diff. This choice reduces identity edits and makes the corruption operation explicit. The trained model is then applied to correct programs collected from six public sources, and their heterogeneous test suites are wrapped into a unified execution framework.
summary_en.experiments: The resulting benchmark, MegaBugFix, contains 12,629 buggy Python programs with correct counterparts and executable tests. The paper contrasts this with prior synthetic bug datasets where many Python samples are not parseable, such as 832/1414 in DebugBench and 312/716 plus 193/356 in two CodeEditorBench splits. The most informative results are the parseability and validity checks of injected bugs, the distribution of diff sizes and bug types, and pass@1/pass@k repair performance of LLMs under the unified harness.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the dataset construction pipeline, the CodeNet pairing rule, the diff-generation fine-tuning setup, and the filtering/evaluation harness. For code post-training data work, inspect the bug quality analysis. For pretraining research, the benchmark leaderboard is less important than the corruption-data recipe.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫数据构造和模型排名差异；合成 bug 有偏，但能暴露小型修复集对代码模型的乐观估计。
recommendation.en: Skim the data construction and ranking shifts; synthetic bugs are biased, but the benchmark usefully exposes optimism in small bug-fix sets.

paper.title: When AI Reviews Its Own Code: Recursive Self-Training Collapse in Code LLMs
paper.abstract: Recursive self-training can degrade neural generative models when generated data is reused without fresh human data or external quality control. We study this risk in code LLMs, where AI-generated code can enter real repositories, later become training data, and create a repository-scale self-training loop. While software development traditionally interrupts this loop through pull-request review, tests, compilation, and human approval, AI coding tools now produce code faster than humans can revi

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究代码 LLM 的递归自训练风险：当模型生成的代码进入仓库，之后又被收集进训练语料，并且代码 review 也由 AI 完成时，训练分布是否会随模型自身偏差逐轮退化。
summary.importance: 它对预训练数据和合成数据策略有直接提醒。代码语料不同于普通网页文本，AI 生成内容可能通过真实仓库回流到下一代 code model 的 pretrain 或 continual pretrain 数据中。传统软件流程里的编译、测试、静态检查和人工 review 相当于外部质量门，可以阻断一部分错误和低质量模式。若生成器和 reviewer 都来自相近的代码 LLM，过滤器会与生成分布耦合，可能接受更像模型自己风格但功能更差的代码。这个问题和 synthetic data scaling、LLM-as-judge 偏差、reward hacking 都有联系。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较三种递归 fine-tuning 设定。第一种是 no review，模型生成的代码不经过过滤，直接进入下一轮训练。第二种是 Human-gate review，使用模型无关的外部规则，例如编译、静态质量检查等，决定哪些生成代码可以进入训练集。这里的 Human gate 不一定全由人手工完成，重点是验收标准不随生成模型变差而同步漂移。第三种是 AI-self-gate review，由代码 LLM 自己评估自己生成的代码，再把通过的样本用于下一轮训练。核心变量不是有没有过滤，而是过滤信号是否独立于生成器。这个实验设计适合隔离“外部质量控制”和“自我偏好强化”的差异。
summary.experiments: 可核验内容主要给出实验设定，而没有提供完整数值结果。实验关注递归 fine-tuning，而不是单轮 SFT：模型生成代码，经过 no-review、Human-gate 或 AI-self-gate 进入下一轮训练，再评估后续模型的编程能力、质量和分布变化。标题和问题设定指向的主要结论是：没有外部质量锚点时，递归自训练可能导致代码模型性能和多样性退化；Human-gate 通过固定质量标准提供更稳的约束；AI-self-gate 看似过滤，实际可能随生成器一起漂移，难以阻止自我强化的错误和窄化风格。由于缺少具体表格和数字，不应把该工作当作定量结论已充分展开的训练 recipe。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。先看 introduction 中对 repository-scale feedback loop 的定义，这部分说明为什么 AI-generated code 进入 GitHub 后会影响未来 code pretraining 数据。再看实验设定，重点区分 no review、Human-gate 和 AI-self-gate 的验收规则。若有完整正文，优先查找递归轮次曲线、任务性能随轮次变化、代码多样性或风格漂移指标，以及 reviewer 与 generator 是否同源的消融。对预训练研究员来说，最有用的是把它当作数据治理问题，而不是普通代码生成 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies recursive self-training collapse in code LLMs: model-generated code may enter real repositories, later be crawled as training data, and then be reviewed by AI systems that are statistically coupled to the same model family.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to pretraining data pipelines and synthetic-data governance. Code corpora are increasingly exposed to AI-written commits and pull requests. Traditional software workflows provide external quality gates through compilation, tests, static analysis, and human approval. If both the code author and the reviewer are AI systems, the acceptance signal may drift with the generator. This creates a feedback loop where future code models learn not only from generated code, but from generated code filtered by a reviewer that may share the same blind spots. The issue connects directly to synthetic data scaling, LLM-as-judge bias, and reward-signal quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares three recursive fine-tuning regimes. In the no-review setting, all generated code is fed into the next training round. In the Human-gate setting, generated code must pass model-independent checks such as compilation and static quality filters before it is reused. The term Human gate refers to an exogenous acceptance rule, not necessarily a fully manual process. In the AI-self-gate setting, the code LLM evaluates its own outputs and uses accepted samples for subsequent training. The key experimental variable is whether the filter is independent of the generator. This separates ordinary data filtering from self-reinforcing preference drift.
summary_en.experiments: The available content specifies the experimental design but does not provide complete numerical results. The experiments are recursive rather than single-round fine-tuning: a model generates code, samples are accepted under no-review, Human-gate, or AI-self-gate rules, and the resulting data is used to train the next generation. The intended measurements include downstream programming performance, quality, and distributional drift. The framing and title indicate that unanchored recursive training can degrade code LLMs, Human-gate review provides a more stable external constraint, and AI-self-gating may fail because the judge can normalize the generator’s own errors and stylistic narrowing. Without the full result tables, the paper should be read as a warning about training-data feedback loops rather than as a complete quantitative recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is sufficient. Start with the introduction’s definition of the repository-scale feedback loop: AI writes code, the code enters repositories, repositories become future training data, and AI review may decide what is accepted. Then inspect the experimental setup and make sure the distinction between no review, Human-gate, and AI-self-gate is clear. In the full version, prioritize plots over recursive rounds, task-performance degradation, diversity or style-drift metrics, and ablations where the reviewer is separated from or tied to the generator. For pretraining work, the useful lens is data-quality control under feedback, not benchmark performance alone.

recommendation.zh: AI自门控的表面有效性与实际崩溃的对比非常关键，做自训练/合成数据过滤的必须重点看不同门控的多轮性能曲线
recommendation.en: The contrast between the apparent effectiveness of AI self-gating and actual collapse is critical; self-training/synthetic data filtering researchers must focus on the multi-round performance curves of different gating mechanisms

paper.title: Beyond MoCap: Scaling Motion Tokenizers with Synthetic Human Motion for Generative Modeling
paper.abstract: Human motion generation models are fundamentally constrained by the limited diversity of motion capture datasets, which predominantly contain common, repetitive actions and fail to cover the long tail of complex human movements, resulting in a restricted motion vocabulary in learned latent representations and poor generalization to rare, compositional, and highly dynamic motions. In this work, we propose a framework for expanding the motion representation space by leveraging large-scale syntheti

summary.core_problem: 现有人类动作生成模型的离散tokenizer受限于真实动作捕捉（MoCap）数据集的多样性不足，无法覆盖长尾复杂动作，导致表示空间受限、泛化性差。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出合成数据与tokenizer codebook联合缩放的范式，为离散tokenizer的词汇扩展提供了可迁移的思路。
summary.technical_approach: 构建大规模物理可信的合成人类动作数据生成管线，扩展训练数据分布；同时设计适配该扩展分布的改进VQ-VAE tokenizer，联合缩放训练分布与离散codebook的大小，以捕获更丰富的动作基元。
summary.experiments: 提供的摘要未披露具体合成数据规模、codebook大小、基线模型及量化效果，仅提及该方法可显著扩展动作表示空间，提升对稀有、组合、高动态动作的泛化能力。
summary.authors_note: 达特茅斯学院团队，无知名预训练领域作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete tokenizers for human motion generation are limited by the low diversity of real motion capture (MoCap) datasets, which fail to cover long-tail complex motions, resulting in restricted representation space and poor generalization.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a paradigm of jointly scaling synthetic training data and tokenizer codebook, providing transferable insights for vocabulary expansion of discrete tokenizers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a large-scale physically plausible synthetic human motion generation pipeline to expand the training distribution; designs an improved VQ-VAE tokenizer adapted to the expanded distribution, and jointly scales the training distribution and discrete codebook size to capture richer motion primitives.
summary_en.experiments: No specific synthetic data scale, codebook size, baselines, or quantitative results disclosed in the provided abstract; only mentions that the method significantly expands the motion representation space and improves generalization to rare, compositional, and highly dynamic motions.
summary_en.authors_note: Dartmouth College team; no well-known pretraining researchers identified.

recommendation.zh: 特定模态的tokenizer改进，仅看§3的合成数据管线与codebook联合缩放设计即可，思路可迁移到文本/多模态tokenizer的长尾覆盖优化。
recommendation.en: Modality-specific tokenizer improvement; only read §3 for synthetic data pipeline and joint codebook-data scaling design, insights transferable to long-tail optimization of text/multimodal tokenizers.

paper.title: Dataset Usage Inference without Shadow Models or Held-out Data
paper.abstract: How much of my data was used to train a machine learning model? Dataset Usage Inference (DUI) aims to answer this by estimating what fraction of a dataset contributed to a model's training. However, existing DUI methods rely on assumptions that rarely hold in practice: they require training expensive shadow models to imitate the target model, and they assume access to both known training samples and an in-distribution held-out set confirmed to be absent from training. These conditions make curre

summary.core_problem: 如何在不训练昂贵的影子模型（shadow models）且没有可信的、未参与训练的保留数据集（held-out data）的情况下，推断某个数据集有多大比例被用于训练目标生成模型（Dataset Usage Inference, DUI）？
summary.importance: 为大模型时代的数据版权和合规审计提供了一种切实可行的方案。传统的 DUI 方法（如 DUCI）依赖影子模型和保留数据，这在动辄数十亿参数的现代生成模型面前计算成本极高且不切实际。本文提出的 NU-DUI 框架将计算成本降低了三个数量级，使得对大型自回归或扩散模型的训练数据审计成为可能。
summary.technical_approach: 将 DUI 转化为混合比例估计（Mixture Proportion Estimation, MPE）问题。核心创新在于构建合成的非成员参考集：1) 使用与目标模型不同架构的生成器对可疑数据集进行图像到图像（img2img）的重写，生成合成的非成员样本；2) 使用重写过程中相同的自编码器对可疑数据集进行自编码，以消除生成器伪影带来的分布偏移，使得成员和非成员之间的差异主要由是否参与训练决定；3) 提取针对目标模型家族定制的成员推断攻击（MIA）特征；4) 应用 MPE 估计成员比例。
summary.experiments: 在五个大型图像生成模型（包括自回归和扩散模型，如 RAR-XXL）上进行了验证。在 RAR-XXL 上，对于 1000 张图像的可疑集，NU-DUI 仅需 42.5 分钟（A100），而传统方法需要 1500 多小时，加速比超过 2000 倍。同时，估计误差（MAE）保持在 0.1 以下（例如 0.058），接近需要可信保留数据的理想情况。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Method 部分，特别是如何通过 img2img 重写和自编码对齐来构建合成非成员参考集的设计，这是本文最巧妙的地方。实验部分可以关注其在不同模型架构（自回归 vs 扩散）上的鲁棒性表现。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to infer the fraction of a dataset used to train a target generative model (Dataset Usage Inference, DUI) without training expensive shadow models or requiring a trusted held-out dataset?
summary_en.importance: Provides a practical solution for data copyright and compliance auditing in the era of large models. Traditional DUI methods (like DUCI) rely on shadow models and held-out data, which are computationally prohibitive and impractical for modern generative models with billions of parameters. The proposed NU-DUI framework reduces computational costs by three orders of magnitude, making training data auditing feasible for large autoregressive or diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Casts DUI as a Mixture Proportion Estimation (MPE) problem. The core innovation lies in constructing a synthetic non-member reference set: 1) Paraphrasing the suspect dataset using an image-to-image generator from a different family than the target model to create synthetic non-member samples; 2) Autoencoding the suspect dataset using the same autoencoder used during paraphrasing to align generator artifacts, ensuring the residual distribution shift is dominated by membership; 3) Extracting Membership Inference Attack (MIA) features tailored to the target model family; 4) Applying MPE to estimate the member ratio.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on five large-scale image generative models (both autoregressive and diffusion, e.g., RAR-XXL). On RAR-XXL with a suspect set of 1,000 images, NU-DUI takes only 42.5 A100 minutes, compared to over 1,500 hours for traditional methods, achieving a speedup of over 2,000x. The estimation error (MAE) remains well below 0.1 (e.g., 0.058), closing the gap to the oracle setting that requires trusted held-out data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section, particularly the design of constructing the synthetic non-member reference set via img2img paraphrasing and autoencoding alignment, which is the most ingenious part of the paper. In the experiments, pay attention to its robustness across different model architectures (autoregressive vs. diffusion). Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关注预训练数据版权合规的团队可参考其合成非成员样本+混合比例估计的思路，仅读§3方法部分即可，文本LLM场景需单独复现验证。
recommendation.en: For teams focused on pretraining data copyright compliance, refer to the synthetic non-member + mixture proportion estimation pipeline in §3; replicate on text LLMs before production adoption.

paper.title: PhysEditWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset Toward Physics-Editable World Models
paper.abstract: Recent game world models can synthesize visually plausible, action-conditioned rollouts. However, their interaction behaviors often remain limited to exploratory or wandering trajectories, and physical dynamics are typically learned as implicit correlations from data rather than as controllable variables. This limitation hinders their applicability to authored game environments, where physical rules are deliberately designed and require explicit manipulation. We introduce PhysEditWorld, a multim

summary.core_problem: 构建一个可控制物理参数的游戏世界模型数据集，使模型能学习同一动作轨迹在不同重力条件下产生的可归因变化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态世界模型数据资产。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但受控 replay-and-render 数据构造方式对 embodied/world-model 预训练的数据设计有参考意义，尤其是把物理变量从相关性中显式拆出来。
summary.technical_approach: PhysEditWorld 基于 UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline：记录归一化 action trace，然后在相同初始状态、角色控制器、动作序列和相机策略下，用不同 gravity configuration 重放并渲染，从而形成成对、可控、可归因的物理变化数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示数据集包含 12 个 cinematic UE5 scenes，并围绕 gravity 作为首个版本的核心物理参数；具体样本规模、训练模型、baseline 和指标在给定信息中不完整。论文重点更偏数据构建，而不是提出新的生成模型结构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a dataset for physics-editable game world models, enabling models to observe attributable changes under different gravity settings for the same action trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a multimodal world-model dataset contribution. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the controlled replay-and-render design is relevant to data construction for embodied and generative world models, especially for disentangling physical variables from raw correlations.
summary_en.technical_approach: PhysEditWorld uses a UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline. It records normalized action traces and replays the same initial state, character controller, action sequence, and camera policy under multiple gravity configurations, producing controlled paired data for physical variation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the dataset contains 12 cinematic UE5 scenes and focuses on gravity in the initial release. The provided information does not fully specify dataset size, trained model scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The main contribution is the data-generation protocol.

recommendation.zh: 可看数据构造思路，不必读模型细节；受控重放比随机视频采集更像 world-model 预训练该要的数据。
recommendation.en: Worth noting for the data protocol, not the model details; controlled replay is closer to useful world-model pretraining data than random video scraping.

paper.title: Autodata: An agentic data scientist to create high quality synthetic data
paper.abstract: We introduce Autodata, a general method that enables AI agents to act as data scientists who build high quality training and evaluation data. We show how to train (meta-optimize) such a data scientist agent, so that it learns to create even stronger data. We describe the overall formulation, and a specific practical implementation, Agentic Self-Instruct. We conduct experiments on computer science research tasks, legal reasoning tasks and reasoning with mathematical objects, where we obtain impro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题是：如何把更强的推理时计算转化成更高质量的训练数据和评测数据，而不是只用固定 prompt 做 Self-Instruct 式生成。核心目标不是生成更多样本，而是让一个 agent 像数据科学家一样创建、检查、迭代数据，并进一步学习如何更好地创建数据。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练数据研究的启发在于，它把合成数据生成从一次性 prompting 推向了闭环优化。数据不再只是模型采样的副产物，而是由 challenger、solver、verifier 和主控 agent 共同塑形的对象。这个方向适合用于构造推理训练数据、困难负例、benchmark 样本，以及 SFT/RL 的训练集。需要注意的是，当前贡献更偏方法框架和实践范式，离大规模预训练数据配比或数据质量定律还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: Autodata 的基本结构包含两个循环。内层循环由数据创建和数据分析组成：agent 基于 grounding context 生成样本，再检查样本是否正确、是否足够困难、是否能区分弱模型和强模型，然后把分析结果反馈给下一轮生成。外层循环是对这个“数据科学家 agent”本身做 meta-optimization，即优化 agent harness、prompt、工具使用和决策策略，使它更擅长产生有效数据。具体实现 Agentic Self-Instruct 使用四类子 agent：Challenger 生成样本，Weak solver 尝试解题，Strong solver 提供较强解答，Verifier/judge 检查答案和样本质量。对于可验证任务，可以要求强模型多数投票正确、弱模型多数投票错误；对于不可完全验证任务，则用 judge 根据 rubric 估计强弱解答的质量差距。相比传统 Self-Instruct，它显式把“难度控制”和“样本质量检查”放进生成流程，而不是先生成再简单过滤。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖计算机科学研究任务、法律推理任务、数学对象推理任务。结果显示，Agentic Self-Instruct 相比经典合成数据创建方法带来更好的训练或评测效果；进一步对数据科学家 agent 做 meta-optimization 后，提升更明显。文中提供的内容强调了弱/强 solver 间隔、verifier 反馈和多轮迭代的重要性，但当前给出的全文片段没有暴露完整表格中的逐任务数字、样本规模和提升幅度，因此不宜补写具体数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Autodata 总体框架图和 Agentic Self-Instruct 的实现图，理解它如何把 challenger、weak solver、strong solver、verifier 组织成数据创建闭环。实验部分主要看三个问题：一是它相对普通 Self-Instruct 的增益是否来自样本难度而非样本数量；二是 verifier 的可靠性如何影响数据质量；三是 meta-optimization 优化的是哪些 agent 决策。若关注预训练数据，值得深挖的是 support/coverage、difficulty 和 verifier noise 这些因素未来能否形成可测的数据质量指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to convert additional inference-time compute into better training and evaluation data, rather than relying on one-shot Self-Instruct-style prompting. The target is not merely to generate more examples, but to build an agentic data scientist that creates, audits, and iterates on data, and can itself be meta-optimized.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining and post-training data work is the shift from static synthetic data generation to a closed-loop data construction process. Synthetic data is treated as an object to be shaped by a challenger, solvers, a verifier, and a controller, rather than as raw model samples followed by light filtering. This is most directly useful for reasoning data, hard negatives, benchmark construction, and SFT/RL data generation. The contribution is currently closer to a practical framework than to a scaling law or a large-scale pretraining data recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Autodata has an inner loop and an outer loop. The inner loop alternates between data creation and data analysis: an agent grounds on source material, generates examples, checks whether they are correct and challenging, measures whether they separate weak and strong models, and feeds the lessons back into the next generation pass. The outer loop meta-optimizes the data scientist agent itself, including its harness, prompts, tool use, and decision policy. The concrete implementation, Agentic Self-Instruct, uses a main orchestrator and four LLM-based subagents: a Challenger that creates examples, a Weak solver expected to fail on many generated cases, a Strong solver expected to solve them, and a Verifier/judge that evaluates both solutions and example quality. For verifiable tasks, the intended criterion is often that the strong solver majority is correct while the weak solver majority is wrong. For less verifiable tasks, the judge scores the gap using generated rubrics. Compared with standard Self-Instruct, the key addition is explicit difficulty control and iterative quality analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover computer science research tasks, legal reasoning, and reasoning over mathematical objects. Agentic Self-Instruct improves over classical synthetic dataset creation baselines, and meta-optimizing the data scientist agent provides an additional gain. The supplied full-content excerpt describes the setup and qualitative findings, but does not expose the complete per-task tables, dataset sizes, or exact improvement numbers, so the safe reading is about mechanism and design rather than precise effect size.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the Autodata template and the Agentic Self-Instruct diagram, especially how the challenger, weak solver, strong solver, and verifier form a feedback loop. In the experiments, check whether gains come from harder examples rather than just more examples, how verifier errors are controlled, and what exactly is optimized during meta-optimization. For pretraining-data researchers, the useful thread is whether coverage, difficulty, solver gap, and verifier noise can become measurable data-quality signals.

recommendation.zh: 把合成数据流程改成可元优化的智能体闭环思路有参考价值，目前实验仅覆盖后训练推理任务，看§3方法和§4.2消融即可
recommendation.en: The meta-optimizable agent loop for synthetic data is a useful reference; experiments only cover post-training reasoning tasks, read §3 method and §4.2 ablation only

institutions: ) has concentrated on agentic methods for architectural or training recipe

paper.title: An LMM for Precisely Grounding Elements in Documents
paper.abstract: Visual grounding in documents is a crucial ability for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in areas such as document understanding, deep research and document error detection. However, existing approaches exhibit poor grounding precision in text-rich document images, often failing to accurately locate the critical document elements needed for reliable reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce PreciseDoc, an LMM specifically designed for precise element grounding and can be further optimized for Do

summary.core_problem: 提升大多模态模型在文本密集型文档图像中的元素级精确定位能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是文档 LMM 的定位数据构造和训练范式，属于多模态理解的专门能力建设。它对 VLM 预训练的可迁移启发在于：文档场景需要细粒度坐标监督，普通图文对齐不足以支撑可靠 grounding。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PreciseDoc，并构建两条可批量生产训练数据的流水线，生成带细粒度坐标元数据的高质量文档，包括带相机效果的合成手填文档。训练目标从单文本定位扩展到真实功能型定位，例如在简历中定位个人信息，并进一步服务 Document VQA。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练样本规模、baseline 和具体提升幅度。实验声称模型可进一步优化 Document VQA，但可验证细节需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve element-level precise grounding for large multimodal models on text-rich document images.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a document-focused LMM training and data-construction approach. Its transferable lesson for VLM pretraining is that document grounding requires fine-grained coordinate supervision; generic image-text alignment is usually not enough.
summary_en.technical_approach: PreciseDoc uses two data-generation pipelines to mass-produce high-quality documents with fine-grained coordinate metadata, including synthetic hand-filled documents with camera effects. The training setup goes beyond locating single text spans and covers functional localization, such as finding personal information in CVs, with possible downstream optimization for Document VQA.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training-data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. It states that the model can be further optimized for Document VQA, but the concrete evidence requires the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 文档 grounding 数据工程味较重；只看数据生成流水线即可，作为 VLM 坐标监督的备查。
recommendation.en: This is mostly document-grounding data engineering; skim the data-generation pipeline as a reference for coordinate-supervised VLM training.

paper.title: Geometry-Instructed Video Editing
paper.abstract: Object-level geometric edits, including translating, rotating, scaling, duplicating, or removing an object, are routine operations in digital content creation (DCC) workflows, yet they remain unreliable in generative video editing. The key challenge lies in specifying the target object's 3D state change unambiguously across viewpoint and time, while consistently updating geometry-dependent secondary effects such as shadows and reflections. We introduce GIVE, a geometry-instructed video editing f

summary.core_problem: 解决生成式视频编辑中物体级几何操作难以精确指定、跨时间和视角不稳定、且阴影反射等几何相关效应难以同步更新的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成/编辑中的条件表示和合成监督数据管线。它对统一多模态预训练不是核心工作，但对几何条件如何进入视频生成模型有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GIVE，用统一 object-state formulation 表示平移、旋转、缩放、复制和删除等操作；使用两个 video-aligned geometry streams：depth-box 编码编辑前后 3D 位置和范围，orientation-box 提供与外观无关的朝向线索；通过 graphics-engine pipeline 构造 paired supervision。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明构建了可扩展图形引擎数据管线用于成对监督，但未给出模型规模、数据量、baseline、指标或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles object-level geometric video editing, where translation, rotation, scaling, duplication, and removal are hard to specify precisely and often fail to update shadows, reflections, and temporal geometry consistently.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a conditioning representation and synthetic paired-supervision pipeline for video generation/editing. It is not central to unified multimodal pretraining, but it is useful background for geometry-conditioned video models.
summary_en.technical_approach: GIVE represents edits with a unified object-state formulation. Two video-aligned geometry streams specify pre- and post-edit states: a depth-box for coarse 3D placement and extent, and an orientation-box for appearance-agnostic orientation. A graphics-engine pipeline supplies paired supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions a scalable graphics-engine pipeline for paired training data, but does not provide model scale, dataset size, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 看几何条件表示和数据管线即可；它是视频编辑工程，不是统一建模范式变化。
recommendation.en: Read only the geometry-conditioning design and data pipeline; this is video-editing engineering, not a shift in unified modeling.

paper.title: One Image is All You Need: Agentic One-Shot Image Generation via Text-Based World Models for Long-Tail Spatial Perception
paper.abstract: Reliable spatial decision automation, such as autonomous driving and maritime surveillance, critically depends on robust visual perception. However, real-world spatiotemporal data exhibits severe heterogeneity, often manifesting as extreme long-tail distributions for safety-critical scenarios. This data scarcity induces dataset shift that degrades detection performance and pose safety risks. While synthetic data generation offers a potential solution, existing generative approaches, such as diff

summary.core_problem: 在长尾安全关键场景数据稀缺下，如何从单张参考图出发生成具备空间一致性与结构约束的场景数据，用于提升空间感知/决策系统鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏生成式数据合成框架：把“单图→结构化场景表示→受约束生成”做成agentic流水线，针对长尾空间关系一致性问题；对多模态数据合成（用于训练/评测）有一定参考，但更偏CV生成而非LLM基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: WMGen-v1：用大型VLM从单张图构建结构化场景表示（显式空间/对象关系），再由LLM进行规划/约束生成流程（文本世界模型/场景脚本），最后驱动扩散/GAN类生成器产出满足空间约束的合成图像（摘要未给出具体生成器与约束实现细节）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据与定量指标；主要宣称在长尾空间感知数据生成上比无显式结构约束的生成方法更一致、更可控（需看正文的空间一致性度量、下游检测/定位增益与消融）。

summary_en.core_problem: Under long-tail data scarcity for safety-critical spatial perception, how to generate spatially consistent, structurally constrained scenes starting from a single reference image.
summary_en.importance: A generative data synthesis pipeline: it operationalizes an agentic “single image → structured scene → constrained generation” workflow for long-tail spatial consistency. Some relevance as multimodal synthetic data tooling, but it’s closer to CV generation than foundation LLM pretraining.
