summary_en.technical_approach: WMGen-v1: a large VLM extracts a structured scene representation from one image; an LLM acts as a planner/world-model to produce constrained textual scene specifications; a generative model (e.g., diffusion/GAN) renders images that satisfy spatial/physical constraints (exact generator/constraints not detailed in the abstract).
summary_en.experiments: No model sizes, training data, or quantitative results are provided in the abstract; claims improved spatial/physical consistency over unconstrained generators (check main paper for metrics, downstream gains, and ablations).

recommendation.zh: 当作“结构化场景→受约束生成”的数据合成思路备查即可；除非正文给出干净的空间一致性指标和下游增益，否则对基座预训练帮助有限。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for “structured scene → constrained generation” data synthesis; unless the paper has clean spatial-consistency metrics and downstream gains, it won’t move pretraining decisions.

paper.title: VeriEvol: Scaling Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning via Verifiable Evol-Instruct
paper.abstract: Scaling reinforcement learning for visual mathematical reasoning requires more than generating harder questions: as data volume grows, the reward labels themselves must remain reliable. Yet existing data pipelines scale supervision while trusting the labeller, and policy-side methods assume the underlying answers are already correct. We instead treat scaling as a verifiable data-construction problem and decouple two axes before any policy update: prompt difficulty, expanded by route-specific evo

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的不是“怎样再造一批更难的视觉数学题”这么简单，而是更具体的训练瓶颈：当多模态数学推理进入 SFT+RL 的规模化阶段后，真正限制上限的往往不是题量，而是 reward 所依赖答案的可靠性。视觉数学任务里，题目必须同时满足图像 grounding、数学结构正确、答案可验证；一旦错误标签进入 RL，噪声不会停留在数据层，而会被反复转成优化目标，持续强化错误策略。论文因此把问题重新定义为一个可验证的数据构造问题：在 policy update 之前，先把“难度扩展”和“答案可靠性”两条轴拆开，分别做 prompt evolution 和 offline falsification verification，再把通过验证的样本交给现有 SFT / GRPO 流程。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的意义很直接。它说明在 reasoning-heavy、尤其是 multimodal reasoning 的训练里，数据构造不能只追求规模和难度，还要把 reward quality 当成一等公民。很多 RL 论文把优化器、采样策略、advantage 设计讲得很细，但默认答案标签是干净的；这篇工作反过来强调，若标签本身不可靠，policy-side 改进很容易被上游噪声吞掉。更重要的是，它把 verifier 从训练环里解耦出来，做成可扩展、可审计、可离线迭代的数据生产系统。这种思路对合成推理数据、代码验证、数学验证、甚至未来 pretrain↔post-train 的中间阶段都有参考价值。量级上，这不是基础架构层面的范式替换，但在“如何规模化制造高质量 reasoning supervision”这个问题上，属于方法论上比较扎实的一步。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案由 VeriEvol 框架和 HTV-Agent 两个核心部件组成。

第一部分是 type-aware prompt evolution。输入是低难度 seed 样本 x=(I,q,a)，目标是构造更难但仍然 image-grounded 的新样本 \u007e{x}=(I,q',â,m)。作者没有采用单一通用改写器，而是按题型路由，例如 geometry、chart、OCR 等，每一类使用 family-specific evolution operators。这样做的原因很明确：视觉数学题的难度不是靠把问题写长，而是靠增加真正依赖图像结构的推理步骤。几何题可以通过引入辅助关系、角度/长度约束、多步推导来变难；图表题则可以通过跨区域比较、组合统计量、条件筛选来增加推理深度。route-specific operator 的价值在于避免生成“表面更复杂、实则可由文本先验回答”的伪难题。

第二部分是 HTV-Agent，即 hypothesis-test verifier。它不是让一个 judge 直接给分，而是采用“先提出候选解释，再主动寻找反证”的 falsification 流程。文中描述为四阶段：
1. independent solver hypotheses：多个独立求解器先给出候选答案或推理假设；
2. refutation-seeking verification：从 counter-evidence、programmatic checking、visual evidence 等多个通道尝试推翻候选答案；
3. conflict resolution by a decider：当不同通道结论冲突时，由 decider 汇总证据做裁决；
4. deterministic acceptance gate：只有满足预设接受条件的样本才进入 RL 数据池。

这里最关键的设计不是“多 agent”本身，而是 verifier 的接口化和可扩展性。作者把 difficulty scaling、answer verification、policy optimization 三者拆开：增加题目难度时，只需扩展 evolution routes；提高答案可靠性时，只需增加新的 refutation channel 或更严格的 acceptance contract；而训练端仍然消费标准 prompt-answer-reward tuple，不需要改 GRPO recipe。相比把生成、验证、训练绑成一个端到端黑盒，这种分层设计更适合规模化迭代，也更容易审计错误来源。

数据产物也分成两层：SFT 数据允许较宽松的 reasoning trace 和 evidence；RL 数据则要求更强的答案规范化和 deterministic reward-checker 保证。这个区分很合理，因为 SFT 可以容忍一定表达多样性，而 RL 的 reward 若不稳定，会直接污染梯度信号。
summary.experiments:
实验结果给得比较具体，能看出作者想证明两件事：一是数据量扩展有效，二是“验证过的数据”比“只是变多的数据”更重要。

1. SFT 数据扩展：将 SFT 数据从 10K 扩到 250K，平均指标提升 +19.31。这个幅度说明 route-specific evol-instruct 不是只在制造冗余样本，而是在持续提供更有训练价值的视觉数学监督。

2. RL 数据扩展：在 RL 阶段，把 verified data 从 10K 扩到 130K，沿数据规模轴带来平滑的 +4.60 提升。这里“平滑”很重要，说明 verifier 没有随着数据规模上升而明显恶化标签质量，否则 RL 往往会出现收益饱和甚至反噬。

3. 设计本身的增益：在固定 130K RL 数据预算下，VeriEvol 相比未演化的 RL baseline 额外提升 +3.88，其中 +1.82 来自 evolved prompts，+2.06 来自 verifier。这个拆分很有信息量：答案验证带来的收益略高于单纯增加题目难度，支持了论文的核心论点——reward quality 是一等瓶颈。

4. 数据可追踪性：作者还强调每个样本都释放完整 verifier trace，包括 solver hypotheses、counter-evidence report、tool outputs、decider rationale、gate outcomes 等。虽然这不是传统意义上的 benchmark 数字，但对复现实验和分析 verifier failure mode 很关键。

当前给出的正文片段没有完整列出底座模型规模、视觉编码器配置、RL 轮数、具体 benchmark 名称和分项成绩，因此无法安全补充更多数字。精读时应重点核对：不同题型 route 的贡献是否均衡；HTV-Agent 各验证通道的 precision / recall 或 acceptance rate；被 verifier 拒绝的样本主要是哪类错误；以及随着数据规模增加，accepted sample 的质量是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇值得精读。建议先看 Introduction，抓住作者为什么把问题定义成“verifiable data construction”而不是 RL algorithm design。然后看 Figure 2 和方法总览，理解 VeriEvol 如何把 difficulty scaling、verification、training signal materialization 拆开。接着重点读 3.2 的 type-aware evolution 和 3.3 的 HTV-Agent，这两节是核心创新所在。实验部分优先看三类表：数据规模扩展曲线、固定预算下 evolved prompt 与 verifier 的增益拆分、以及 verifier 相关消融。若附录里有 acceptance gate、answer normalization、tool contracts 的细节，也值得看，因为这些决定了 RL reward 是否真的 deterministic。若时间充足，建议顺带检查开放 trace 的样例，看看 verifier 是如何处理冲突证据和视觉 grounding 失败的。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in scaling multimodal mathematical reasoning: once training moves into large-scale SFT and RL, the limiting factor is often not the number of questions but the reliability of the answers that become reward signals. In visual math, a sample must be image-grounded, mathematically valid, and verifiable. If incorrect labels enter RL, the noise is not a passive annotation issue anymore; it is repeatedly converted into optimization pressure and can reinforce the wrong policy. The paper therefore reframes scaling as a verifiable data-construction problem. Before any policy update, it separates two axes that are usually entangled: prompt difficulty is expanded through structured evolution, while answer reliability is enforced through offline falsification-based verification.
summary_en.importance: This matters at the pretrain–posttrain interface. Many reasoning papers spend most of their effort on the optimizer side—sampling, GRPO variants, advantage shaping—while assuming the answer labels are already trustworthy. This work argues that for reasoning-heavy multimodal training, reward quality is itself a first-order systems problem. Its main contribution is not a new RL algorithm, but a data pipeline that makes verification modular, auditable, and scalable. That is useful beyond visual math: the same design logic is relevant to synthetic reasoning corpora, code verification, math supervision, and any setting where noisy labels can be amplified by RL. The contribution is methodological rather than architectural, but it is a meaningful step toward scalable high-quality reasoning supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework has two main components: VeriEvol for prompt evolution and HTV-Agent for answer verification.

The first component is type-aware prompt evolution. Starting from a low-difficulty seed sample x=(I, q, a), the system constructs a harder but still image-grounded sample \u007etilde{x}=(I, q', â, m). Instead of using one generic rewriting model, it routes each seed by problem family—such as geometry, charts, or OCR—and applies family-specific evolution operators. This design choice is important. In visual math, difficulty should come from additional grounded reasoning steps, not from making the prompt longer or more verbose. Geometry can be made harder by introducing auxiliary relations and multi-step constraints; chart questions can be made harder by requiring cross-region comparison, aggregation, or conditional filtering. Route-specific evolution is meant to avoid pseudo-hard examples that look more complex but can still be solved from text priors.

The second component is HTV-Agent, a hypothesis-test verifier. Rather than asking a single judge to score an answer, it follows a falsification-oriented pipeline: propose candidate solutions, then actively try to refute them. The paper describes four stages: (1) independent solver hypotheses, where multiple solvers generate candidate answers or reasoning hypotheses; (2) refutation-seeking verification, which checks those candidates through counter-evidence, programmatic tools, and visual evidence channels; (3) conflict resolution by a decider when channels disagree; and (4) a deterministic acceptance gate that only admits samples satisfying predefined criteria into the RL pool.

The key idea is not merely “multi-agent verification.” It is the separation of interfaces. Difficulty scaling, answer verification, and policy optimization are decoupled. New evolution routes can be added without changing the verifier. New verification channels can be added without changing the RL optimizer. The training side still consumes standard prompt-answer-reward tuples, so existing SFT and GRPO recipes remain usable. This is a cleaner systems design than an end-to-end generator-verifier-trainer loop where all failure modes are entangled.

The paper also distinguishes between SFT and RL data products. SFT samples can tolerate more flexible reasoning traces and evidence. RL samples require stronger answer normalization and deterministic reward-checker guarantees. That separation is well motivated: RL is much less tolerant to label ambiguity because reward instability directly corrupts the gradient signal.
summary_en.experiments:
The reported numbers support two claims: scaling data helps, and verified data helps more than merely larger data.

1. SFT scaling: increasing SFT data from 10K to 250K improves the mean score by +19.31. This suggests the route-specific evol-instruct pipeline is generating supervision with real training value rather than mostly redundant variants.

2. RL scaling: increasing verified RL data from 10K to 130K yields a smooth +4.60 gain along the data-volume axis. The word “smooth” matters here. It suggests that verification quality does not collapse as the pool grows; otherwise RL gains would typically saturate early or become unstable.

3. Design contribution at fixed budget: with the RL budget fixed at 130K, the full VeriEvol design outperforms an unevolved RL baseline by +3.88. The gain decomposes into +1.82 from evolved prompts and +2.06 from the verifier. This decomposition is one of the most informative results in the paper: answer verification contributes slightly more than prompt hardening, which directly supports the paper’s central claim that reward quality is a primary bottleneck.

4. Traceability: every released sample includes the full verifier trace—solver hypotheses, counter-evidence reports, tool outputs, decider rationale, and gate outcomes. This is not a benchmark number, but it is important for reproducibility and for analyzing verifier failure modes.

The provided text does not include the full experimental tables, base model size, visual encoder details, RL schedule, or benchmark-by-benchmark breakdown, so those should be checked in the full paper. The most important details to inspect are the contribution of each route type, the acceptance rate and error profile of HTV-Agent, and whether accepted-sample quality remains stable as the data pool scales.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a must-read paper. Start with the introduction to understand why the authors frame the problem as verifiable data construction rather than RL algorithm design. Then read the main system overview and Figure 2 carefully, because the separation between difficulty scaling, verification, and training signal materialization is the central design choice. After that, focus on Section 3.2 for type-aware evolution and Section 3.3 for HTV-Agent; these are the two technical cores. In the experiments, prioritize the scaling curves, the fixed-budget ablation that separates prompt evolution from verification, and any verifier-specific analysis. If the appendix includes details on acceptance gates, answer normalization, and tool contracts, those are worth reading because they determine whether the RL reward is truly deterministic.

recommendation.zh: 这类 verified data pipeline 比新 RL loss 更可能迁移；重点读 HTV-Agent 的拒绝规则和误杀率。
recommendation.en: This verified-data pipeline is more likely to transfer than another RL loss; inspect HTV-Agent’s rejection rules and false-negative behavior.

paper.title: Tmax: A simple recipe for terminal agents
paper.abstract: Terminal-using agents have quickly become the most popular downstream application of language models (LMs). Despite their prevalence, relatively little academic work has examined RL-based training of these models, likely due to difficult benchmarks, a lack of data, and a lack of simple baseline recipes. We present Tmax, the strongest open RL recipe for terminal agents to date, bringing open data recipes closer to the frontier. While simple, our recipe achieves 27\% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 with onl

summary.core_problem: 如何在长时序、强交互、奖励稀疏且评测严格的“终端（terminal）代理”场景里，给开源权重模型提供一套可复现、稳定的 RL 后训练配方，并配套足够难、足够大、可用于 RL 的环境数据，从而把小模型的 terminal agent 能力推到可用水平。
summary.importance: 这篇更像“RL post-train 工程配方 + 可训练环境数据”的工作，而不是预训练范式创新。对基座研究的价值主要在两点：第一，长时序 agent RL 的稳定性手段（算法选择、数值精度、group size、异步基础设施）给出了可落地的经验组合；第二，证明了在 terminal 这种工具交互分布上做 RL，不只是 harness-fitting，能外溢到 SWE-Bench Verified、甚至 AIME 这类非同分布评测。对“pretrain↔posttrain 闭环”的启发在于：高质量、可控难度的合成环境 + 稳定 RL 训练，能把能力推到传统 SFT 难以覆盖的区域。
summary.technical_approach:
核心由两部分组成：
1) 数据/环境生成（TMAX-15K）：用强闭源/前沿模型合成 terminal 环境实例，而不是只合成轨迹。作者强调用一个“taxonomy”去组织生成：显式难度控制（逐级变难）、persona（改变任务叙事/约束以增加分布多样性）、verifier diversification（多样化校验器/评分器，避免单一二值判定带来的奖励脆弱性）。并且在部分任务上引入连续值奖励，而不是只有 pass/fail。
2) RL 训练配方（TMAX）：基于 open-instruct 的全异步 RL 基础设施做长时序训练。作者观察到朴素 GRPO 在 long-horizon agent 场景里不稳定，于是改用 DPPO（Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization），并配合两个关键稳定性措施：FP32 的 LM head（降低混合精度下 logits/softmax 的数值问题）与更大的 group size（降低优势估计方差、让更新更“平均”）。整体目标是让策略更新在长轨迹、工具调用频繁、奖励噪声更大的情况下不崩。
与既有工作差异：相对 Endless Terminals / OpenThinker-Agent 这类“有数据/有 RL 但规模或难度不足”的路线，TMAX 更强调可控难度的环境生成与 RL 稳定性工程；相对 SWE 系列从真实 repo/issue 构造环境，TMAX 更偏 taxonomy 驱动的合成任务覆盖面，减少被软件工程单一分布绑架。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的关键结果：
- 数据：TMAX-15K 共 14,600 个 RL 环境实例，作者称比第二大“完整释放环境数据”的 terminal 数据集大 2.5x，并且用 Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 的 pass rate 侧面证明更难。
- 主结果：9B 模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上达到 27%（默认设置），优于此前同量级开源模型，并声称接近某些小型闭源模型（文中举例 Claude Haiku 4.5）。
- 迁移/外溢：RL 后训练让 SWE-Bench Verified 提升 5+ points；并且对 AIME 这类非 agent 评测也有提升（幅度未在片段中给出具体数）。
- 泛化性：在不同 prompts/toolsets 的 harness 下仍有提升，作者据此主张不是单纯对评测 harness 过拟合。
（注：你提供的全文内容在实验细节处截断，诸如 DPPO/GRPO 的对照曲线、group size/FP32 head 的消融、训练步数/采样量/奖励设计的具体数字，需要在论文实验章节与附录中补齐才能给出更精确的量化复述。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–40 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“为什么 GRPO 不稳、为什么选 DPPO + FP32 head + 大 group”的动机描述，抓住作者认为的主要失稳来源。
- 精看数据生成那一节（taxonomy、difficulty/persona/verifier diversification、连续奖励），这是可复用性最高的部分：它决定了 RL 信号质量与任务覆盖。
- 实验部分重点找三类图表：① RL 稳定性（loss/kl/reward 曲线、崩溃案例）；② 关键消融（GRPO vs DPPO、FP16/FP32 head、group size、数据来源对比）；③ 泛化实验（跨 harness、跨任务）。
- 如果要复现/迁移到别的工具型 agent，优先抄“异步 rollouts + 稳定更新”的系统结构与日志产物（作者提到释放 rollouts 与 logprobs，适合做训练动态分析）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make RL post-training for long-horizon terminal-using agents reproducible and stable for open-weight models, while also providing sufficiently large and difficult RL-ready terminal environments so that relatively small models can reach practical performance on Terminal-Bench–style evaluations.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an RL post-training recipe plus an RL environment dataset, not a new pretraining paradigm. Its value to foundation-model researchers is pragmatic: (1) it packages a stability-oriented set of choices for long-horizon agent RL (algorithm, precision, group size, async infra) that others can replicate; (2) it argues the learned improvements are not merely harness overfitting, showing gains that transfer to SWE-Bench Verified and even non-agent math evals. It’s a concrete example of the pretrain↔post-train loop where controllable synthetic environments + stable RL can push capabilities beyond what SFT typically covers.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two pillars:
1) TMAX-15K environment generation: instead of only generating trajectories, they synthesize full terminal RL environment instances using a strong frontier model. A taxonomy drives generation with explicit difficulty control, persona variation (to diversify constraints and narrative framing), and verifier diversification (to avoid brittle binary checks). Some tasks use continuous-valued rewards rather than pass/fail.
2) RL recipe (TMAX): built on an asynchronous RL stack (open-instruct). They report naive GRPO becoming unstable in long-horizon agent settings, and switch to DPPO (Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization). Two emphasized stabilizers are an FP32 LM head (to mitigate mixed-precision numerical issues around logits/softmax/entropy/KL) and a large group size (lower-variance advantage estimates and smoother updates).
Compared to prior open terminal-agent efforts, the novelty is less about a new algorithm and more about a coherent, stability-first training stack paired with harder, taxonomy-controlled environments.
summary_en.experiments:
Confirmed from the provided full-text excerpt:
- Dataset: TMAX-15K contains 14,600 RL environment instances; claimed 2.5× larger than the next-largest terminal dataset that releases full environment data, and harder per Gemini-3-Flash-Preview pass rates.
- Main score: a 9B model reaches 27% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 under default settings, outperforming prior open models at similar sizes; they claim comparable performance to some smaller closed models (example given: Claude Haiku 4.5).
- Transfer: RL training improves SWE-Bench Verified by 5+ points; also reports gains on AIME (exact numbers not visible in the excerpt).
- Generalization: improvements persist under different prompts/toolsets (different harnesses), used as evidence against pure harness-fitting.
Note: the excerpt cuts before detailed tables/ablations; exact training compute, rollout counts, DPPO-vs-GRPO curves, and precision/group-size ablations should be taken from the experiments/appendix for a fully numeric recap.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
- Read the Introduction carefully for the failure mode claim (why GRPO is unstable) and the rationale for DPPO + FP32 head + large group size.
- Focus on the environment/data generation section: taxonomy design, difficulty scheduling, persona and verifier diversification, and where continuous rewards are used.
- In experiments, prioritize: (i) stability plots (reward/KL/loss spikes, collapse cases), (ii) ablations (GRPO vs DPPO, FP16 vs FP32 head, group size, data-source comparisons), and (iii) cross-harness / cross-task transfer results.
- If you plan to reproduce, the released rollouts and logprobs are worth inspecting for training-dynamics analysis.

recommendation.zh: 把“terminal agent 怎么做数据+怎么做 outcome-only RL”讲成可复现配方，适合直接照着复现；但提升可能主要来自数据生成与评测对齐，别把算法增益想太多。
recommendation.en: A reproducible recipe for terminal-agent data + outcome-only RL that you can copy into internal baselines; likely more about data/eval alignment than a new RL algorithm, so treat gains accordingly.

paper.title: FreeStyle: Free Control of Style-Content Dual-Reference Generation from Community LoRA Mining
paper.abstract: Style-content dual-reference generation aims to synthesize an image that preserves the structure and semantics of a content reference while adopting the style of a separate style reference.Despite recent progress, this setting remains challenging because models must balance content fidelity, style alignment, and instruction following avoiding semantic leakage from the style reference.A key bottleneck is the lack of large-scale triplet data with clean content-style separation and broad long-tail

summary.core_problem: 解决双参考图像生成中内容参考、风格参考难以解耦的问题，即既保持内容结构和语义，又采用另一张图的风格，同时避免风格参考带入语义泄漏。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成的数据与训练框架，重点在大规模 style-content triplet 构造和解耦训练；对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性有限，但 community LoRA mining 作为弱结构化数据来源有可借鉴之处。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FreeStyle，将社区 LoRA 视为风格和内容的组合锚点，围绕多个 base model 设计生成和过滤管线，构造 Style-Reference 与 Content-Reference 三元组。训练上采用两阶段 curriculum，并使用阶段特定的 disentanglement 机制；摘要提到包含 attention-level enrichment 约束，以缓解内容泄漏和风格语义混入。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体训练集规模、模型参数量、基线和数值提升。可确认的是，数据覆盖多个 base model，并面向风格-内容双参考生成进行训练与评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles dual-reference image generation: preserving the structure and semantics of a content reference while adopting the style of a separate style reference without semantic leakage.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a multimodal generation data-and-training framework, centered on large-scale style-content triplet construction and disentangled training. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but community LoRA mining is an interesting weakly structured data source.
summary_en.technical_approach: FreeStyle treats community LoRAs as compositional anchors for style and content, then builds a generation and filtering pipeline to create Style-Reference and Content-Reference triplets across multiple base models. Training uses a two-stage curriculum with stage-specific disentanglement mechanisms, including attention-level constraints mentioned in the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report dataset size, model scale, baseline names, or numerical gains. It does state that the pipeline spans multiple base models and targets style-content dual-reference generation.

recommendation.zh: 可略看数据管线：community LoRA 当标签和锚点的思路能借鉴到合成偏好数据，但图像风格任务偏窄。
recommendation.en: Skim the data pipeline: using community LoRAs as labels and anchors may transfer to synthetic preference data, though the task is narrow.

paper.title: Towards Engineering Scaling Laws with Pretraining Data Composition
paper.abstract: Neural scaling laws describe how model performance improves as a power law in compute, model size, and dataset size. While well-established for large language models, these relationships are emerging for large models in particle physics. As with language, empirical studies show that the performance scales as a power law. However, unlike natural language or image domains, fundamental physics has high-fidelity simulators that produce synthetic data cheaply. This favors scaling regimes where additi

summary.core_problem: 论文研究的是在高能物理模拟数据场景下，能否通过设计预训练数据组成来改变 scaling law 的形状和 compute-optimal 方向。具体任务是 hadronic jet 分类：固定下游任务，改变 JetClass-II 预训练子集里的物理过程组成，观察模型大小、预训练数据组成和微调性能之间的幂律关系。
summary.importance: 这不是 LLM 论文，领域任务也较窄；对基座预训练的价值在于数据组成与 scaling behavior 的关系。它把“数据更多”拆成更具体的问题：预训练数据是否覆盖更宽的生成过程，是否与下游任务的有效特征对齐。这个视角可以类比到语言模型的数据配比：不同语料不只是改变平均质量，也可能改变 scaling exponent、数据受限还是参数受限的最优区间，以及微调阶段对参数量和数据量的依赖。需要注意，论文中的数据来自可控物理模拟，和自然语言网页语料的采样约束不同，结论不能直接迁移。
summary.technical_approach: 方法使用一个处理 jet point cloud 的通用 Transformer。每个 jet 由 constituent particles 构成，每个粒子包含 4 个运动学特征、4 个轨迹位移特征和 1 个粒子 ID 特征。模型使用 learnable class token、pre-norm Transformer blocks、SwiGLU FFN，不使用位置编码，因为输入是集合而不是序列。模型深度固定为 4 层，attention head dimension 固定为 8，通过改变 embedding dimension 和 head 数得到 12 个模型规模，参数量约从 3K 到 10.5M。预训练数据来自 JetClass-II，共 188 类模拟 jet，分为 QCD、BSM two-prong resonance decay、BSM three/four-prong resonance decay 三组。论文构造四个预训练子集：QCD only、QCD+res2p、QCD+res34p、QCD+res2p+res34p。下游任务是在 JetClass 上做 10 类 jet 分类。核心设计是用 BSM resonance decay 增加预训练数据的 diversity 和 alignment：它们覆盖 QCD 不覆盖的相空间，并在 prong multiplicity、mass scale、substructure 等特征上更接近下游任务。
summary.experiments: 实验扫描 12 个模型规模和多种预训练数据组成，在 JetClass-II 上预训练后，在 JetClass 10 类分类任务上微调，并拟合性能随模型规模和数据组成变化的 scaling behavior。给定正文明确给出了模型规模范围、数据桶和预训练子集设计，但没有提供结果表格里的具体数值、拟合指数或误差下降幅度。可归纳的实验结论是：加入 BSM resonance decay 的预训练子集通过增加多样性和任务相关性，能够改变 fine-tuning scaling 的趋势，使 compute-optimal 分配更偏向使用数据，而不是单纯扩大模型。论文也承认当前实验没有分离 diversity 和 alignment 两个因素，因为 BSM-augmented 数据同时带来更宽支持集和更强下游相关性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 15–25 分钟。LLM 研究者不需要细读物理背景，重点看 Introduction 里关于 engineering scaling laws 的问题设定，以及 Methods 里四个预训练子集如何定义 diversity 和 alignment。实验部分优先看 scaling fits、不同数据组成的性能曲线、compute-optimal 讨论。如果关心数据配比研究，可以重点关注作者如何把“数据组成”转化为可控变量；如果只关心通用 LLM 预训练，这篇可以作为方法类旁证，不需要深读物理任务细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether scaling behavior can be engineered by changing the composition of pretraining data. The study is set in hadronic jet classification, where high-fidelity simulators make it cheap to generate controlled pretraining corpora. The concrete question is how different JetClass-II pretraining mixtures affect the scaling relation between model size, data composition, and downstream fine-tuning performance on JetClass.
summary_en.importance: This is a physics-domain study rather than an LLM pretraining paper, so its direct relevance is limited. The useful idea is that data composition can change not only the intercept of a scaling curve but also the regime in which more data or more parameters are preferred. For LLM pretraining, the analogue would be mixtures whose diversity and task alignment affect scaling exponents, downstream transfer, and compute-optimal allocation. The caveat is important: particle physics has controllable synthetic data generation, while language pretraining usually depends on messy, naturally occurring corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model is a Transformer over jet point clouds. Each jet is represented as a set of constituent particles, with kinematic features, trajectory displacement features, and particle identification features. The architecture uses a learnable class token, pre-norm Transformer blocks, SwiGLU feed-forward layers, and no positional encodings because the input is a set. Depth is fixed at four layers and the attention head dimension is fixed at eight; embedding width and number of heads are varied to obtain 12 model sizes from roughly 3K to 10.5M parameters. Pretraining uses JetClass-II, which contains 188 simulated jet classes grouped into QCD, two-prong BSM resonance decays, and three/four-prong BSM resonance decays. Four pretraining subsets are compared: QCD only, QCD plus res2p, QCD plus res34p, and the union of all three groups. The downstream task is 10-class jet classification on JetClass. The main design choice is to use BSM resonance decays as a controlled way to increase both distributional diversity and alignment with downstream substructure features.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments sweep model size and pretraining composition, then fine-tune on the JetClass classification task and analyze scaling trends. The available text gives the parameter range, architecture, data buckets, and mixture definitions, but not the exact fitted exponents or numerical performance gains. The reported qualitative result is that BSM-augmented pretraining mixtures alter the scaling behavior and move the preferred allocation toward data-rich regimes. The study also notes a limitation: diversity and alignment are not disentangled, because the BSM additions simultaneously broaden the pretraining support and improve feature overlap with the downstream task.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. For LLM pretraining readers, the useful parts are the introduction’s framing of engineered scaling laws and the methods section defining the four controlled data mixtures. In the results, focus on the scaling fits, mixture comparisons, and compute-allocation discussion. The particle-physics details can be read lightly unless you need to evaluate whether the claimed diversity and alignment variables are well controlled.

recommendation.zh: 数据组成可改变scaling幂律斜率的结论对LLM数据配比设计有直接参考，重点看数据组成调控scaling的实验部分。
recommendation.en: The finding that data composition shifts scaling law exponents is directly relevant to LLM data mixture design; focus on the data-modulated scaling experiments.

paper.title: The Significance of Style Diversity in Annotation-Free Synthetic Data Generation
paper.abstract: Generating high-utility synthetic data for intent classification typically requires human-annotated seed data, which is often unavailable in fast-paced industrial settings. In this paper, we propose a framework for synthetic dialogue generation that works entirely without human-annotated data, relying solely on intent definitions. Our proposed dialogue generation framework utilizes two different types of topic and style attributes to improve data diversity. Also, we propose two novel post-hoc st

summary.core_problem: 在没有人工标注种子数据的情况下，如何仅凭 intent 定义生成足够有用的合成对话数据，并提升其风格多样性与训练价值。
summary.importance: 这是一篇合成训练数据工作，虽然面向 intent classification 而非基座预训练，但对后训练数据合成有一个可迁移的点：风格多样性可能比主题多样性更影响数据效用。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 annotation-free 的对话生成框架，只使用 intent definitions 生成样本；在生成时显式控制 topic 和 style 两类属性，并设计两个事后风格化模型 Univ 与 Exam，把 LLM 生成的 utterance 改写成更丰富、更接近人类的表达；最后用 LLM-as-a-judge 做质量过滤。
summary.experiments: 在工业和公开数据集上，合成数据训练得到的模型性能可达到人工标注训练数据的 93.3%。核心经验结论是 style diversity 比 topic diversity 更关键。摘要未给出底座模型规模、过滤成本或 judge 误差分析，因此结论更适合作为弱先验，而非直接照搬。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to generate useful synthetic dialogue data from intent definitions alone, without any human-annotated seed data, while preserving enough diversity to train downstream models well.
summary_en.importance: This is a synthetic training-data paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it offers one transferable lesson for post-training data generation: stylistic diversity may matter more than topical diversity for utility.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework generates dialogues using only intent definitions, explicitly modeling both topic and style attributes. It then applies two post-hoc stylization models, Univ and Exam, to rewrite LLM-generated utterances into more varied and human-like styles, followed by LLM-as-a-judge filtering for quality control.
summary_en.experiments: On industrial and public datasets, the resulting synthetic data reaches up to 93.3% of the performance obtained with human-annotated training data. The main empirical claim is that style diversity is more important than topic diversity. The abstract does not provide enough detail on model scale, filtering cost, or judge reliability, so the result should be treated as a useful hint rather than a settled recipe.

recommendation.zh: 增量型合成数据论文，但“style diversity 比 topic diversity 更值钱”这个结论值得记下；只看消融和过滤策略，别把任务结果当通用规律。
recommendation.en: Incremental synthetic-data work, but the claim that style diversity matters more than topic diversity is worth pocketing; read the ablations, not the task score.

paper.title: Critical Percolation as a Synthetic Data Model for Interpretability
paper.abstract: Neural networks learn features that reflect the hierarchical, multi-scale structure of natural data. Synthetic datasets used to evaluate interpretability methods typically lack this structure, limiting their value as realistic toy models. To close this gap, we introduce a family of synthetic datasets consisting of hierarchical functions defined on critical mean-field percolation clusters embedded in a high-dimensional data space. The percolation data consists of sparse, low-dimensional fractal c

summary.core_problem: 现有可解释性 toy dataset 往往缺少自然数据常见的层级、多尺度结构，导致方法在玩具环境中的结论很难外推到真实神经网络表征。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析侧的数据建模工作，贡献不在提出新的解释方法，而在构造一个更接近真实数据统计结构、同时又可解析的合成数据分布，供 interpretability 研究做更干净的受控实验。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出基于临界平均场渗流簇的合成数据族：数据点分布在稀疏、低维、分形结构的高维簇上，簇大小服从幂律分布；标签由带分类层级的潜变量生成。方法上利用渗流簇、随机树与 additive coalescence 的对应关系，设计近线性时间的联合采样算法，同时采样随机树结构及其层级 latent decomposition。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模或标准 baseline 数字，重点更像是数据生成机制与理论可解析性，而非大规模神经网络 benchmark。可预期实验会围绕生成数据的统计性质、层级结构恢复、以及作为 interpretability testbed 的适用性展开，但从摘要看还不足以支持强经验结论。

summary_en.core_problem: Typical toy datasets for interpretability lack the hierarchical and multi-scale structure of natural data, so conclusions drawn from them often fail to transfer to realistic representation learning settings.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-oriented data-modeling paper. Its value is not a new interpretability method, but a more realistic yet analytically tractable synthetic distribution for controlled interpretability experiments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a family of synthetic datasets built from critical mean-field percolation clusters. Samples lie on sparse, low-dimensional fractal clusters in a high-dimensional space, with cluster sizes following a power law. Labels are generated by latent variables with a taxonomic hierarchy. Using a mapping among percolation clusters, random trees, and additive coalescence, the authors derive an almost linear-time joint sampler for both the random tree and its hierarchical latent decomposition.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scales, benchmark baselines, or headline quantitative gains. The emphasis appears to be on the statistical properties and analytical tractability of the data model rather than large-scale neural benchmarking. Any empirical value likely comes from showing that the generated data better supports interpretability studies than standard toy datasets.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但如果你做表征机制或想找更像自然数据的 toy setup，可先看数据构造；没有大规模训练结论，不必深读。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining material, but worth knowing if you care about representation probes or better toy worlds; read for the data model, not for training conclusions.

paper.title: Want Better Synthetic Data? Steer It: Activation Steering for Low-Resource Language Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become an effective tool for synthetic data generation, including for low-resource languages, where generated data can improve downstream task performance. Current best-performing approaches typically rely on few-shot prompting with target-language examples, which increases inference costs and may reduce diversity through lexical anchoring. In this work, we investigate activation steering as an alternative for low-resource synthetic data generation. We study two

summary.core_problem: 解决低资源语言合成数据生成依赖 few-shot 示例、成本较高且容易被示例词汇锚定的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 activation steering 的应用分析。它与预训练数据没有直接关系，但对控制 LLM 生成分布、语言身份向量和质量向量的可迁移性有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 研究两类 steering：Language Steering 通过激活方向增强目标语言身份；Quality Steering 通过对比人工文本与回译文本的表示来捕捉文本良构性。方法在 zero-shot 和 few-shot prompt 下都施加 steering，并比较不同开源 LLM、层位置和语言类型。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 4 个开源 LLM、11 种类型差异较大的低资源语言，生成情感分类和主题分类数据，再微调小分类器评估下游效果。摘要未给出具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies 与 DFKI。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to generate synthetic data for low-resource languages without relying heavily on few-shot target-language examples.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an application-oriented analysis of activation steering. It is not pretraining-data work, but it gives a useful signal about controllable generation, language identity directions, and quality directions.
summary_en.technical_approach: It evaluates two steering strategies: Language Steering, which targets linguistic identity, and Quality Steering, which contrasts human-written text with backtranslated text to capture well-formedness. Steering is tested under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers four open-source LLMs and 11 typologically diverse languages. It generates sentiment and topic classification data, then trains smaller classifiers for downstream evaluation. The abstract does not report exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies and DFKI.

recommendation.zh: 作为 activation steering 备查即可；任务太下游，真正有用的是层位置和语言方向的消融。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an activation-steering reference; the task is downstream, and the useful bits are the layer and language-direction ablations.

institutions: German Research Institute for Artificial Intelligence
Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies, Bratislava, Slovakia
German Research Institute for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI), Saarbrücken

paper.title: Phantoms and Disclosures: a Causal Framework for Auditing Synthetic Data
paper.abstract: The rapid adoption of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) has spurred interest in synthetic data as a privacy-preserving alternative to sensitive real-world datasets. However, generating high-utility synthetic data often carries the risk of memorizing and regurgitating private information from the training corpus. In this work, we present a customizable empirical auditing framework designed to detect and explain such data disclosures. Our framework introduces a mechanism to distinguis

summary.core_problem: 现有合成数据隐私审计方法无法区分“模型真实记忆并泄露训练集中的隐私信息”和“模型偶然生成与用户数据重合的内容（幻影泄露）”，假阳性率高，无法支撑合成数据的合规使用。
summary.importance: 提出黑盒条件下的因果审计框架，不需要模型访问权限、不需要插入金丝雀样本，即可严格区分真实泄露和幻影泄露，为合成数据在预训练中的合规使用提供实用检测方法。
summary.technical_approach: 基于因果统计检验框架，将原始数据划分为训练成员集和保留集，通过比较合成数据中样本在两个集合上的出现率，对比零学习基线与差分隐私界，判定观测到的重合来自记忆泄露还是随机生成，支持自定义隐私阈值。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、数据集规模与定量对比结果，方法从统计原理上保证假阳性率可控，可适配零学习、差分隐私等不同隐私基线。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自Google Research，包括长期从事隐私算法、合成数据与数据科学研究的Sergei Vassilvitskii、Kareem Amin等研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing synthetic data privacy auditing methods cannot distinguish true disclosures (memorized training data regurgitation) from phantom disclosures (coincidentally generated content matching user records), leading to high false positive rates that block compliant synthetic data use.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a black-box causal auditing framework requiring no model access or canary insertions to rigorously separate true disclosures from phantom matches, providing a practical detection method for compliant synthetic data use in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds on causal statistical testing that splits source data into training and holdout sets. By comparing the rate at which synthetic samples appear in the two sets against strict baselines (zero-learning, differential privacy bounds), the framework classifies matches as memorization or random generation, with support for custom privacy thresholds.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scales, dataset sizes, or quantitative comparisons are disclosed in the abstract; the method provides statistical guarantees on false positive rates and adapts to multiple privacy baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The team is from Google Research, including Sergei Vassilvitskii and Kareem Amin, who hold long-standing expertise in privacy algorithms, synthetic data, and data science.

recommendation.zh: 做预训练合成数据合规与清洗的团队值得读方法部分，可显著降低隐私审计假阳性，减少不必要的数据损失。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for teams building pretraining synthetic data pipelines; it meaningfully reduces privacy audit false positives and avoids unnecessary data pruning.

paper.title: State-Grounded Multi-Agent Synthetic Data Generation for Tool-Augmented LLMs
paper.abstract: Training tool-augmented LLM agents requires large corpora of multi-turn, tool-grounded conversational data that is expensive to annotate, privacy-constrained in production settings, and largely absent from public datasets. We present StateGen, a synthetic data generation platform that produces scored, reasoning-trace-rich training conversations by orchestrating a four-role LLM loop: a persona-conditioned user simulator, an agent under test, a state-grounded tool simulator, and a multi-axis LLM j

summary.core_problem: 训练工具增强 LLM agent 需要大量多轮、工具接地的对话数据，但标注昂贵、存在隐私限制且公开数据集稀缺。
summary.importance: 方法创新 + 系统创新：提出 StateGen 合成数据平台，通过四角色 LLM 循环（用户模拟器、被测 agent、状态接地工具模拟器、多轴 LLM 评审）自动生成带推理轨迹的高质量训练对话；核心创新是权威状态管理器消除工具调用幻觉。
summary.technical_approach: 核心架构：权威状态管理器维护跨轮结构化 world-state 对象，强制后端即事实不变式；四角色 LLM 循环：人格条件用户模拟器 + 被测 agent + 状态接地工具模拟器 + 多轴 LLM 评审；天然支持多 agent 层级扩展（子 agent 声明为工具，共享单一状态对象）。
summary.experiments: 在 3 个生产语料上评估 64,698 轮对话；工具调用幻觉分数大幅降低；但未提供具体基线对比数值或 SOTA 结论（摘要中未详述）。
summary.authors_note: 未明确列出机构；从作者名看可能涉及业界研究团队，但无法确认具体知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Training tool-augmented LLM agents requires large multi-turn, tool-grounded conversational data, which is expensive to annotate, privacy-constrained in production, and largely absent from public datasets.
summary_en.importance: Methodological + system innovation: presents StateGen, a synthetic data generation platform that produces scored, reasoning-trace-rich training conversations via a four-role LLM loop; key innovation is the authoritative state manager that eliminates tool-call hallucinations by construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: Core architecture: an authoritative state manager maintains a structured world-state object across turns, enforcing a backend-is-truth invariant; four-role LLM loop: persona-conditioned user simulator + agent under test + state-grounded tool simulator + multi-axis LLM judge; naturally extends to hierarchical multi-agent settings by declaring sub-agents as tools sharing a single state object.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 64,698 conversations across three production corpora; tool-call hallucination scores substantially reduced; specific baseline comparison numbers or SOTA claims not detailed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions not explicitly listed; likely involves industry research teams, but no well-known authors identifiable from given information

recommendation.zh: 状态管理器消除工具幻觉的设计思路对后训练数据合成有启发，特别是结构化 world-state 强制一致性；建议看 §3 的架构细节。
recommendation.en: The state-manager design eliminating tool hallucinations is instructive for post-training data synthesis, especially the structured world-state enforcing consistency; suggested to read §3 architecture details.

paper.title: When Sample Selection Bias Precipitates Model Collapse
paper.abstract: The proliferation of recursive training on synthetic data can alleviate data scarcity but risks model collapse, where repeated training erodes distributional tails and homogenizes outputs. Data selection is widely viewed as a remedy, yet its reliability depends critically on the reference distribution used by the verifier. We show that in low-resource verification regimes, where each verifier observes only a small, fragmented, and biased slice of the target manifold, selection itself becomes bia

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的不是一般意义上的“合成数据会导致模型坍塌”，而是更具体也更现实的问题：当递归训练依赖数据选择来过滤合成样本时，如果验证器只能看到局部、稀缺、带偏的数据切片，那么“选择”本身会变成新的偏置来源。论文把场景放在数据孤岛和低资源机构上，例如医院、银行、联盟式协作环境。这里各方都不能共享原始数据，只能用本地参考分布去打分和筛选模型生成样本。问题在于，本地参考分布并不覆盖全局流形，结果是筛选机制会系统性保留贴近本地模式的样本，持续丢弃尾部和跨域模式。这样一来，原本被视为缓解 model collapse 的 sample selection，反而会加速多样性收缩，并把递归训练推向更强的分布偏移。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“数据选择能否拯救递归合成训练”这个问题从理想 oracle 设定拉回到真实训练基础设施约束下，指出选择器的参考分布质量本身就是一阶变量。很多关于 synthetic data 的讨论默认 verifier 足够接近真实分布，这篇工作说明在低资源和分布碎片化条件下，这个前提并不成立。第二，它把 model collapse 的成因从“生成器误差累积”扩展到“选择器偏差累积”，这对合成数据用于 continual pretrain、domain adaptation、联盟式训练都很关键。第三，它给出了一条不交换原始数据的缓解路径：用 Wasserstein 几何构造跨 silo 的代理参考分布。这个贡献不是简单工程补丁，而是在训练数据治理层面提出了一个可分析、可协作的机制。量级上，它更像是对 synthetic pretraining pipeline 的风险建模与修正框架，而不是单点提分方法。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上，论文先把递归训练分成 replace、accumulate 和 selection 三类范式，并把分析重点放在 selection。前两类是已有文献常见设定：replace 只用新一轮合成数据，已知会快速坍塌；accumulate 把历史真实数据持续保留，能避免方差发散，但在很多低资源场景里真实数据规模太小，后续仍会被大量合成数据主导。论文关心的是更常见也更被寄予希望的 selection：每一轮先生成候选合成样本，再用 verifier 选出“高质量”子集用于下一轮训练。

核心创新在于把 verifier 的参考分布显式建模为局部流形上的偏置观测，而不是全局真分布的近似。理论部分给出的直觉是：如果选择分数由某个 silo 的局部参考集决定，那么样本被保留的概率会随其与该局部流形的接近程度上升。这样，selection operator 不再是去噪器，而是一个带方向性的投影，会反复压缩全局分布的支撑集。论文进一步说明，这种压缩不是偶然现象，而会在递归迭代中以幂律速度导致多样性衰减和 Wasserstein 距离恶化。也就是说，selection bias 会被训练闭环放大。

为缓解这个问题，作者提出协作式 verifier 框架。关键约束是不共享原始数据，因此不能直接做 pooled verification。论文利用 Wasserstein geometry 在各 silo 的经验分布之间构造代理参考：一种是 geodesic interpolation，即在两个或多个局部分布之间沿最优传输路径做插值；另一种是 Wasserstein barycenter，即求多个局部分布的几何中心。然后用这些代理分布替代单一 silo 的本地参考，对合成样本进行联合打分或筛选。这样做的理由很明确：如果单个 verifier 只能看到局部切片，那么就需要一个不暴露原始样本、但能在分布层面整合多方信息的参考对象。与直接平均特征、参数平均或简单投票不同，Wasserstein 代理保留了分布几何结构，尤其适合分析尾部覆盖和模式迁移。论文还讨论了理论上若 verifier 能访问全局 ground truth，selection 可以恢复为有效稳定器，但这在目标场景下不可行，因此协作代理是现实替代方案。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验的目标不是追求通用 benchmark 上的绝对分数，而是验证三件事：局部选择偏置是否会系统性诱发 collapse；这种退化是否会随递归轮数累积；协作式代理参考能否缓解。实验部分重点看 Section 6。作者构造了低资源、多 silo 的递归训练环境，对比 no selection、local selection、global-reference selection，以及基于 geodesic / barycenter 的 collaborative selection。

关键观察有几类。第一，local selection 虽然短期内能提高样本“看起来像本地数据”的一致性，但会更快损失全局多样性，表现为分布方差收缩、尾部模式消失、与真实全局分布的 Wasserstein 距离增大。第二，这种退化不是一次性的，而是随着 generation 递推持续放大，符合理论部分给出的 asymptotic power-law collapse。第三，若用全局参考做选择，collapse 明显减轻，说明问题不在 selection 这个动作本身，而在 reference distribution 的覆盖不足。第四，在不能共享原始数据的前提下，Wasserstein geodesic 和 barycenter 代理都能显著优于单 silo 选择，尤其在 silo 间分布异质性较强时更明显。

摘要里没有给出完整数字，提供的全文片段也未包含全部表格，因此这里不虚构具体百分点或样本规模。精读时应直接核对 Section 6 的主表、递归轮次曲线、Wasserstein 距离与方差变化图，以及不同 silo 数量、资源规模、异质性强度下的消融。真正有价值的不是单个终点指标，而是 collapse trajectory 的形状变化：local verifier 往往在早期看似稳定，后期却更快进入模式收缩；协作代理则主要改善尾部保留和长期稳定性。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题设定—理论机制—缓解方法—实验验证”四步读。

第一步看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries。重点不是背景铺陈，而是作者如何重新定义问题：selection 不是天然安全，安全性取决于 verifier 的参考分布。这里要把 replace、accumulate、selection 三种递归范式区分清楚，因为后面的理论结论都建立在这个划分上。

第二步精读 Section 3。这里是全文最关键的部分。要看清作者如何把 local prior 导致的 biased filter 形式化，以及为什么这种偏置会在递归训练中表现为 diversity contraction。尤其关注 Subsection 3.2 关于幂律收缩的推导和假设条件：哪些结论依赖低资源、哪些依赖分布碎片化、哪些依赖选择规则的单调性。

第三步看 Section 4 的 Wasserstein 协作框架。重点不是公式推导本身，而是理解为什么选 geodesic interpolation 和 barycenter，而不是更简单的 pooled statistics 或 ensemble voting。这里值得深挖的是：代理分布到底在多大程度上恢复了全局流形；它缓解的是均值偏差、支撑集缺失，还是尾部质量不足。

第四步看 Section 6 实验。优先看递归轮次上的动态曲线，而不是只看最终一轮。重点图表通常会展示 variance、Wasserstein distance、diversity coverage、不同 silo 异质性下的表现。若时间有限，先看 local vs collaborative vs global-reference 三组对比，再看 geodesic 与 barycenter 的差异。

这篇论文值得深挖的点有两个。一个是它把 verifier 质量问题前置了，这对用 reward model、judge model、过滤器做合成数据清洗也有直接启发。另一个是它把分布协作放在数据层而不是参数层，这和联邦学习里常见的参数聚合是不同思路，适合继续追问：能否推广到 tokenizer 级别、语义嵌入级别，或更高维的文本生成分布。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a more specific failure mode than the usual “synthetic data causes model collapse” story. Its target is recursive training with sample selection, under the realistic condition that the verifier only has access to a small, biased, local slice of the target distribution. This happens naturally in data silos such as hospitals, banks, or privacy-constrained consortia, where raw data cannot be pooled. In that setting, selection is no longer an unbiased quality filter. It becomes a local-prior amplifier: synthetic samples that align with the silo’s own manifold are retained, while globally valid but locally rare modes are discarded. Repeating this loop shrinks diversity, erodes tails, and pushes the model toward collapse even when selection was intended as the safeguard.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is threefold. First, it challenges the common assumption that sample selection can stabilize recursive synthetic training as long as one filters aggressively enough. The paper shows that the reference distribution behind the verifier is itself a first-order variable. Second, it extends the collapse discussion from generator error accumulation to selector bias accumulation. That matters for synthetic pretraining, continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and federated or siloed training pipelines. Third, it proposes a concrete mitigation path that does not require raw-data sharing: constructing collaborative proxy references with Wasserstein geometry. This is less about squeezing out benchmark gains and more about correcting a structural weakness in synthetic-data training loops.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper starts by separating recursive training into three paradigms: replace, accumulate, and selection. Replace uses only newly generated synthetic data and is already known to collapse quickly. Accumulate keeps the original real data and appends later generations, which can prevent variance blow-up in theory, but in low-resource settings the real seed set is often too small to dominate later synthetic rounds. The main focus is selection: generate a candidate synthetic pool, score it with a verifier, and keep only the “good” subset for the next round.

The key move is to model the verifier’s reference distribution explicitly as a biased local observation rather than an approximation to the global truth. Under this view, the selection operator is not a denoiser. It is a directional projection toward the local manifold. Samples are retained in proportion to how well they match the silo’s own support, so repeated selection trims away globally important but locally underrepresented regions. The paper argues that this is not a transient artifact. In recursive training, the bias compounds and drives diversity contraction at an asymptotic power-law rate, with worsening Wasserstein distance to the true global distribution.

To mitigate this, the authors propose a collaborative verifier framework under a no-raw-data-sharing constraint. Instead of pooled verification, they build proxy reference distributions across silos using Wasserstein geometry. Two constructions are emphasized: geodesic interpolations between local empirical distributions, and Wasserstein barycenters across multiple silos. These proxies are then used as collective references for scoring synthetic samples. The design choice is important. Simple feature averaging, parameter averaging, or majority voting would not preserve distributional geometry well enough, especially for tail coverage and mode structure. Wasserstein proxies are intended to recover a more faithful global reference at the distribution level while respecting silo boundaries. The paper also notes that access to the true global distribution would theoretically fix the problem, but that option is unavailable in the target regime, which is why collaborative proxies matter.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are designed to validate mechanism rather than to chase a single downstream score. Section 6 is the main place to read. The setup simulates low-resource recursive training with multiple silos and compares no selection, local selection, global-reference selection, and collaborative selection based on geodesic or barycenter proxies.

The main findings are consistent with the theory. Local selection can improve short-term alignment with the silo’s own data, but it accelerates global diversity loss: variance contracts, tail modes disappear, and Wasserstein distance to the true distribution grows. This degradation compounds across generations rather than appearing as a one-off effect, matching the paper’s power-law collapse analysis. When selection is performed against a global reference, collapse is much weaker, which isolates the real issue: not selection per se, but insufficient reference coverage. Under the realistic no-sharing constraint, both Wasserstein geodesic and barycenter proxies outperform single-silo selection, with larger gains when silo heterogeneity is stronger.

The abstract and the provided full-text excerpt do not expose all numeric tables, so it would be wrong to invent exact percentages or dataset sizes here. The right way to read the results is to inspect the main tables and generation-wise curves in Section 6: Wasserstein distance, variance evolution, diversity coverage, and ablations over silo count, resource level, and heterogeneity. The most informative signal is the trajectory shape over recursive rounds. Local verification often looks acceptable early on, then collapses faster later; collaborative proxies mainly help by preserving tails and improving long-horizon stability.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in four passes: setup, mechanism, mitigation, validation.

Start with the Introduction and Preliminaries. The important point is not the generic model-collapse background, but the paper’s reframing: selection is only as good as the reference distribution behind the verifier. Keep the replace / accumulate / selection distinction clear, because the later claims depend on it.

Then read Section 3 carefully. This is the conceptual center of the paper. Focus on how the authors formalize local-prior-driven biased filtering, and why that bias becomes diversity contraction under recursion. Subsection 3.2 is especially important because it links the selection bias to asymptotic power-law collapse. Pay attention to which assumptions are doing the work: low-resource verification, fragmented support, and the monotonicity of the selection rule.

Next, read Section 4 on the Wasserstein collaborative framework. The key question is not the algebra itself, but why geodesic interpolation and barycenters are the right objects here, instead of simpler pooled statistics or ensemble voting. The interesting technical issue is what exactly the proxy restores: mean location, support coverage, tail mass, or all three.

Finally, read Section 6 with an eye on dynamics rather than endpoint scores. Prioritize the generation-wise plots for variance, Wasserstein distance, and diversity coverage. If time is limited, first compare local selection, collaborative selection, and global-reference selection; then look at the difference between geodesic and barycenter proxies.

Two follow-up questions are worth carrying forward. One is whether the same verifier-bias logic applies to judge models, reward models, and synthetic-data filters used in modern post-training loops. The other is whether distribution-level collaboration can be extended beyond raw data distributions to tokenization space, embedding space, or text-generation manifolds.

recommendation.zh: 把“数据筛选能防崩塌”这个直觉打了个洞：参考分布不全时筛选会系统性杀尾部；建议复现其toy设定检验自家过滤管线。
recommendation.en: Pokes a real hole in the “filtering prevents collapse” intuition: with incomplete reference distributions, selection kills tails systematically—worth reproducing the toy regime against your filtering pipeline.

paper.title: VeriGeo: Controllable Geometry Question Generation with Numerical and Analytical Verification
paper.abstract: Geometry problem generation is useful for AI-assisted education and multimodal mathematical reasoning, but reliable synthesis remains difficult because the problem statement, diagram, constraints, and solution should be mutually consistent. Existing methods often trade off controllability and reliability: seed-based rewriting is flexible but weakly verifiable, whereas diagram-first construction improves validity but is less suited to arbitrary user-specified constraints.
