summary.core_problem: 如何在保证几何问题陈述、图表、约束和解答相互一致的前提下，可控地生成高质量的几何问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于可执行推理轨迹的几何问题生成框架，解决了现有方法在可控性和可靠性之间的权衡问题，有助于构建高质量的多模态数学推理合成数据。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 VeriGeo 框架，包含 Author 和 Solver 两个 Agent。Author 根据用户约束生成问题和图表，Solver 生成对齐的解答。两者共享一个动作序列，连接自然语言、图表、几何约束和证明步骤。采用三阶段 pipeline 进行数值一致性、分析可实现性和全局一致性验证。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体实验细节，但强调了三阶段验证 pipeline 的作用。
summary.authors_note: Yingce Xia 是微软亚洲研究院（MSRA）的知名研究员，在自然语言处理和机器翻译领域有丰富经验。

summary_en.core_problem: How to controllably generate high-quality geometry problems while ensuring mutual consistency among the problem statement, diagram, constraints, and solution?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a geometry problem generation framework grounded in executable reasoning traces, addressing the trade-off between controllability and reliability in existing methods, which is useful for constructing high-quality synthetic data for multimodal mathematical reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the VeriGeo framework, comprising an Author and a Solver agent. The Author generates the problem and diagram based on user constraints, while the Solver produces an aligned solution. Both share an action sequence connecting natural language, diagrams, geometric constraints, and proof steps. Employs a three-stage pipeline for numerical consistency, analytical realizability, and global consistency verification.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental details are not provided in the abstract, but the role of the three-stage verification pipeline is emphasized.
summary_en.authors_note: Yingce Xia is a well-known researcher at Microsoft Research Asia (MSRA) with extensive experience in NLP and machine translation.

recommendation.zh: 一种用于合成多模态数学（几何）推理数据的 Agent 框架，对于关注高质量合成数据构建（用于 post-train）的研究员有一定参考价值，但核心是数据合成 pipeline 而非预训练本身。
recommendation.en: An Agent framework for synthesizing multimodal mathematical (geometry) reasoning data, offering some reference value for researchers focused on high-quality synthetic data construction (for post-train), but the core is a data synthesis pipeline rather than pre-training itself.

paper.title: Multi-Turn Reasoning When Context Arrives in Pieces: Scalable Sharding and Memory-Augmented RL
paper.abstract: When a user reveals task-critical information across several conversation turns, LLM accuracy drops by up to 65% despite full context availability. We show that this Lost in Conversation degradation can be substantially mitigated by training models to maintain a compact rolling memory instead of attending to a growing history. To make such training scalable, we introduce a low-cost sharding pipeline that converts single-turn QA datasets into multi-turn fragmented-information episodes, eliminatin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多轮对话里信息分片到达时，模型明明已经见过全部关键信息，却仍然在最终求解时明显掉点的问题。作者把这个现象放在 Lost in Conversation 框架下，进一步指出两个更具体的训练瓶颈：一是现有多轮碎片化数据太贵，难以支撑 RLVR 规模训练；二是让模型始终依赖完整历史并不是一个稳健策略，因为历史越长，检索和整合越差，训练时也缺少一个明确的“跨轮压缩与保留”机制。论文想解决的不是普通长上下文 QA，而是增量式信息暴露下，模型如何在每一轮主动写出可持续使用的中间记忆，并靠最终可验证奖励把这种能力学出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的启发主要有三点。第一，它把“记忆写入”从 agent 工程技巧推进成了可训练的策略对象，而且证明这种对象可以只靠终局可验证奖励学出来，不需要中间记忆标注。第二，它给出了一条低成本数据构造路径：把单轮 QA 数据自动切成多轮信息碎片，从而把原本稀缺的多轮推理训练信号扩展到 RL 可用规模。这对 reasoning-oriented continual pretrain、mid-train、以及面向 agent 交互的 post-train 都有现实意义。第三，结果显示 memory-only 条件下训练出来的策略，不只是更省上下文，而且在 full-history 推理条件下也优于直接训练 full-history 的模型，说明“受限记忆”可能是一种更强的训练归纳偏置，而不只是推理时的压缩技巧。这一点对长上下文预训练、外显 scratchpad 设计、以及对话式 reasoning recipe 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成。第一部分是 sharding 数据管线。作者把 GSM8K、MATH500 这类单轮数学题，先用 LLM 按“最小逻辑单元”切分，再做完整性和非冗余校验，最后把核心问题单独抽出并在每一轮重复提供，而证据碎片按轮次逐步揭示。这样做的关键，不是简单随机切块，而是尽量保留原题的推理依赖结构，让模型必须跨轮累积信息。对 LongBench 这类文档 QA，则退回到按句边界对齐的固定长度 chunk，因为这类数据没有天然的离散推理单元。作者还构造了 Full-question 和 Mixed 两种变体：前者把完整问题随机放在某一 shard，其余位置塞入 Wikitext 噪声，测试模型是否只是在做相关内容识别；后者把逻辑分片和噪声交织，测试在干扰下的记忆提取能力。

第二部分是 memory-augmented RL。每一轮 t，策略接收问题 q、当前记忆 m_t 和新到达的 shard s_t，输出重写后的自然语言记忆 m_{t+1}。记忆长度上限固定为 256 token，故意不让模型把所有历史原样抄进去，而是逼它做选择性保留、压缩和整合。最后一轮只基于 q 和终态记忆 m_K 生成答案。训练上沿用 DAPO 风格的多轨迹 RLVR：每个样本采样 G=4 条轨迹，用规则验证器对最终答案给标量奖励，再做 group-relative advantage。一个重要设计是，作者不做中间 turn 级别 credit assignment，而是把同一条轨迹的优势统一传播到所有记忆更新步骤。理由是中间记忆的“正确写法”并不唯一，若强行监督某一轮该记什么，反而会把策略空间收窄。优化器层面使用 dual-clipped PPO surrogate，并按 token mean 聚合所有轮次损失，避免较长的记忆输出在梯度里占比过大；另加独立 KL 项约束策略漂移。对照组则是 full-history policy：每轮直接看累计聊天历史，不显式维护压缩记忆。评测时两类模型都在 memory 和 full-history 两种推理条件下测试，用来区分收益到底来自“训练结构”还是“推理时压缩”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两个模型尺度：Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-4B-Thinking，训练在 2×A100 上完成，每个 prompt 采样 4 条轨迹。核心结果有几层。

第一，LiC 掉点可以被大幅收回。引言给出的数字是，在 GSM8K 上最多可恢复 60 个点的 Lost in Conversation 性能损失，说明这不是边际修补，而是把“跨轮累积失败”变成了可训练能力。

第二，memory-trained policy 在所有评测条件下都超过 full-history baseline。这里最重要的不是 memory inference 优于 full-history inference，而是同一个 memory-trained 模型即便在推理时给它完整历史，也仍然优于专门按 full-history 训练的模型。这说明收益主要来自训练时被迫做信息筛选和状态更新，而不是单纯因为测试时上下文更短。

第三，泛化比任务表面形式更强。模型只在 sharded GSM8K 上训练，却能 zero-shot 迁移到更难的 MATH500，以及 out-of-domain 的 LongBench 长文档 QA。这个结果支持作者的判断：学到的不是某个数据集的题型模板，而是“如何把分步到达的信息压进有限状态并在终局取用”的策略。

第四，数据结构和噪声设置带来可解释消融。Sharded、Full-question、Mixed 三种训练集的比较，用来区分逻辑分解、相关内容识别、以及抗干扰能力各自的作用；MATH500 上插入 n∈{2,4} 个噪声 shard 的测试，则检查记忆策略在更长、更脏对话中的稳健性。虽然给出的全文片段没有列出全部表格数字，但实验设计本身很扎实，能回答“为什么 memory RL 有效”而不只是“它有效”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Method 的问题设定，再看实验主表和消融。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主线。

重点有四处。第一，看 sharding pipeline 的定义方式，尤其“最小逻辑单元”“问题重复暴露、证据逐步揭示”这两个设计，它们决定了训练信号是不是在逼模型做跨轮整合，而不是普通摘要。第二，看 memory state 的接口：每轮只传 q、m_t、s_t，且记忆上限 256 token，这里体现了作者想把记忆训练成受限状态机，而不是缩短版上下文。第三，看 advantage 如何统一传播到所有 turn，以及为什么不做中间监督；这是整篇里最有方法论意味的取舍。第四，看 memory-trained vs full-history-trained 在两种 inference condition 下的交叉评测，这组实验最能说明收益来自训练归纳偏置，而不是测试时 token 节省。

如果时间更少，只看三样：任务构造图、主结果表、Sharded/Full-question/Mixed 消融表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in multi-turn interaction: task-critical information arrives incrementally across turns, the model has technically seen all of it, yet final accuracy collapses. The authors frame this as Lost in Conversation, then sharpen the problem into two training bottlenecks. First, existing fragmented multi-turn datasets are too expensive to build for RL with verifiable rewards. Second, relying on full conversation history is a weak strategy because retrieval and integration degrade as history grows, and the model is never forced to learn an explicit cross-turn state update mechanism. The target is therefore not generic long-context QA, but learning how to write and rewrite a compact intermediate memory under delayed supervision.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model researchers is that it turns memory maintenance from an inference-time systems trick into a trainable policy. More importantly, the policy is learned from final verifiable reward only, without gold intermediate memories. That matters for the pretrain–posttrain interface: if multi-turn state tracking can be induced from cheap synthetic restructuring of single-turn corpora, then reasoning-oriented mid-training or RL stages can target a capability that standard next-token training does not isolate well. A second contribution is the data recipe itself: converting abundant single-turn QA into fragmented multi-turn episodes at low annotation cost. A third and more subtle point is the empirical result that memory-trained models beat full-history-trained baselines even when both are evaluated with full history. That suggests bounded memory is not merely a compression device at inference time; it acts as a stronger inductive bias during training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two components. The first is a sharding pipeline. For GSM8K and MATH500, an LLM decomposes each problem into minimal logical units, verifies completeness and non-redundancy, and withholds the core question from the shard sequence while repeating that question at every turn. Evidence is then revealed piece by piece. This is not random chunking: the goal is to preserve the dependency structure of the original reasoning problem so the model must accumulate state across turns. For LongBench QA, where such discrete reasoning units are less natural, the authors instead chunk documents into fixed-size sentence-aligned segments. They also build two ablation variants. Full-question places the full question in one random shard and fills the rest with Wikitext noise, testing whether the model is only learning relevance detection. Mixed interleaves logical shards with noise, testing robustness under distraction.

The second component is memory-augmented RL. At turn t, the policy receives the question q, current memory m_t, and incoming shard s_t, then generates a rewritten memory m_{t+1}. The memory is free-form natural language capped at 256 tokens, intentionally too small to copy the full history verbatim. At the final turn, the model answers using only q and the terminal memory m_K. Training extends the DAPO-style multi-conversation RLVR setup: for each sample, G=4 trajectories are sampled, a rule-based verifier scores only the final answer, and group-relative advantages are computed. A key design choice is to propagate the same trajectory-level advantage to all intermediate memory-writing steps rather than assigning turn-level credit. The rationale is that there is no unique correct intermediate memory, so direct supervision would overconstrain the policy. Optimization uses a dual-clipped PPO surrogate with token-mean aggregation across turns, preventing long memory outputs from dominating gradients, plus a separate KL penalty to limit policy drift. The main baseline is a full-history policy that sees the concatenated conversation history instead of an explicit compressed state. Both model families are evaluated under both memory-only and full-history inference conditions, which cleanly separates training effects from inference-time context compression.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use two model scales: Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B-Thinking, trained with 4 sampled trajectories per prompt on 2×A100 GPUs. Several findings stand out.

First, the Lost in Conversation degradation is substantially recoverable. The paper reports up to a 60-point recovery on GSM8K, which indicates that the failure is not an immutable consequence of fragmented context but a learnable deficiency in state maintenance.

Second, memory-trained policies outperform full-history baselines under every evaluation condition. The strongest evidence is the cross-condition result: a model trained with bounded memory still beats a model trained on full history even when both are given full history at test time. This argues that the gain comes from the training objective and state-update discipline, not simply from shorter inference context.

Third, the learned behavior transfers beyond the training domain. Models trained only on sharded GSM8K generalize zero-shot to the harder MATH500 benchmark and to out-of-domain LongBench QA. That supports the claim that the model is learning a reusable information-accumulation strategy rather than memorizing a dataset-specific format.

Fourth, the ablations are informative rather than cosmetic. Comparing Sharded, Full-question, and Mixed isolates the role of logical decomposition versus relevance filtering versus noise robustness. Additional MATH500 variants with n in {2, 4} inserted noise shards test whether the memory policy remains stable as conversations become longer and dirtier. The excerpt provided does not include all table values, but the experimental structure is strong enough to answer why the method works, not only whether it works.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim-level read, start with the problem setup in the introduction, then move to the memory interface and the main result tables. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough to capture the core idea.

There are four places worth focusing on. First, inspect how the sharding pipeline defines minimal logical units and why the question is repeated while evidence is fragmented; this is what turns the task into cross-turn accumulation rather than ordinary summarization. Second, look closely at the memory interface: each turn only gets q, m_t, and s_t, with a 256-token cap. That design reveals the intended inductive bias. Third, read the discussion around trajectory-level advantage propagation and the decision not to supervise intermediate memories. That is the most methodologically interesting choice in the paper. Fourth, examine the cross-evaluation matrix between memory-trained and full-history-trained models under both inference conditions. That is the cleanest evidence that the benefit comes from training structure rather than token savings at test time.

If time is limited, read the task construction figure, the main performance table, and the Sharded/Full-question/Mixed ablation table.

recommendation.zh: 只看 sharding pipeline 和 full-history 对照；若结果扎实，它会削弱“长上下文训练自然学会增量状态”的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the sharding pipeline and the full-history control; if solid, it weakens the prior that long-context training naturally teaches incremental state tracking.

paper.title: Valid Inference with Synthetic Data via Task Exchangeability
paper.abstract: There is a proliferation of work arguing for the use of synthetic data in scientific research. For example, social scientists are arguing for the use of LLM-generated "silicon samples" in pilot studies; AI evaluations increasingly rely on "LLM-as-a-judge" outputs; and proteomics research is accelerated by generative models that produce synthetic protein structures. These developments raise an intriguing possibility: synthetic data may help researchers ask more questions, run more studies, and ac

summary.core_problem: 给使用合成数据做科学推断的流程提供统计有效性条件，避免直接相信有偏或错设的生成模型输出。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是统计原则和有效性保证。它不直接解决 LLM 预训练数据生成，但对 LLM-as-a-judge、silicon samples、合成评测数据和用生成模型辅助研究的可靠性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心概念是 task exchangeability：如果研究者能找到带真实数据的历史任务，并且当前任务与这些历史任务在任务层面可交换，就可以用这些历史任务校准合成数据带来的偏差和不确定性。方法重点不是让生成模型更准，而是给出何时能用合成数据进行有效推断的条件。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论有效性保证，未给出具体实验设置、模型规模或数值结果。应用动机覆盖 LLM 生成的社会科学样本、LLM-as-a-judge 输出和生成式蛋白结构等合成数据场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when synthetic data can be used for valid scientific inference despite bias, noise, and model misspecification.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a statistical validity principle rather than an LLM training method. It is still relevant to synthetic evaluation data, LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, and model-generated scientific data where inference validity matters.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key condition is task exchangeability: the current task should be exchangeable with historical tasks for which real data exists. Under that condition, synthetic data can be calibrated or used in a way that preserves inferential guarantees, instead of assuming the generator is correct.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mainly highlights provable guarantees and motivating domains. It does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative improvements in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但 task exchangeability 是合成评测和 judge 数据校准的好警戒线；看定义即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but task exchangeability is a useful guardrail for synthetic evals and judge calibration; read the definition.

paper.title: Adaptive Turn-Taking for Real-time Multi-Party Voice Agents
paper.abstract: Turn-taking in multi-party spoken conversations remains a fundamental challenge for voice-based agents, particularly under dynamic floor competition and varying user expectations. We propose ModeratorLM, a role-playing voice agent that conditions turn-taking behavior on an explicitly assigned role in multi-party settings. The system is built on a speech large language model operating in chunk-wise streaming manner. We further introduce a reasoning-augmented variant that incorporates chain-of-tho

summary.core_problem: 在多人实时语音对话中，语音 agent 如何根据自身角色决定何时插话、让话或接管话轮。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是实时语音 agent 的系统与行为策略改进；对语音 LM 的交互层有参考价值，但核心不是语音 tokenizer、统一预训练或基础建模范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ModeratorLM，一个带显式角色条件的 role-playing voice agent，运行在 chunk-wise streaming 的 speech LLM 上；另有 reasoning-augmented 版本，基于对话上下文和分配角色进行 CoT 风格推理。论文还构造 RolePlayConv，大规模合成多人语音对话数据，覆盖多样 assistant roles。
summary.experiments: 在真实会议数据和 RolePlayConv 上评测，相比非角色条件 baseline，turn-taking precision 提升超过 40%，recall 提升超过 70%，并显著减少 false-positive interruptions。摘要未给出 speech LLM 参数量、延迟、音频 tokenization、合成数据规模和人工评估细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构标注为 Amazon AGI2IIT Kharagpur。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how a real-time multi-party voice agent should decide when to speak, yield, or take the floor based on its assigned role.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a system and behavior-policy improvement for real-time voice agents. It is relevant to the interaction layer of speech LMs, but it is not primarily about speech tokenization, unified pretraining, or a new foundation modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose ModeratorLM, a role-conditioned role-playing voice agent built on a chunk-wise streaming speech LLM. A reasoning-augmented variant adds chain-of-thought-style reasoning over conversational context and the assigned role. They also construct RolePlayConv, a large synthetic dataset of spoken multi-party conversations with diverse assistant roles.
summary_en.experiments: On real-world meeting data and RolePlayConv, the method improves turn-taking precision by over 40% and recall by over 70% over non-role-conditioned baselines, while reducing false-positive interruptions. The abstract does not specify the speech LLM size, latency, audio tokenization, synthetic data scale, or human evaluation protocol.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliation is Amazon AGI2IIT Kharagpur.

recommendation.zh: 语音 LM 方向可看方法图和实验表；pretrain 侧信号主要是角色条件数据如何改变 streaming 行为。
recommendation.en: For speech-LM work, skim the method diagram and tables; the pretraining signal is mostly how role-conditioned data changes streaming behavior.

paper.title: Which Models Are Our Models Built On? Auditing Invisible Dependencies in Modern LLMs
paper.abstract: Modern LLM training pipelines increasingly rely on other models to generate data, filter corpora, judge outputs, and guide development decisions. These dependencies are recursive: a model may depend on an upstream artifact whose own dependencies are documented only in separate releases and artifacts. As a result, the full dependency structure is fragmented across heterogeneous public artifacts, with complexity and recursive depth far outpacing humans' ability to trace. We introduce ModSleuth, an

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是模型训练算法本身，而是现代 LLM 研发流程里一个越来越严重、但常被低估的问题：模型并不是只依赖原始语料和初始化权重，而是依赖大量上游模型与数据资产，包括数据生成、重写、过滤、OCR、偏好标注、judge、reward model 等。这些依赖往往分散在技术报告、model card、代码仓库、数据集页面里，且具有递归性。作者要做的是从公开材料中重建这种多跳 dependency graph，并给出证据链，而不是停留在“谁蒸馏了谁”或“谁初始化自谁”的狭义 lineage。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“训练数据来源”扩展成“训练与开发依赖来源”，这比传统 data provenance 更贴近今天的大模型流水线。第二，它提醒做数据、评测和 post-train 的人：上游模型依赖会把 license、contamination、evaluation circularity 一起传下来，很多问题不是单跳可见的。第三，它提出了一个更适合现代 LLM 生态的 dependency formalization：不仅区分 direct 和 indirect dependency，还把 dependency 的作用方式显式标成 generation、filtering、rewriting、evaluation 等操作类型。对做预训练数据治理、合成数据审计、模型谱系分析的人，这个框架有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心不是训练一个新模型，而是定义“什么算依赖”并把它做成可递归执行的审计系统 ModSleuth。作者明确说，随着 Claude Code 这类 agentic system 出现，单纯的信息抽取已经不是主要瓶颈；更难的是语义判定和实体对齐。

具体有三块。第一块是 dependency formalization。作者把依赖分成 direct dependency 和 indirect dependency。前者指会实质影响下游模型权重或训练数据内容的上游资产，比如用于生成训练数据、重写语料、过滤样本、做 OCR、提供偏好标签或 reward signal 的模型/数据。后者则指影响开发决策但不直接进入训练的资产，比如评测 judge、开发时参考的外部模型等。这个区分很重要，因为它把“影响模型”与“进入训练闭环”分开了。

第二块是 operation-centered graph representation。传统 lineage 往往只记录 A built on B，但这里的边带有操作语义，例如 generation、filtering、rewriting、OCR、evaluation。这样做的好处是图不仅能回答是否有关联，还能回答通过什么机制发生影响。对于分析 contamination 或 license 传播，这种边类型信息比单纯 ancestry 更有用。

第三块是 identity lattice，用来解决公开文档中最麻烦的实体解析问题：同一个模型可能有 family name、checkpoint name、repo 名、内部代号、不同版本号，数据集也可能有派生版和镜像版。作者把这些异构引用统一到一个可递归解析的身份结构里，再由 agent 从论文、model card、repo、dataset page 等来源抽取证据，逐层扩展图谱。

从全文描述看，ModSleuth 的技术难点并不在 agent 调用本身，而在审计 schema 的设计：哪些边应保留，证据强度如何判定，模糊引用如何合并，递归到多深停止。这些设计决定了图谱是否既有覆盖率又不过度臆断。
summary.experiments:
实验结论很清楚：现代 LLM 的依赖链比公开讨论中通常假设的更深、更杂，也更递归。作者报告依赖链最长可达 8 hops，且依赖类型远不止初始化和训练数据复用，还包括 synthetic data generation、rewriting、annotation、OCR，以及这些辅助组件自身的训练数据来源。也就是说，一个下游模型可能通过多跳路径间接继承上游模型的语料、许可限制和污染风险。

论文还强调了几类实证发现。第一，公开材料之间存在明显 underreporting 和 inconsistency，例如论文、代码、model card 对同一依赖的描述不一致。第二，存在潜在的 license 或 terms-of-use 风险，因为某些模型生成数据或派生数据集的上游来源并未被完整披露。第三，evaluation bias 和 contamination 风险会沿递归路径传播，尤其当 judge model、synthetic data generator 和被评估模型共享祖先时，传统单跳 decontamination 很难发现问题。

作者还提到一个很有分量的观察：有些恢复出的依赖连原开发者都未必清楚。这说明问题不只是文档写得不认真，而是当前开发流程本身缺少能表达递归依赖的记录机制。

由于给出的全文片段没有完整实验表、case study 数量和精确审计指标，无法可靠复述覆盖了多少模型、人工核验精度是多少、不同边类型的抽取准确率如何。但从论文主线看，重点并不是 benchmark 分数，而是 formalization 加上若干有代表性的审计案例。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction，再看 Design of ModSleuth。前者定义问题边界，后者决定这篇文章是否只是一个 agent demo，还是一个可复用的审计框架。阅读时重点抓三件事：1）direct vs indirect dependency 的判定标准；2）operation-centered edge type 如何定义；3）identity lattice 如何处理模型家族、版本、repo 和数据集别名。

如果只想快速获取启发，优先看图 1 一类的案例图和几个代表性 case study，理解多跳依赖如何把 synthetic data、judge、OCR、filtering 串起来。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以读完主线。若要深挖，值得看作者如何处理证据冲突、缺失文档和模糊引用，因为这些问题决定系统在真实审计中的可信度。对做预训练数据治理的人，最值得思考的是：现有 model card 和 data card 为什么天然太“平”，无法表达递归依赖。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a growing but under-specified problem in modern LLM development: models are no longer shaped only by raw corpora and initialization, but by a web of upstream models and datasets used for generation, rewriting, filtering, OCR, preference labeling, judging, and other development stages. These dependencies are recursive and scattered across papers, model cards, repositories, and dataset pages. The goal is to reconstruct evidence-grounded multi-hop dependency graphs from public artifacts, going beyond narrow notions of lineage such as initialization ancestry or direct dataset reuse.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is mainly about governance and observability of the training pipeline. First, it expands provenance from 'where did the training data come from' to 'what upstream artifacts shaped the model and how.' That better matches current LLM pipelines. Second, it shows that license constraints, contamination, and evaluation circularity can propagate through recursive synthetic-data and model-based tooling chains, which matters for anyone working on data curation, synthetic pretraining data, or model-based evaluation. Third, it offers a dependency formalization that is more useful than flat disclosure templates: it distinguishes direct from indirect dependencies and labels the mechanism of influence, such as generation, filtering, rewriting, OCR, or evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is not a new training method but a recursive auditing system, ModSleuth, built around a stronger definition of dependency. The authors explicitly argue that with systems like Claude Code, raw information extraction is no longer the main bottleneck. The harder problems are semantic: deciding what counts as a dependency, and resolving references across inconsistent names, versions, repositories, and artifact families.

The first component is dependency formalization. The paper separates direct dependencies from indirect dependencies. Direct dependencies are upstream artifacts that materially affect downstream model weights or training data content, such as models used for synthetic data generation, rewriting, filtering, OCR, preference annotation, or reward modeling. Indirect dependencies influence development decisions without directly entering training, such as judge models used during evaluation or model selection. This distinction is useful because it separates influence on the training loop from broader influence on development.

The second component is an operation-centered graph representation. Instead of a generic 'built on' edge, ModSleuth attaches operation semantics to edges: generation, filtering, rewriting, OCR, evaluation, and so on. That makes the graph more informative for auditing contamination paths, license propagation, and evaluation bias.

The third component is an identity lattice for entity resolution. Public artifacts refer to the same model or dataset under family names, checkpoint names, repository names, internal aliases, and versioned releases. The identity lattice reconciles these heterogeneous references into a recursive graph construction process, while the agent gathers source-grounded evidence from papers, model cards, repositories, and dataset pages.

The real technical challenge is therefore schema design rather than agent orchestration: which edges to keep, how to score evidence strength, how to merge ambiguous references, and how far recursive tracing should proceed before confidence degrades.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is that modern LLM dependency chains are deeper, broader, and more recursive than standard public narratives suggest. The paper reports chains extending up to eight hops, and the recovered dependencies go far beyond initialization and direct dataset reuse. They include synthetic data generation, rewriting, annotation, OCR, and the training data of those auxiliary components themselves. In other words, a downstream model can inherit data, licensing constraints, and contamination risks through long indirect paths.

The paper also highlights several recurring findings. First, public artifacts often underreport or inconsistently describe dependencies across papers, code, and model cards. Second, there are potential license and terms-of-use issues because upstream sources behind generated or derived datasets are not always fully disclosed. Third, contamination and evaluation bias can propagate recursively, especially when judge models, synthetic data generators, and evaluated systems share ancestry. Standard one-hop decontamination procedures are poorly suited to this setting.

One notable observation is that some recovered dependencies were reportedly unknown even to original developers. That suggests the issue is not merely incomplete documentation by individuals, but a structural mismatch between current development practices and the recursive nature of modern model pipelines.

The provided text does not include full tables, dataset counts, or extraction metrics, so it is not possible to state exact coverage, precision, or benchmark numbers reliably. The paper’s center of gravity is the formalization plus representative audit cases rather than a conventional leaderboard result.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, read the Introduction and the Design of ModSleuth sections first. The introduction defines the problem sharply, and the design section determines whether this is just an agent demo or a reusable auditing framework. Focus on three things: 1) the criteria for direct versus indirect dependency, 2) how operation-centered edge types are defined, and 3) how the identity lattice resolves model families, versions, repositories, and dataset aliases.

If time is limited, prioritize the main case-study figures that show how synthetic data, judges, OCR systems, and filtering models connect through multi-hop paths. Around 25–35 minutes should be enough to capture the main contribution. For deeper reading, pay attention to how the system handles conflicting evidence, missing documentation, and ambiguous references, because those choices determine whether the recovered graphs are trustworthy enough for real auditing. For pretraining and data-governance readers, the most useful question is why existing model cards and data cards are too flat to represent recursive dependencies.

recommendation.zh: LLM供应链溯源的实用框架，做数据治理和合成数据溯源可参考，重点读§3的依赖定义部分。
recommendation.en: Practical LLM supply chain tracing framework; read §3 for dependency formalization if you work on data governance.

paper.title: CodeAlchemy: Synthetic Code Rewriting at Scale
paper.abstract: Pre-training on raw code teaches syntax but provides sparse signal for diverse real-world task formats. While synthetic data has proven transformative for language models, code remains largely unexplored beyond limited quality improvements. We present CodeAlchemy, a synthetic data generation framework that transforms publicly sourced code into semantically-rich training data through 5 strategies: CodeEnhance (quality-aware rewriting), CodeQA (template-based problems), CodeDev (developer tasks),

summary.core_problem: 代码预训练长期依赖原始仓库语料，能学到语法和局部模式，但对真实开发任务中的问答、重写、调试、执行跟踪等监督信号覆盖很弱，导致模型对“会写代码”之外的开发能力学习不足。
summary.importance: 这是一个以预训练数据为核心的工作，贡献不在新模型，而在大规模合成代码语料构造。它把公开代码转成多种语义更密集的训练格式，并把执行轨迹也纳入语料，属于代码领域较少见的“数据形态扩展”路线；对通用 LLM 研究员的价值在于：它提供了一个较完整的 synthetic pretraining recipe，说明代码数据不必只以 next-token 形式存在。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CodeAlchemy 框架，用 5 类策略把原始代码转成合成训练数据：CodeEnhance 做质量感知重写，CodeQA 生成模板化问题，CodeDev 构造开发者任务，CodeDialogue 生成多轮对话，CodeTrace 通过插桩和执行收集控制流、状态变化和库调用知识。数据覆盖 3 个语料源、15 种语言，总计 500B+ 合成 token，外加 350B reasoning token。方法上更像“程序化数据工厂”而不是单一生成器，重点是把静态代码转成多视角监督信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的实验规模较大：执行了 1.3M+ 文件，覆盖 14 种语言和 5K 库；并引入 DevEval 与 TraceEval 两个评测，分别测开发者任务和执行预测。摘要提到 frontier 模型在新 benchmark 上仍有明显不足，暗示这些数据形态确实触及现有代码模型的薄弱区。由于摘要截断，具体基线、模型尺寸和提升幅度未完全给出，但从定位看，重点应是验证不同合成数据子集对代码能力的增益，而不是追求单一榜单分数。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab 与 IBM Research。Rameswar Panda 长期活跃于 IBM 的多模态与高效学习方向；这篇工作代表的是工业研究团队在“合成数据扩展代码预训练”上的系统化尝试。

summary_en.core_problem: Code pretraining still relies heavily on raw repositories, which teach syntax and local patterns but provide sparse supervision for real developer-facing formats such as QA, rewriting, debugging, and execution tracing.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a pretraining-data paper rather than a modeling paper. Its contribution is a large-scale synthetic code data pipeline that converts public code into semantically denser training views, including execution traces. For foundation-model researchers, the useful signal is that code corpora need not stay in plain next-token form.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces CodeAlchemy, a synthetic data generation framework with five transformation strategies: CodeEnhance for quality-aware rewriting, CodeQA for templated problems, CodeDev for developer tasks, CodeDialogue for multi-turn conversations, and CodeTrace for instrumented execution traces capturing control flow, state changes, and library knowledge. It processes three corpora across 15 languages, producing 500B+ synthetic tokens plus 350B reasoning tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The reported scale is substantial: 1.3M+ files executed across 14 languages and 5K libraries. The paper also introduces DevEval and TraceEval to test developer tasks and execution prediction. The abstract suggests that even frontier models remain weak on these benchmarks, implying that the generated data targets real blind spots. The exact model sizes, baselines, and gains are not fully visible from the truncated abstract, but the experimental focus appears to be capability gains from richer synthetic pretraining views rather than leaderboard chasing.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab and IBM Research. Rameswar Panda is known for work in multimodal and efficient learning; this paper reflects a systematic industrial effort on synthetic data for code pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该当作“代码版数据炼丹术”来看：先看数据工厂设计和 Trace 部分，若你在做合成预训练数据，值得立刻对照内部 pipeline 补一轮多视角 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read this as a code-data factory paper, not a model paper: focus on the data transformations and the trace pipeline, then compare against your own synthetic pretraining stack with a clean ablation.

institutions: MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab, IBM Research

paper.title: Mix, Don't Pick: Why Synthetic Corpus Composition Matters for Time Series Foundation Model Pretraining
paper.abstract: Choosing the wrong synthetic generator for time-series foundation model pretraining is costly: under identical training budgets, the best and worst generators produce up to a $2\times$ gap in forecasting error, yet the field has no principled way to make this choice. The problem is compounded by the fact that generator rankings are not stable across architectures: across 11 generator families evaluated on Chronos-T5-Mini and Moirai-Small trained from scratch, we find that which generators are us

summary.core_problem: 时间序列基础模型预训练中合成数据生成器的选择缺乏原则性方法，且生成器排名在不同架构间不稳定
summary.importance: 数据贡献类，提出合成预训练是语料组合问题而非生成器选择问题；在相同训练预算下最优与最差生成器可产生高达2倍的预测误差差距
summary.technical_approach: 不解决生成器选择问题而是绕过它：简单等权重混合所有11个生成器家族，在Chronos-T5-Mini和Moirai-Small上均匹配或超越最优单一生成器；再与真实数据组合得到整体最强预训练语料
summary.experiments: 在Chronos-T5-Mini和Moirai-Small上从零训练，评估11个生成器家族；最优与最差生成器间预测误差差距高达2倍；等权重混合+真实数据组合效果最佳
summary.authors_note: Aaryan Nagpal, Debdeep Sanyal, Murari Mandal, Dhruv Kumar, Saurabh Deshpande（机构未明确）

summary_en.core_problem: No principled method exists for selecting synthetic data generators for time-series foundation model pretraining, and generator rankings are unstable across architectures
summary_en.importance: Data contribution; frames synthetic pretraining as a corpus composition problem rather than a generator selection problem; up to 2× gap in forecasting error between best and worst generators under identical training budget
summary_en.technical_approach: Sidesteps generator selection: a simple equal-weight mixture of all 11 generator families matches or beats the best individual generator on both Chronos-T5-Mini and Moirai-Small; composing this mixture with real data yields the strongest pretraining corpora
summary_en.experiments: Trained from scratch on Chronos-T5-Mini and Moirai-Small, evaluated 11 generator families; up to 2× forecasting error gap between best and worst generators; equal-weight mixture + real data composition achieves best overall results
summary_en.authors_note: Aaryan Nagpal, Debdeep Sanyal, Murari Mandal, Dhruv Kumar, Saurabh Deshpande (institutions not explicitly stated)

recommendation.zh: 时间序列领域的预训练数据策略研究，核心发现——等权重混合优于最优单一选择——与LLM数据mixture研究有类比，但领域差异大，仅作弱启发参考。
recommendation.en: Pretraining data strategy study in time-series domain; core finding — equal-weight mixture outperforms best single generator — has analogies to LLM data mixture research but domain differences limit transfer; weak heuristic reference only.

paper.title: SpectCount: Spectrotemporal Counting via Synthetic Signals Improves Large Audio Language Models
paper.abstract: Large audio language models (LALMs) extend large language models with an audio encoder and large-scale audio data. However, the scarcity of high-quality annotated audio data remains a fundamental bottleneck for scaling. Through probing signal detectability analysis, we identify fine-grained spectrotemporal perceptual weaknesses in a foundation LALM. To address these challenges, we propose Spectrotemporal Counting (SpectCount), a data-efficient fine-tuning approach based on fully synthetic audio

summary.core_problem: 解决大音频语言模型在高质量标注音频稀缺条件下，细粒度时频感知能力不足的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在于又做一个音频 benchmark，而在于提出一种弱点驱动的合成信号微调范式：不用真实音频、人工标注或预训练生成器，也能补齐基础模型的感知短板。对统一多模态预训练和数据合成都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先通过 probing signal detectability analysis 定位基础 LALM 的细粒度 spectrotemporal 弱点，再提出 SpectCount：在线生成全合成音频信号，以计数式、可控的时频结构任务进行数据高效微调。核心思想是用可解析、可控的合成刺激去定向修补模型感知盲区，而不是继续堆真实数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模和具体基线名称，但声称在一个 foundation LALM 上，SpectCount 不仅修复了探测到的时频弱点，还在声音、音乐、语音等多个未见过的听觉 benchmark 上带来泛化提升。若正文实验干净，这会是“合成 probing→定向补训”闭环的一个不错案例。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单中有 Nam Soo Kim，长期从事语音与音频建模。摘要无法确认更具体机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets fine-grained spectrotemporal weaknesses in large audio language models under the scarcity of high-quality annotated audio data.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not just another audio benchmark result. The interesting part is a weakness-targeted synthetic-signal finetuning paradigm: no real audio, no human annotations, and no pretrained generator, yet measurable gains on an audio foundation model. That is relevant to multimodal pretraining and synthetic data design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first use probing signal detectability analysis to identify spectrotemporal perceptual blind spots in a foundation LALM, then introduce SpectCount: an on-the-fly synthetic audio finetuning method built around controllable counting-style spectrotemporal signals. The key idea is to repair model weaknesses with analyzable synthetic stimuli rather than simply adding more real data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size or exact baselines, but claims that SpectCount both fixes the detected weaknesses and improves performance on diverse unseen auditory benchmarks spanning sound, music, and speech. If the full setup is clean, this is a useful closed-loop example of probing-to-targeted-remediation.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Nam Soo Kim, known for speech and audio modeling. The abstract alone does not confirm more detailed institutional context.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是方法论，不是分数：先用可控 probing 找盲点，再用纯合成刺激补训；做多模态 pretrain 的人应复现这条闭环。
recommendation.en: Read it for the methodology, not the benchmark numbers: probe the blind spot with controllable stimuli, then patch it with synthetic finetuning; that loop is worth porting to multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: In-Context Multiple Instance Learning
paper.abstract: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) addresses problems where supervision is available at the level of bags of instances and has been successfully applied in fields ranging from computational pathology to satellite imagery. Nevertheless, existing algorithms struggle in the low-label regime that characterizes many real-world applications. Flexible models overfit and rigid ones fail to adapt to the task at hand. We show that pretraining an in-context learner with a Perceiver-style architecture on synt

summary.core_problem: 解决多实例学习（MIL）在低标签数据场景下容易过拟合或无法适应新任务的问题。
summary.importance: 首次将上下文学习（In-Context Learning）引入多实例学习，通过在合成数据上预训练 Perceiver 架构，实现了在推理时无需梯度更新的 few-shot MIL 分类。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Perceiver 风格的架构作为上下文学习器，在多种合成的包结构数据生成器上进行预训练。推理时，模型通过单次前向传播处理包含少量标记包的上下文，直接对新包进行分类。
summary.experiments: 在 12 个 MIL 基准测试中，预训练模型在 few-shot 设置下取得了最佳平均性能，优于现有的 MIL 算法。
summary.authors_note: 柏林工业大学和 BIFOLD 团队工作，Klaus-Robert Müller 为知名机器学习学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing the issue of Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) algorithms overfitting or failing to adapt to new tasks in low-label data regimes.
summary_en.importance: Introduces In-Context Learning to Multiple Instance Learning for the first time, achieving few-shot MIL classification without gradient updates at inference by pretraining a Perceiver architecture on synthetic data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a Perceiver-style architecture as an in-context learner, pretrained on various synthetic bag-structured data generators. At inference, the model processes a context of a few labeled bags in a single forward pass to classify new bags.
summary_en.experiments: Achieved the best average performance across 12 MIL benchmarks in a few-shot setting, outperforming existing MIL algorithms.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from TU Berlin and BIFOLD, Klaus-Robert Müller is a renowned machine learning scholar.

recommendation.zh: 将 ICL 范式迁移到多实例学习（MIL）任务，证明了在合成数据上预训练可以泛化到真实 MIL 任务，作为 ICL 泛化能力的侧面印证可扫一眼。
recommendation.en: Transfers the ICL paradigm to Multiple Instance Learning (MIL), proving that pretraining on synthetic data generalizes to real MIL tasks; worth a glance as a side validation of ICL's generalization capability.

paper.title: Epidemiology of Model Collapse: Modeling Synthetic Data Contamination via Bilayer SIR Dynamics
paper.abstract: Training on synthetic data causes model collapse, but existing analyses treat this as single-chain degradation. In reality, the AI ecosystem involves cross-contamination: models ingest synthetic data from other models, produce new synthetic text, and contaminate shared corpora. We propose a bilayer coupled SIR/SIRS framework -- a phenomenological mean-field model treating data corpora and AI models as two interacting populations, each with susceptible, infected, and recovered compartments linked

summary.core_problem: 研究合成数据污染如何在开放模型生态中跨语料库和模型传播，并导致模型坍塌风险累积。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制建模和风险分析。它把模型坍塌从单模型递归退化问题扩展为生态系统级交叉污染问题，对预训练数据治理、合成数据过滤和持续预训练有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出双层耦合 SIR/SIRS 平均场模型，把数据语料和 AI 模型分别视为易感、感染、恢复群体，并用跨层传播项连接二者。主要推荐 SIRS 版本，因为过滤后的语料和重新训练后的模型仍可能再次暴露于合成数据污染。文中用 Next Generation Matrix 推导基本再生数 R0 = sqrt(β_D β_M / [(γ_D+μ_D)(γ_M+μ_M)])，并用流行病阈值判断污染是否进入超临界传播。
summary.experiments: 实验更接近情景校准而非训练实验。作者基于公开 AI 文本占比数据做示例性校准，并报告若干场景下 R0 大于 1，说明污染可能自我维持和扩散。没有给出真实大模型预训练中的可控消融，也没有验证具体过滤策略对下游模型质量的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how synthetic-data contamination can spread across shared corpora and model populations, creating ecosystem-level model-collapse risk.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a mechanistic risk model rather than a training method. It reframes model collapse from a single recursive training chain into a coupled contamination process, which is relevant to pretraining data governance, synthetic-data filtering, and continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author proposes a bilayer coupled SIR/SIRS mean-field model, with data corpora and AI models represented as interacting susceptible, infected, and recovered populations. The SIRS variant is preferred because filtered corpora and retrained models can lose protection and become contaminated again. The paper derives the reproduction number R0 = sqrt(β_D β_M / [(γ_D+μ_D)(γ_M+μ_M)]) using the Next Generation Matrix and applies epidemic threshold reasoning to the coupled system.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical component is scenario calibration, not large-scale model training. The paper uses public estimates of AI-generated text prevalence to illustrate supercritical regimes where R0 exceeds 1. It does not provide controlled pretraining ablations or direct measurements of filtering policies on model quality.

recommendation.zh: 可扫公式和假设；它提醒数据污染是生态反馈问题，但缺少真实训练闭环验证，别把 R0 当工程阈值用。
recommendation.en: Skim the equations and assumptions; it frames contamination as ecosystem feedback, but R0 is not yet an engineering threshold without training-loop validation.

paper.title: Synthetic Contrastive Reasoning for Multi-Table Q&A
paper.abstract: Multi-table question answering requires models to retrieve relevant evidence, link schemas, and perform compositional reasoning across relational tables. Existing multi-table Q&A resources typically provide questions and final answers but lack reasoning supervision that explains how answers are derived. To address this gap, we construct a synthetic contrastive reasoning-trace dataset for MMQA by generating validated positive traces and plausible negative traces with heterogeneous LLMs. We then u

summary.core_problem: 多表问答（multi-table QA）缺少可学习的“推理过程监督”：现有数据多给最终答案，不给可验证的推理轨迹，也缺少“看起来合理但其实错”的负例来做偏好学习，导致模型在 schema linking、join/过滤/聚合等组合推理上容易犯隐蔽错误。
summary.importance:
属于 post-train/数据合成范畴，对预训练的直接影响有限，但对“训练信号质量”很有代表性：
- 用可验证的正轨迹 + 可信的负轨迹构造偏好对，提供比纯 Q&A SFT 更强的学习信号；
- 通过“异构 LLM 生成正/负轨迹”增强对比度，减少模型只学到生成器风格或模板；
- 结果显示 CPO 在这类结构化推理任务上比 DPO 更稳，提示偏好优化目标函数的选择会显著影响可学习性。

如果你在做 reasoning 数据合成、RLAIF/偏好学习、或把结构化外部证据纳入训练闭环，这篇的工程细节（验证、过滤、负例构造）值得借鉴。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三块：合成正轨迹、合成负轨迹、用偏好优化训练。

1) 正轨迹（positive traces）：
- 用强模型（文中主要用 GPT-4o）对给定问题 + 多张表生成 step-by-step 推理轨迹。
- 轨迹格式被强约束为 markdown 表格（Step | Output），并要求每一步显式引用 TABLE1/TABLE2，减少“凭空推断”。
- 关键是“验证”：正轨迹必须能导出 gold answer。作者不靠字符串匹配，而用 LLM-as-judge 做语义一致性判定（文中提到使用 Gemini 2.0 Flash 作为 judge），以处理别名/格式差异。

2) 负轨迹（negative traces）：
- 生成“流畅且貌似合理，但包含事实/逻辑错误”的推理过程，作为偏好学习的反例。
- 重要设计：正负轨迹由异构 LLM 生成（不同模型负责不同角色）。作者声称消融显示：同一生成器同时产正负例会降低对比信号（更像风格差异或更容易被模型投机）。异构生成让负例更“像人类会犯的错”，也更难被简单风格特征区分。

3) 训练：Contrastive Preference Optimization (CPO)
- 用（正轨迹, 负轨迹）的偏好对对开源模型做偏好微调。
- 论文同时对比 DPO，结论是 CPO 在该设置下更优。

整体取舍：用合成轨迹换取规模与覆盖面，但必须投入验证与过滤，否则会把 hallucination 作为监督信号灌进去。作者用自动 judge + 人评校准来压这个风险。
summary.experiments:
模型：Qwen3-14B、Mistral-8B、Llama-3.1-8B。

主要结论（按文中给出的幅度）：
- 相比只做 Q&A SFT，使用偏好对做 CPO 带来平均绝对提升约 9.7%–16.3%。
- 在 MMQA 上，最大绝对提升可到 21 个百分点（相对 Q&A SFT）。
- 同样的偏好对上，CPO 优于 DPO。
- 只在两表数据上训练，收益可迁移到三表样例，说明学到的不是死记模板，而是一定程度的组合推理习惯。

数据与质量控制：作者报告做了自动与人工评估来检查轨迹可靠性与多样性，并对 LLM-as-judge 组件做了与人类标注的一致性验证（细节需要看实验与附录）。此外还构造了一个来自 BIRD 的新评测集：通过“全表证据抽取”保证答案可由给定表导出，并用自动语义一致性过滤 question–SQL 不对齐。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 35–50 分钟）：
- 先看“轨迹生成规则”和格式约束（显式引用表、markdown step 表格、避免复制整行），这是它能否稳定产出可学信号的关键。
- 重点看“正轨迹如何验证”“负轨迹如何构造”以及异构生成的消融；这部分决定数据是否真的提供了对比学习信号，而不是噪声。
- 直接看 CPO vs DPO vs Q&A SFT 的主表结果，以及跨数据集/跨表数迁移实验。
- 如果你关心可复用的数据管线，去看他们从 BIRD 构造新评测集的证据抽取与一致性过滤流程，里面有不少工程化细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-table QA lacks learnable reasoning supervision: most datasets provide only final answers, not verifiable reasoning traces, and they rarely include plausible-but-wrong rationales that are crucial for preference learning. As a result, models often fail silently on schema linking and compositional operations (joins/filters/aggregations).
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training / synthetic-data paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution. Its main value is as a concrete recipe for improving training signal quality: validated positive traces plus high-quality negative traces yield a stronger learning signal than plain Q&A SFT; using heterogeneous LLMs for positive vs negative generation increases contrast and reduces generator-style shortcuts; and the results suggest CPO can be more effective than DPO for this structured reasoning setting. If you work on reasoning data synthesis, RLAIF/preference tuning, or integrating external structured evidence into the training loop, the verification and filtering details are the part to steal.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The pipeline has three components: generate positive traces, generate negative traces, and train with preference optimization.

1) Positive traces:
- A strong model (primarily GPT-4o) generates step-by-step reasoning traces conditioned on the question and multiple tables.
- Output is tightly constrained: a markdown table of steps, and each step must explicitly reference which table (TABLE1/TABLE2) it uses, discouraging unsupported leaps.
- Positives are validated to lead to the gold answer. Instead of brittle string matching, they use an LLM judge for semantic equivalence (Gemini 2.0 Flash is mentioned) to handle formatting/alias variations.

2) Negative traces:
- Generate fluent, plausible rationales that contain factual or logical errors.
- Key design choice: positives and negatives are generated by heterogeneous LLMs. Their ablations reportedly show that using the same generator for both weakens the contrastive signal and makes it easier for the learner to exploit stylistic cues.

3) Training with CPO (Contrastive Preference Optimization):
- Fine-tune open-weight LLMs on (positive, negative) preference pairs.
- They also run DPO on the same pairs and report CPO performs better in this setup.

The main trade-off is scale vs noise: synthetic traces can be large and diverse, but only if you invest in validation and filtering; otherwise hallucinations become supervision. They mitigate this with automated judging plus human evaluation/calibration.
summary_en.experiments:
Models: Qwen3-14B, Mistral-8B, Llama-3.1-8B.

Reported outcomes:
- CPO over preference pairs improves over Q&A SFT by ~9.7%–16.3% absolute on average.
- On MMQA, the largest absolute gain over Q&A SFT reaches 21 percentage points.
- On the same preference data, CPO outperforms DPO.
- Training on two-table data transfers to three-table examples, suggesting the model learns compositional reasoning behaviors rather than memorizing templates.

They also introduce an evaluation set derived from BIRD: a full-table evidence extraction procedure to guarantee answer derivability, plus automated semantic-consistency checks to filter question–SQL mismatches. Trace quality is assessed via automated and human evaluation, and the LLM-judge components are validated against human annotators (details likely in experiments/appendix).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~35–50 minutes):
- Start with the trace-generation constraints (explicit table references, step-table formatting, anti-copying rules). This is what makes the synthetic supervision learnable.
- Focus on how positives are validated and how negatives are constructed, especially the heterogeneous-generator ablation.
- Jump to the main results comparing CPO vs DPO vs Q&A SFT, and the transfer experiment from two-table training to three-table evaluation.
- If you want a reusable data pipeline, read the section on building the BIRD-derived evaluation set (evidence extraction + semantic-consistency filtering).

recommendation.zh: 数据合成+CPO在后训练中的干净应用案例，消融实验可读，skim第4节异构生成器设计即可。
recommendation.en: A clean case study of data synthesis + CPO in post-training. The ablation on heterogeneous generators in §4 is worth skimming.

paper.title: CoEval: Ranking Language Models for Custom Tasks Without Labeled Data or Trustworthy Benchmarks
paper.abstract: Choosing or ranking language models for a specific application is hardest when no task-specific labeled data exists, and standard public benchmarks cannot be trusted, their items having likely leaked into pretraining, so scores reflect memorization rather than fitness. We present CoEval, an open-source, reusable framework that closes this gap end to end: from only a description of a task or domain, teacher models synthesize a fresh, attribute-controlled benchmark with no human labels, contaminat

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是无标注数据、公共 benchmark 又可能被污染时，如何为某个自定义任务选择和排序语言模型。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测基础设施工作，对基座研究的直接价值在于动态评测和污染规避。它不改进预训练算法，但针对当前模型选择中的一个真实痛点：静态公开题集容易进入预训练语料，分数可能反映记忆而不是泛化。CoEval 的思路是每次按任务描述重新生成评测集，并用跨模型家族 judge ensemble 评分。这个框架对内部模型迭代、continual pretrain 后的能力回归测试、以及面向特定数据分布的模型选择都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: CoEval 包含两步。第一步，teacher model 根据任务或领域描述生成 attribute-stratified benchmark，也就是按用户声明的能力、难度、子领域等属性控制题目分布。由于题目每次运行时新生成，目标是降低静态 benchmark 泄漏到训练语料中的风险。第二步，candidate models 在这些题目上作答，再由来自不同模型厂商或模型家族的 judge ensemble 评分。论文强调 judge panel 的关键不是数量，而是组成：跨家族、多来源的 judge 更能降低同源偏好；如果盲目加入低一致性的 judge，可靠性反而下降。聚合时利用不同 judge 对长答案偏好的方向差异抵消 verbosity bias，并通过 vendor-disjoint 设计减少 self-preference。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了一个四任务中等规模实验，产生 7,978 条有效评测，总成本为 5.89 美元。在有 ground truth 的设置中，CoEval 能恢复真实模型排序，并且 label-free judging 与 ground-truth correctness 的相关性达到 rho=0.86。实验还分析了 judge ensemble 的组成与可靠性的关系，结论是 vendor diversity 比单纯增加 panel size 更重要；加入低一致性 judge 会降低整体可靠性。论文还给出 rubric generalization、污染抵抗、成本，以及三个自定义垂直场景的端到端案例。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看框架定义部分，理解 declarative task specification 如何变成可执行 benchmark；再看 Section 5.1 和 Table 3，确认它在有 ground truth 场景下能否恢复正确排序；随后看 judge ensemble 的消融，尤其是 composition-over-size 的结果。对预训练研究员来说，最值得借鉴的是“动态生成评测分布 + 跨家族 judge 聚合”的工程设计，而不是某个具体任务上的排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses model selection for a custom task when there is no labeled task-specific data and public benchmarks may be contaminated by pretraining exposure.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation-infrastructure paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from dynamic evaluation and contamination control, rather than from a new training method. Static public benchmarks are increasingly weak signals for model choice because items can leak into pretraining corpora. CoEval proposes a renewable evaluation pipeline: generate a fresh task-specific benchmark from a task description and rank candidate models with a cross-family judge ensemble. This is useful for internal model iteration, continual-pretraining regression tests, and deployment-oriented model selection under a target distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoEval has two main components. First, a teacher model synthesizes an attribute-stratified benchmark from a domain or task specification, controlling dimensions such as capability, difficulty, and subdomain coverage. Since items are generated anew for each run, the benchmark is designed to reduce exposure to student-model training data. Second, candidate model responses are scored by a judge ensemble drawn from different model vendors or families. The paper’s central methodological point is that judge composition matters more than judge count. A diverse panel can reduce same-family self-preference, while adding low-agreement judges can make reliability worse. The aggregation scheme also aims to cancel verbosity bias because individual judges may have biases with different signs.
summary_en.experiments: The reported medium-scale study covers four tasks and produces 7,978 valid evaluations at an end-to-end cost of USD 5.89. In settings where ground truth exists, CoEval recovers the correct model ranking and its label-free judging correlates with ground-truth correctness at rho = 0.86. The experiments also examine judge-panel reliability and find that vendor diversity is a stronger lever than simply increasing the number of judges. Additional analyses cover rubric generalization, contamination resistance, cost, and three end-to-end custom-domain case studies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the framework section to understand how a declarative task specification is turned into a generated benchmark. Then check Section 5.1 and Table 3 for validation against ground-truth rankings. The most useful part is the judge-ensemble analysis, especially the composition-over-size finding. For pretraining researchers, the transferable idea is the evaluation design: dynamically generated target distributions combined with cross-family judging, not the ranking outcome for any single task.

recommendation.zh: 做模型选型和内部 eval 的人可以看；新意在 judge panel 设计而不在生成 benchmark，本身不改 pretrain prior，但可直接影响你怎么搭无标注评测流水线。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you build internal eval stacks; the useful bit is judge-panel composition rather than benchmark synthesis, and it won’t change pretraining priors but may change how you run label-free model ranking.

paper.title: Synthetic Hallucinations, Real Gains: Hard Negatives from Frontier Models for FIM Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Small open-source code models that power IDE autocomplete still emit hallucinated Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) completions: syntactically natural calls to methods, parameters, variables, and imports that do not exist in the surrounding project. Existing mitigations either require per-language execution sandboxes that do not apply at mid-keystroke or preference-optimisation pipelines that need large human-labelled corpora. We propose an execution-free alternative: use frontier code models to synthesi

summary.core_problem: 缓解小型开源代码补全模型在 IDE Fill-in-the-Middle 场景中生成不存在 API、变量、参数和 import 的幻觉问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码模型后训练数据构造和负样本学习。它关心的是 mid-keystroke 自动补全中的项目上下文一致性，和通用代码 LM 的实用失效模式相关，但不是基座预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是用多个 frontier code model 为真实 GitHub FIM 上下文合成“看起来合理但错误”的 hard negatives，并把这些负样本与真实开发者编辑形成对比监督信号，用于小模型 SFT；幻觉类型参考 Delulu taxonomy，避免依赖执行沙箱或大规模人工偏好标注。
summary.experiments: 数据来自 public GitHub，覆盖八种编程语言；每个上下文由三个 frontier generator 生成四类幻觉负样本之一。摘要提到使用 Docker 验证的多语言 FIM hallucination benchmark，但未给出模型参数量、训练 token 数、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Illinois Chicago；摘要未显示与大型代码模型预训练团队的直接关联。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets hallucinated Fill-in-the-Middle completions in small open-source code models, especially nonexistent APIs, variables, parameters, and imports in IDE autocomplete.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a post-training data construction recipe for code models using hard negatives. The problem is relevant to practical code LM reliability, but it is not a foundation pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline asks multiple frontier code models to synthesize plausible-but-wrong FIM completions for real GitHub contexts, then contrasts those synthetic hallucinations with the ground-truth developer edit as a supervised fine-tuning signal. The hallucination types follow the Delulu taxonomy and avoid execution sandboxes or large human preference datasets.
summary_en.experiments: The data are scraped from public GitHub across eight languages. Three frontier generators are used to create hard negatives across four hallucination categories, and the paper mentions a Docker-verified multilingual FIM hallucination benchmark. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training scale, baselines, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is University of Illinois Chicago; no clear tie to a major code-model pretraining group is visible from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 可看数据构造流程，不必细读；对代码预训练的价值主要是 hard negative 采样思路。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look for the hard-negative data recipe; it is not a pretraining result, and the main value is the sampling setup.

summary.core_problem: 如何通过基于环境交互的合成数据来扩展 Agent 的能力（Scaling Agentic Capabilities），减少对人工标注的依赖。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出 grounded interaction synthesis 作为 Agent 能力扩展的新路径，将 Agent 交互本身作为训练信号来源。
summary.technical_approach: 通过 Agent 在环境中的自举交互生成合成数据，再利用这些数据迭代训练以提升 Agent 的规划与工具使用能力，核心思想是让 Agent 自己生产训练数据。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体模型规模、训练数据量和量化对比结果。
summary.authors_note: 合作机构包括中国人民大学、北京大学和腾讯。

summary_en.core_problem: How to scale agentic capabilities by synthesizing grounded interaction data, reducing reliance on human annotation for agent training.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes grounded interaction synthesis as a new path for scaling agent capabilities, treating agent interactions themselves as the training signal source.
summary_en.technical_approach: Generates synthetic data through bootstrapped agent-environment interactions, then iteratively trains the agent on this data to improve planning and tool-use; the core idea is letting the agent produce its own training data.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model sizes, training data volumes, or quantitative comparison results are provided in the available abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Renmin University of China, Peking University, and Tencent.

recommendation.zh: Agent 自举交互合成数据是后训练方向，可作为数据合成思路的参考，但摘要信息过少，待看正文评估。
recommendation.en: Bootstrapped agent interaction synthesis falls in post-training, useful as a data synthesis reference but abstract is too sparse to assess; wait for full text.

paper.title: Not All Synthetic Data Is Yours to Learn From
paper.abstract: Can a language model improve from plain text sampled from itself, with no prompts, no teacher, no verifier, and no reward model? Yes, but only when the synthetic corpus is compatible with the student, a relational property of the source-student pair rather than an intrinsic property of the data. We call this the latent capability resurfacing hypothesis: weak self-training can amplify capabilities already present in the pretrained model, but only under this compatibility condition. We study this

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“合成数据能不能用”这个泛问题，而是一个更尖锐的问题：在没有 prompt、没有 teacher、没有 verifier、没有 reward model 的极弱设定下，模型能否仅靠自己从 BOS 无条件采样出来的纯文本继续训练，并得到稳定收益。作者把问题进一步收紧为一个关系性判断：决定收益的关键，不是某份 synthetic corpus 自身“质量高不高”，而是 source model 与 student model 是否兼容。全文围绕一个具体假设展开：预训练已经把一部分能力编码进参数里，但这些能力在 base decoding 行为中没有充分显现；弱自训练只能把这些潜在能力重新表面化，而不能可靠地凭空注入缺失能力。这个问题对预训练研究很关键，因为它直接触到 synthetic data 的边界条件、self-training 的有效机制，以及“模型从自己生成的数据里到底学到了什么”。
summary.importance: 影响主要有三层。第一，它给“模型坍塌”叙事补了一个重要限定：不是所有自生成数据都会把模型带坏，关键在 source-student compatibility。也就是说，synthetic utility 是 relational property，不是 corpus intrinsic property。第二，它把很多分散在 code self-distillation、reasoning self-training、inference-time sampling 里的现象，收束到一个更基础的解释框架：收益更像是 latent capability resurfacing，而不是新知识注入。这对理解 continual pretrain、mid-train synthetic mixing、以及 RL/SFT 为什么常常像“激活已有能力”而非“创造能力”都有直接启发。第三，它提出了一个对数据研究很不舒服但很重要的结论：常见的静态 proxy——比如 student 对语料的平均 NLL、语料和 benchmark 的语义相似度、source 模型更大更强——都不足以预测 transfer utility。对做数据配比、合成数据筛选、teacher 选择的人来说，这意味着现有很多经验法则并不稳。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计刻意做得很“干净”。训练管线只有三步：从某个 source model 以 BOS token 为起点无条件采样，得到 plain text synthetic corpus；用这些文本继续微调一个 base student；然后在一组下游 benchmark 上评估变化。整个过程中不引入任务提示、拒绝采样、答案校验、reward、偏好模型或外部数据过滤，因此任何收益都只能来自 student 与 synthetic signal 的相互作用，而不是额外监督。

核心分析框架有三部分。第一部分是 compatibility study。作者系统比较了 self-generated、same-lineage、different-recipe、cross-family 等 source-student 配对。以 Qwen student 为例，self data 最有效；同家族但更大的 Qwen2.5-7B 往往优于训练 recipe 已变化的 Qwen3-8B；跨家族如 LLaMA-3.2-1B 常常更弱甚至有害。这里的关键不是 source 绝对能力，而是 tokenizer、训练分布、建模习惯、内部表示结构等共同形成的“谱系相容性”。论文没有把 compatibility 简化成单一可观测量，而是把它当作一个经验上可验证、但未被简单 proxy 捕获的关系属性。

第二部分是对“intrinsic data quality”解释的反证。作者检验了几类直觉上应该有效的 proxy：student 对 synthetic corpus 的 mean NLL、synthetic corpus 与 benchmark 的语义接近度、增大 synthetic support 的规模等。结果显示，这些指标和真实 downstream gain 的对应关系很弱，甚至会出现“相同 NLL、相反收益”或“benchmark similarity 不同、收益相近”的情况。这个结果很重要，因为它说明自训练收益不是简单的 distribution matching，也不是“更像测试集就更好”。

第三部分是 latent capability resurfacing 的机制证据。作者不是只看 benchmark 分数，而是同时看 extractability。若收益只是 rehearse 了 source 生成的具体序列，那么 utility 上升通常会伴随更高的 verbatim extraction 风险。作者在 Pythia 控制实验里观察到相反现象：在合适的自训练区间，held-out exact-match extractability 明显下降，而 benchmark utility 保持甚至上升。这支持一种更分布式的解释：训练更新强化了参数中已有但未充分表达的任务结构，而不是记住更多具体句子。

此外，全文还讨论了 temperature 的作用。温度不是越高越好或越低越好，而是在 fidelity 与 coverage 之间做权衡：低温更贴近 source 的高置信模式，高温带来更广覆盖但也更噪。只有在兼容配对里，这个 trade-off 才能转化为稳定收益；在不兼容配对里，增加多样性并不能补救谱系错配。
summary.experiments:
实验结论比摘要里更完整，重点有四组。第一组是 source-student 配对实验。Qwen student 在 self-training 下收益最好；same-lineage transfer 次之；different recipe 和 cross-family 明显更差。作者特别强调一个反直觉点：较小但同谱系的 source，可能比更大但训练 recipe 改过的 source 更有用。这说明“teacher 越强越好”在这里不成立。

第二组是模型家族差异。Qwen 系列在 reasoning、math、code 上能得到更广泛收益；作者测试的 LLaMA student 收益更窄，主要集中在理解型 benchmark，对 structured generation 的改善不稳定。这一点支持“自训练放大预训练已支持的能力边界”而不是“补齐模型短板”。如果预训练里没有足够强的结构化生成基础，单靠 BOS-only synthetic text 很难补出来。

第三组是 proxy 失效实验。作者把 downstream gain 与 mean NLL、benchmark similarity、synthetic support size 等做对照，发现这些量都不能稳定排序不同 synthetic corpora 的效用。尤其是 mean NLL 这个结果很关键，因为它否定了一个常见想法：只要 student 觉得数据“顺口”，继续训练就会有帮助。论文给出的证据是，同样容易被 student 拟合的数据，可能带来相反的迁移结果。

第四组是 utility-extractability frontier。Pythia 控制实验中，compatible self-training 把点推向“更高 utility、更低 verbatim extractability”的区域。摘要里只说了趋势，正文强调下降是明显的，而不是边际波动。这组结果是全文最有机制含义的一部分，因为它把“不是简单记忆”从口头判断变成了可测现象。

从全文可见，作者更重视现象的稳健排序和机制辨析，而不是追求单个 benchmark 上的大幅绝对增益。参数规模和数据规模在正文中用于构造不同 source-student 关系，例如 Qwen2.5-0.5B student、Qwen2.5-7B source、Qwen3-8B source、LLaMA-3.2-1B source，以及 Pythia 系列的受控实验。合成数据来自 BOS-only unconditional sampling，且作者还考察了 temperature 和 synthetic support 的变化，但结论是扩大样本量本身带来的额外稳定收益有限，远不如 compatibility 重要。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“假设—反证—机制证据”这条线读。

先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。Figure 1 基本把全文三条主结论都压缩进去了：utility 是关系性的、简单 proxy 失效、utility 可以和 extractability 反向变化。读懂这张图，全文主旨就清楚了。

然后重点看 source-student pairing 的主实验部分。这里要注意作者不是在比较谁更强，而是在比较 lineage、recipe、family 变化如何影响 transfer。读的时候可以把 tokenizer、数据分布、训练目标细节这些潜变量放在脑中，因为 compatibility 很可能就是这些因素的合成结果。

接着看 proxy analysis。这里最值得深挖的是为什么 mean NLL 和 benchmark similarity 都不够。一个可继续思考的问题是：如果静态 proxy 不行，是否需要基于训练动态、梯度对齐、表示几何或 Fisher overlap 的 compatibility 指标。

Pythia 的 extractability 实验值得精读，尤其是 utility-extractability frontier 的图表和实验设置。这部分决定了论文是否只是“又一个 self-training 有点用”的经验结论，还是对机制有更强约束。若时间有限，至少把 exact-match extraction 的定义、held-out 构造方式、以及与 benchmark utility 的联动关系看清楚。

最后看 temperature 与 synthetic support 的消融。这里能帮助判断这项工作对实际 recipe 的含义：该优先调 source 选择，还是调采样温度，还是盲目扩 synthetic corpus。预计认真读完主文需要 45 到 70 分钟；若连附录中的更多配对和消融一起看，时间会更长。
summary.authors_note: UT Austin VITA Group。文中可确认的作者包括通讯作者 Sina Alemohammad；其研究背景与 model collapse、synthetic data、生成模型训练分布偏移相关。其余作者信息在给定全文片段中无法完整确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a deliberately minimal question: can a language model improve by continuing training on plain text sampled from a model with only a BOS token as input, with no prompts, no teacher annotations, no verifier, and no reward model? The answer is yes, but only under a compatibility condition between the source model and the student. The central claim is not that synthetic text has an intrinsic quality level that makes it useful or harmful. Instead, usefulness is relational. The paper formalizes this through the latent capability resurfacing hypothesis: pretraining already encodes capabilities that are only partially expressed by the base model, and weak self-training can resurface them when the synthetic corpus is compatible with the student. In incompatible settings, the same procedure does little or can even hurt. This is a sharp question for pretraining research because it probes what synthetic data is actually doing, where self-training breaks, and whether gains come from new information injection or from amplifying structure already present in the pretrained weights.
summary_en.importance: The contribution matters in three ways. First, it adds an important qualifier to the model-collapse narrative. Recursive synthetic training is not uniformly bad; the outcome depends strongly on source-student compatibility. That shifts the discussion from intrinsic corpus quality to pairwise transfer geometry. Second, it provides a cleaner explanatory frame for several scattered observations from code self-distillation, reward-free reasoning self-training, and inference-time sampling: many gains may be better understood as resurfacing latent capabilities rather than creating new ones. That has direct implications for continual pretraining, synthetic data mixing, and the interface between pretraining and post-training. Third, it shows that common static proxies are poor predictors of synthetic utility. Source size, source capability, mean NLL under the student, and benchmark similarity all fail to reliably rank synthetic corpora. For anyone working on data curation, teacher selection, or synthetic filtering, that is a nontrivial warning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The experimental design is intentionally stripped down. A source model generates unconditional text from BOS. That synthetic corpus is then used to continue training a base student. The student is evaluated on downstream benchmarks. There are no prompts, no task formatting, no rejection sampling, no correctness filtering, no reward model, and no external supervision. This makes the setup unusually clean: if gains appear, they must come from the interaction between the pretrained student and weak self-generated signal.

The analysis has three main components. First is the compatibility study. The paper compares self-generated data, same-lineage transfer, different-recipe transfer, and cross-family transfer. For Qwen students, self-generated data works best; a same-lineage source such as Qwen2.5-7B transfers better than a differently trained but larger source such as Qwen3-8B; cross-family sources such as LLaMA-3.2-1B are weaker and can be harmful. The key point is that absolute source strength is not the right axis. Compatibility likely reflects a bundle of factors such as tokenizer alignment, training distribution, optimization recipe, and internal representational structure.

Second, the paper directly tests and rejects intrinsic-data explanations. It evaluates several plausible proxies: mean token NLL of the synthetic corpus under the student, semantic similarity between the synthetic corpus and benchmark distributions, and scaling the amount of synthetic support. None of these reliably predicts downstream gains. The paper explicitly shows cases where similar NLL leads to opposite transfer outcomes, and where benchmark similarity differs without corresponding utility differences. This is a strong argument against simple distribution matching stories.

Third, the paper provides mechanism-oriented evidence for latent capability resurfacing by jointly measuring utility and extractability. If gains were mainly due to rehearsal of specific generated sequences, one would expect better downstream performance to come with higher verbatim extraction risk. In controlled Pythia experiments, the paper finds the opposite in favorable regimes: held-out exact-match extractability drops while downstream utility is preserved or improved. That points to reinforcement of more distributed task structure rather than memorization of specific strings.

The paper also studies temperature as a coverage-fidelity trade-off. Lower temperature stays closer to high-confidence source modes; higher temperature broadens support but adds noise. This trade-off only becomes useful when the source-student pair is already compatible. More diversity does not rescue an incompatible pairing.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical story has four important pieces. First, source-student pairing experiments establish the main ranking: self-training is strongest, same-lineage transfer is next, and different-recipe or cross-family transfer is weaker. A notable result is that a smaller but lineage-matched source can outperform a larger source trained with a different recipe. So stronger teacher does not imply better synthetic data in this setting.

Second, the paper compares student families. Qwen students show broader gains across reasoning, math, and code. The LLaMA student examined in the paper improves more narrowly, mostly on comprehension-style benchmarks, with little reliable gain on structured generation. This supports the claim that BOS-only self-training amplifies abilities already supported by pretraining rather than filling in missing structured capabilities.

Third, proxy-failure experiments show that mean NLL under the student, benchmark similarity, and synthetic support size do not reliably explain downstream gains. This is especially important for mean NLL, since it rules out a common intuition that data the student already finds easy should be safe and useful for continued training.

Fourth, the Pythia-controlled experiments examine the utility-extractability frontier. Compatible self-training moves the model toward better benchmark utility with lower held-out exact-match verbatim extraction. The paper presents this as a clear shift, not a tiny fluctuation. That is the strongest evidence in the paper against a simple rehearsal explanation.

The paper uses concrete source-student configurations such as Qwen2.5-0.5B as student, Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B as alternative sources, LLaMA-3.2-1B as a cross-family source, and Pythia models for controlled analysis. Synthetic corpora are generated via BOS-only unconditional sampling. The paper also varies temperature and synthetic support size, and finds that scaling support alone yields limited stable benefit compared with getting compatibility right.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and Figure 1. Figure 1 already contains the paper’s three central claims: utility is relational, simple intrinsic proxies fail, and utility can improve while extractability decreases. If that figure is clear, the rest of the paper becomes much easier to parse.

Then read the main source-student pairing experiments carefully. The important question is not which source is larger or stronger, but how lineage, recipe, and family changes affect transfer. While reading, keep latent variables such as tokenizer overlap, pretraining distribution, and optimization recipe in mind, since compatibility is likely an aggregate effect of these factors.

Next, focus on the proxy analysis. This section is worth reading slowly because it explains what does not work. A useful follow-up question is what a better compatibility metric might look like: gradient alignment, representation overlap, Fisher geometry, or some training-dynamics-based signal may be more promising than static corpus scores.

The Pythia extractability section deserves close attention, especially the utility-extractability frontier plots and the exact definition of held-out exact-match extraction. This is the part that turns the paper from an empirical self-training note into a stronger mechanism paper.

If time is limited, read the main text plus the key figures on pairing, proxy failure, and extractability. That should take around 45 to 70 minutes. The appendix is worth checking if you care about robustness across pairings and additional ablations.
summary_en.authors_note: UT Austin, VITA Group. The visible author information includes corresponding author Sina Alemohammad, whose prior work is associated with synthetic data, model collapse, and distribution shift in generative training. Full author list cannot be reliably recovered from the provided text fragment.

recommendation.zh: 合成数据效用的关系性结论推翻了“源模型越强数据越好”的默认认知，应立刻在内部合成数据实验中加入谱系匹配的消融
recommendation.en: The relational nature of synthetic data utility overturns the default prior that stronger source models produce better training data; add lineage matching ablation to internal synthetic data experiments immediately

institutions: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校
The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: Exploring Autonomous Agentic Data Engineering for Model Specialization
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on general tasks, while often struggling to adapt to specialized domains without high-quality domain-specific data. Existing LLM-based data curation methods primarily rely on human-designed workflows, leaving it unexamined whether LLMs can autonomously execute an end-to-end data engineering pipeline for model specialization. We formalize \textbf{Autonomous Agentic Data Engineering}, a novel task designed to evaluate LLMs as autono

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 LLM agent 能否在很少人工流程设计的情况下，独立完成面向模型专用化的数据工程：理解目标任务、设计数据策略、调用固定 teacher 合成数据、校验格式与质量、用固定 student 做 SFT，并根据验证反馈迭代优化数据。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练大模型本身，而在把“数据”明确放进可搜索、可优化的闭环里。它提供了一个观察点：当模型能力足够强时，数据配方的一部分可以从人工规则迁移到 agent 生成的程序与策略。对基座研究员更有用的是它的评估框架，而不是具体某个领域的结果。固定 teacher、student、finetune recipe 和预算后，性能提升主要来自数据构造能力，这种控制变量设计适合用于研究数据质量、合成数据覆盖度、训练反馈噪声，以及 post-training 信号如何反向塑造数据分布。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 Agentic Data Engineering 形式化为闭环优化问题。给定目标任务，agent 生成一个数据整理程序，通过 teacher model API 合成候选训练集；student model 在该数据上做标准化 SFT；评测器给出 public set 或 private set 反馈；agent 再根据反馈调整数据策略。论文设置了两类 agent：One-Shot 只一次性生成数据；Iterative Agent 可以多轮使用外部反馈优化。实验中 teacher 和 student 被固定，默认 teacher 是 Qwen3-30B-A3B，student 是 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct。agent 不能直接手写最终 submission，而必须写代码并通过 teacher API 生成样本，这个约束减少了“硬编码答案”对评测的污染。与常见 LLM 数据合成工作相比，它不是给定人工 pipeline 后让模型填充样本，而是让模型自己设计 domain specification、prompt、生成逻辑、验证规则和迭代策略。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Science、Code、Finance 三类 QA/reasoning 任务，并比较从零开始与给定 seed data 两种条件。评价指标是 student 在合成数据 SFT 后的 hidden private set 性能增益。论文报告现代 LLM agent 已能从任务描述中推断监督信号，生成较贴合任务的数据；其中 GPT-5.2 在迭代设置下取得平均 57.29% 的相对性能增益，并超过人工设计的数据合成 pipeline。One-Shot 与 Iterative 的对比显示，外部反馈对数据分布修正有明显帮助。失败案例集中在 post-generation QA：格式一致性、标签可靠性、样本多样性和难度控制仍不稳定，说明 agent 会生成“看起来合理但训练信号有噪声”的数据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。重点看任务形式化和环境设计部分，尤其是固定 teacher/student 后如何隔离数据工程能力；再看 One-Shot 与 Iterative Agent 的实验表格，关注 seed data、反馈轮数和预算约束对增益的影响。失败模式分析值得多看，因为它比平均分更能说明当前 agentic data curation 的瓶颈：生成数据不是难点，稳定地产生可训练、可验证、分布合适的数据才是难点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether an LLM agent can run an end-to-end data engineering pipeline for model specialization with minimal human-designed workflow: infer the task, plan a data strategy, synthesize examples through a fixed teacher model, validate the data, fine-tune a fixed student model, and iteratively improve the data using feedback.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining-oriented research is not a new base-model training method, but a controlled way to study data as an optimizable object. By fixing the teacher, student, fine-tuning recipe, and budgets, the measured improvement is largely attributed to the agent’s data-curation strategy. This is useful for studying synthetic data quality, coverage, feedback noise, and the interface between post-training performance signals and data distribution design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate Agentic Data Engineering as a closed-loop optimization problem. For each target task, the agent writes a data-curation program that calls a teacher model API to synthesize a candidate dataset. A fixed student model is then fine-tuned on that dataset under standardized hyperparameters and evaluated by a deterministic evaluator. The feedback can be used by an iterative agent to revise the curation strategy. The default setup uses Qwen3-30B-A3B as the teacher and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct as the student. The agent must generate the final submission through executable code and teacher API calls rather than directly writing examples, which reduces trivial leakage and forces the system to express an actual curation procedure. Compared with typical LLM-based data synthesis pipelines, the key difference is that the model is responsible for the full recipe: task specification, prompt design, data generation, validation, and optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans Science, Code, and Finance QA/reasoning tasks, under both from-scratch and seed-data settings. The main metric is the private-set performance gain of the fine-tuned student. The paper reports that current LLM agents can infer missing supervision patterns and synthesize task-aligned instances. In the iterative setting, GPT-5.2 achieves an average relative gain of 57.29% and outperforms human-crafted synthesis pipelines. The comparison between One-Shot and Iterative Agent settings shows that external feedback is useful for correcting the generated data distribution. The main failure modes are in quality assurance after generation: format consistency, label reliability, diversity, and difficulty control remain brittle.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes around 25–35 minutes. Focus on the task formulation and environment design, especially how fixing the teacher and student isolates the agent’s contribution to data engineering. Then read the tables comparing One-Shot and Iterative settings, and check how seed data, feedback rounds, and budget constraints affect gains. The failure-mode analysis is particularly informative, because it shows that producing plausible synthetic examples is easier than producing stable training signals with the right distribution.

recommendation.zh: 读方法闭环和消融即可；若反馈信号干净，这类 data-as-policy 会直接影响 mid-train/SFT 数据管线。
recommendation.en: Read the loop design and ablations; if the feedback signal is clean, this data-as-policy setup matters for mid-train and SFT pipelines.

paper.title: Diffusion Models Preferentially Memorize Prototypical Examples or: Why Does My Diffusion Model Love Slop?
paper.abstract: Generative models have a persistent limitation: their tendency to memorize training data can create legal liabilities and erode creative diversity. Understanding which samples are memorized in whole or in part, and under what conditions, therefore remains an important open problem. Here we answer the question "Are atypical or rare samples memorized first?" in the negative. We train diffusion models on strings generated according to the production rules of the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), and fi

summary.core_problem: 生成模型的记忆化是一个持久问题——模型倾向于记住训练数据，带来法律风险并降低创造性多样性。核心问题是：哪些样本会被优先记忆？现有文献中存在竞争假设：一种观点认为非典型/稀有样本会被优先记住（因为它们主导剩余训练损失），另一种观点认为常见特征的样本更容易被记住。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在于数据记忆机制的理解：研究发现与直觉相反，由常见子串组成的典型样本被优先记忆。这意味着仅在数据点级别去重并不能提供有效的隐私保证，因为即使是唯一的样本如果包含常见子特征也会被优先记忆。这对预训练数据处理（去重策略）和隐私保护有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Random Hierarchy Model (RHM) 生成的显式层级组合式合成字符串数据训练扩散模型。RHM 的扩展版本将数据生成规则与幂律概率分布耦合，可以通过控制幂律进入的抽象层次来精细地控制样本的典型性。这使得研究者能够区分泛化、部分记忆和完全记忆，并系统地研究样本稀有度与记忆顺序之间的关系。
