summary.experiments: 在 RHM 生成的合成字符串数据上训练扩散模型。关键发现：由常见子串组成的样本被优先记忆。即使在训练数据完全唯一（无重复样本）的情况下，这一结论仍然成立——说明样本级别的去重不能提供有意义的隐私保证。进一步的分析预测并证实了在扩散模型中典型样本的记忆优先性（与经典分类模型中非典型样本主导损失的情况不同）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中对三种竞争假设的梳理（图 1 第一行）和实验部分（核心发现段落）。建议关注实验设计中如何利用 RHM 控制样本典型性以及完全唯一数据的实验。预计阅读时间：25-35 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 论文未提供作者信息，从 arXiv ID 2605.30642 查询为近期提交。

summary_en.core_problem: Memorization in generative models is a persistent limitation—models tend to reproduce training data, creating legal liabilities and reducing creative diversity. The core question is: which samples get memorized first? Competing hypotheses exist in the literature: one view claims atypical/rare samples are memorized first (because they dominate remaining training loss), another argues samples with common features are easier to memorize.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining research lies in understanding data memorization mechanisms: the study finds, counterintuitively, that prototypical samples composed of common substrings are preferentially memorized. This implies deduplication at the data point level alone does not provide meaningful privacy guarantees—even unique samples can be preferentially memorized if they contain common sub-features. This has direct implications for pretraining data processing (deduplication strategies) and privacy protection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains diffusion models on explicitly hierarchical, compositional synthetic string data generated by the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM). An extended version of RHM couples data generation rules to a power-law probability distribution, allowing fine control over sample typicality by manipulating the abstraction level at which the power-law enters. This setup enables distinguishing generalization, partial memorization, and full memorization, and systematically studying the relationship between sample rarity and memorization order.
summary_en.experiments: Diffusion models trained on RHM-generated synthetic string data. Key finding: samples composed of common substrings are preferentially memorized. This holds even when training data consists of entirely unique samples (no duplicates)—demonstrating that sample-level deduplication does not provide meaningful privacy guarantees. Further analysis predicts and confirms the preferential memorization of prototypical examples in diffusion models (contrasting with the behavior in classification models where atypical samples dominate loss).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the introduction's mapping of three competing hypotheses (Figure 1, first row) and the experimental section where core findings are presented. Pay attention to how RHM controls sample typicality and the experiments on entirely unique data. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author information not provided in the available content; arXiv ID 2605.30642 is a recent submission.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim：结论把记忆风险从样本重复移到子结构频率，读实验设计和长尾对记忆时序的分析即可。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming: it moves the memorization prior from duplicate examples to frequent substructures; focus on the setup and the fat-tail timing analysis.

paper.title: Scaling Multi-Hop Training Data via Graph-Constrained Path Selection
paper.abstract: Endowing large language models with compositional reasoning over specialized documents requires multi-hop training data at scale, where such data rarely exists outside of curated benchmarks built on structured sources. To construct it directly from plain, unannotated text, existing methods ask a single teacher model to jointly discover an evidence path through a document and verbalize it as a question-answer pair. However, these methods degrade sharply when documents are structured around repeti

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是专门领域多跳训练数据难以规模化生成的问题。现有合成流水线通常让 teacher LLM 同时完成两件事：在长文档里搜索证据路径，并把路径写成 QA。面对合同这类模板重复、交叉引用密集、语义差异细小的文本时，这个联合任务失败率很高，生成预算增加也难以线性转化为可用样本。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的相关性有限，更接近 post-train 数据合成和领域 SFT。但它提供了一个有用的数据工程信号：合成数据扩展时，瓶颈不一定是 teacher 的写作能力，而是把搜索、结构约束和语言生成压进同一个 prompt 后造成的有效产率下降。把“证据路径枚举”和“问题答案 verbalization”拆开，可以显著提高过滤后的样本数量。这个思路可迁移到通用推理数据构造，但论文里的实验证据主要停留在法律合同域，泛化到通用多跳推理的增益很小。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 Graph-Constrained Semantic Chain Synthesis，简称 GCSCS。流程分四步。第一步按合同的 Article、Section、Clause、Paragraph、Schedule、Exhibit 等天然边界切分文本，并把片段转成 keyword-grounded 的原子 QA facts。第二步构造 contextual keyword centroids，用中心向量表达每个概念在上下文中的语义 footprint。第三步在 FAISS 索引上搜索非循环的、满足拓扑约束的路径，并用五类几何约束过滤，提前保证跨条款连接是可用的。第四步才调用 teacher LLM，让它基于已经装配好的 evidence chain 写出最终 QA。关键区别是 teacher 不再负责隐式图搜索，只做单次语言表达。
summary.experiments: 在 CUAD 合同数据上，随机多文档链通过结构化 JSON quality gate 的比例只有 22.0%，可用语料约停在 18K。GCSCS 把通过率提升到 94.5%，可用样本扩大到 80K，约为 4.4 倍。用这批数据微调 Qwen3-32B，在严格 source-contract split 的 closed-book 设置下，Token F1 从 21.66% 提升到 38.58%。18K matched-size ablation 显示，在相同训练规模下 constrained 和 unconstrained chains 的下游表现接近，说明主要收益来自数据产率和规模，而不是单条 chain 质量更高。零样本迁移到 HotpotQA 和 MuSiQue 的提升为正但很小，HotpotQA 约 +0.56%，说明模型主要学到法律回答风格和合同域知识组织方式，而不是通用多跳能力。作者还发现 citation-as-suffix 行为：模型会把 citation ID 当成答案后缀格式习惯；加入检索上下文后，CFR 从 89% 降到 8%，说明原先 citation 并不代表真实 grounding。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 15-25 分钟即可。重点看 Introduction 对 cognitive synthesizability bottleneck 的定义，以及 Methodology 中路径枚举和 teacher fusion 的拆分。实验部分建议看三处：22.0% 到 94.5% 的 quality-gate yield，18K matched-size ablation，以及 citation-as-suffix 分析。若关注通用 LLM 训练数据，这篇的可取之处是数据管线分工和过滤产率分析；法律合同任务本身不必细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the difficulty of scaling synthetic multi-hop training data in specialized document collections. A single teacher model is often asked to both find an evidence path and write a question-answer pair. In legal contracts, where clauses are repetitive, densely cross-referenced, and semantically close, this coupled operation has low usable yield.
summary_en.importance: The work is closer to post-training data generation than to foundation-model pretraining. Its main lesson is still useful for LLM data pipelines: synthetic data scaling can be limited by effective yield, not by raw generation volume. When path search and verbalization are merged into one prompt, the teacher fails mechanically even if the underlying evidence paths exist. Decoupling graph construction from language generation improves yield substantially. The evidence for general reasoning transfer is weak; most of the gain appears domain-specific.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed pipeline, Graph-Constrained Semantic Chain Synthesis (GCSCS), separates topology discovery from teacher verbalization. It first chunks contracts along native legal boundaries such as articles, sections, clauses, schedules, and exhibits. It then converts content into keyword-grounded atomic QA facts and builds contextual keyword centroids that represent the semantic footprint of each concept. A FAISS index is used to search for non-looping, topologically admissible evidence paths under several geometric constraints. Only after this path is pre-validated does the teacher model generate the final QA pair. The teacher is therefore used for articulation rather than implicit graph search.
summary_en.experiments: On CUAD-style contract data, random multi-document chains pass the structured JSON quality gate only 22.0% of the time, and the usable corpus saturates around 18K examples. GCSCS raises the pass rate to 94.5% and produces 80K usable examples, a 4.4x increase. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B on this corpus improves closed-book Token F1 from 21.66% to 38.58% under a strict source-contract split. A matched 18K ablation shows that constrained and unconstrained chains perform similarly at equal data size, indicating that the main improvement comes from higher data yield rather than better individual chains. Zero-shot transfer to HotpotQA and MuSiQue is positive but small, with HotpotQA improving by about 0.56%. The paper also identifies a citation-as-suffix artifact: the model learns to append citation IDs as a format habit, and when retrieved context is injected at inference time, the citation failure rate drops from 89% to 8%.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim of 15-25 minutes is enough. Read the problem framing around the cognitive synthesizability bottleneck, then inspect the methodology for how path enumeration is separated from teacher fusion. In the experiments, focus on the quality-gate yield, the matched-size ablation, and the citation-as-suffix diagnostic. For general LLM training, the reusable part is the pipeline design and yield analysis, not the legal contract task itself.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim 方法部分：把路径验证从 teacher 里拿出来是干净的 data pipeline prior，可复查内部多跳合成流程。
recommendation.en: Skim the method: moving path validation outside the teacher is a clean data-pipeline prior worth checking against internal multi-hop synthesis.

paper.title: When and How Human Curation Backfires: Preference Alignment under Multi-Model Self-Consuming Loop
paper.abstract: Foundation models are increasingly trained on synthetic data generated by prior model iterations rather than exclusively on real data. This self-consuming training paradigm can lead to model collapse, divergence, or bias amplification. Recent work (Ferbach et al., 2024) shows that incorporating human curation into the loop can steer a self-consuming model toward human-aligned behavior, but these analyses focus on a single, isolated model that solely consumes its own outputs. In practice, however

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究多模型自消费训练中的偏好对齐动态：多个模型会训练在真实数据、自己生成的数据、其他模型生成的数据以及人类筛选后的合成数据混合物上。在这种耦合系统里，增加某个模型的人类 curated synthetic data 比例，未必会像单模型情形那样单调改善长期对齐。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏理论，但问题和预训练数据生态直接相关。今天的大模型训练已经不可避免地接触到其他模型生成、筛选、改写或自动标注的数据。单模型 self-consuming loop 的结论过于理想化，因为真实数据池里存在多模型交叉污染。该工作给出的核心提醒是：人类筛选不是无条件稳定器；当模型之间存在强交互时，curation 可能被其他模型的数据反馈放大、削弱，甚至反向影响长期 alignment。对持续预训练和合成数据配比来说，这意味着不能只看单个数据源的即时质量，还要看它进入数据生态后的闭环效应。
summary.technical_approach: 作者形式化了一个 interacting self-consuming models 框架。可用内容中重点展开的是双模型设定：两个模型参数分别为 θ_t 和 ϕ_t，参数空间是闭凸集合；每轮更新时，模型训练在真实数据与合成数据的混合物上，合成数据可以来自自己，也可以来自另一个模型，并且部分合成样本经过人类偏好筛选。分析目标有三层。第一，刻画这个动态系统何时收敛到稳定点，尤其关注真实数据比例和 cross-model interaction strength 对稳定性的作用。第二，在已收敛前提下，对人类 curation 比例做局部敏感性分析，把长期 alignment 变化分解为 self-influence 和 cross-influence。第三，比较真实数据训练与真实-合成混合训练之间的 global alignment gap。和单模型 Ferbach et al. 风格结果相比，这里的关键区别是多模型耦合会让 curation 的边际效应变成非单调函数。
summary.experiments: 实验部分用于验证理论预测：增加人类 curated synthetic data 的比例并不总是改善对齐，alignment 随 curation ratio 变化可以出现非单调行为，和定理中的 self-influence / cross-influence 分解一致。给出的正文内容没有包含具体模型规模、数据集名称或数值提升，因此不宜推断实验量级。可确认的实验结论是：多模型交互足以让单模型情形下“更多人类筛选带来更好长期对齐”的结论失效。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–45 分钟。优先看 Section 2 的问题形式化，确认合成数据混合、交叉消费和人类筛选比例是如何进入更新算子的；再看 Section 3 的收敛条件，尤其是真实数据比例如何缓解耦合不稳定；最后看 Section 4 的敏感性分解，这是最有用的部分。若只关心工程启发，可以跳过部分证明，重点读 self-influence、cross-influence 的符号条件和 Section 5 的非单调实验曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies preference alignment under multi-model self-consuming training. Multiple models are updated on mixtures of real data, their own synthetic data, other models’ synthetic data, and human-curated synthetic samples. In this coupled setting, increasing the human-curated fraction for one model does not necessarily improve its long-run alignment.
summary_en.importance: The topic is directly relevant to pretraining data ecosystems. Modern training corpora can contain outputs from many prior models, including auto-captioned data, synthetic instructions, rewritten text, or curated generated samples. Single-model self-consuming analyses miss this coupling. The main lesson is that human curation is not an unconditional stabilizer: cross-model feedback can amplify, dampen, or reverse its long-term effect. For continual pretraining and synthetic-data mixing, this argues for evaluating closed-loop data dynamics rather than only the local quality of a curated source.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize interacting self-consuming models as a dynamical system. The available text focuses on a two-model setup with parameters θ_t and ϕ_t in closed convex parameter spaces. At each iteration, each model trains on a mixture of real data and synthetic data generated by itself or by the other model, with some synthetic data filtered by human preferences. The analysis has three parts: convergence to a stable point under cross-model interactions; local sensitivity of the stable point and alignment objective to the human-curation fraction; and the global alignment gap between mixed real–synthetic training and purely real-data training. The sensitivity analysis decomposes the effect into self-influence, the model’s direct response to its own curation, and cross-influence, the propagated effect through other models. This differs from single-model self-consuming results, where increasing human curation tends to monotonically improve long-run alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are used to validate the theoretical prediction that more human-curated synthetic data can produce non-monotonic alignment behavior in a multi-model loop. The result supports the self-influence and cross-influence decomposition: curation can help, saturate, or hurt depending on the strength and sign of cross-model interactions. The provided full-content excerpt does not include concrete model scales, datasets, or numerical effect sizes, so those should not be inferred. The reliable takeaway is that multi-model coupling is sufficient to invalidate the simple single-model rule that more human curation always improves long-run alignment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Read the formulation section first to understand how real data, self-generated data, cross-model synthetic data, and human curation enter the update operator. Then focus on the convergence analysis, especially the role of real-data ratio in stabilizing the coupled system. The most useful part is the sensitivity analysis: the sign conditions for self-influence and cross-influence explain when curation helps or backfires. If the goal is engineering intuition rather than proof details, prioritize those sign conditions and the non-monotonic experimental curves in Section 5.

recommendation.zh: 多模型自消耗是后训练对齐中日益重要的问题，第4节的收敛性分析和第5节的交叉影响分析对理解合成数据训练的长期动态很有价值。
recommendation.en: Multi-model self-consumption is increasingly relevant for post-training alignment; the convergence analysis in §4 and cross-influence results in §5 are valuable for understanding long-term synthetic data dynamics.

paper.title: GenesisFunc: Multi-Agent Data Generation for Accurate and Generalizable Function-Calling
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) extend their capabilities through function-calling (FC), which relies on training data with high quality, diversity, and broad coverage of scenario. However, obtaining and annotating real function-calling data is challenging, while synthetic data from existing pipelines often suffers from unreliable APIs, limited tool scalability, insufficient diversity, and weak quality control. To address these, we present GenesisFunc, an automated pipeline for generating FC traini

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何再做一个 function-calling 模型”，而是更前面的瓶颈：如何稳定地产出可用于训练的高质量 FC 数据。作者指出现有合成流程有四个老问题：API 来源不可靠、工具集合难扩展、对话场景单薄、质量控制弱。结果是模型在 benchmark 上可能能学会格式，但一到真实多轮、多工具、参数约束复杂的场景就容易失真。GenesisFunc 的目标，是把“工具选择—多轮对话生成—执行校验—数据筛选”做成一条自动化流水线，让生成数据同时满足可执行、覆盖广、对话自然、可扩展到下游工具四个条件。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是训练目标或 scaling 层面的工作，更接近 post-train 数据工程；但对“模型如何学会调用外部环境”这个接口问题有现实意义。它的价值主要有三点。第一，它把 function-calling 数据构造从单轮模板扩展到多轮、多任务、带历史依赖的对话，这比只做 schema matching 更接近真实 agent 使用形态。第二，它强调 API 可靠性和可执行验证，而不是只靠模型自评，这一点对任何工具学习数据合成都重要。第三，它展示了同一套生成数据既可用于 SFT，也可进一步接到 RL 强化多轮工具使用，这对 pretrain↔post-train 闭环有一点启发。不过从贡献量级看，它更像一套做得较完整的数据生成 recipe，而不是改变建模范式的方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三段。第一段是工具种子选择。作者没有从开放网页随意抓 API，也没有完全手工写 toy tools，而是从 BFCL 中挑选经过验证、覆盖多个领域的工具作为 seed set。这样做的原因很直接：如果 API 本身不稳定，后面生成再多数据也只是把噪声放大。第二段是多智能体对话生成模块，这是全文的主体。其设计重点不是简单让多个 agent 轮流写对话，而是给不同 agent 明确分工，用历史感知的角色分化和参数槽位控制来提升场景多样性。可以理解为：有的 agent 负责构造用户意图和上下文，有的负责规划工具使用路径，有的负责填充参数与单位，有的负责从对话历史中制造合理的追问、修正和多任务切换。这样生成出来的样本不只是“用户一句话—模型调一个函数”，而是包含多轮澄清、参数补全、跨工具组合、上下文延续等结构。第三段是多阶段评估模块。作者把规则校验、模型判分和人工抽检串起来：规则层主要检查 schema 一致性、参数合法性、调用可执行性；模型层评估对话自然度、任务完成度和工具调用合理性；最后再做定向人工复核。这个设计的关键点在于把“语言上像对的”和“执行上真能跑的”分开处理，避免只优化表面流畅度。
summary.experiments: 实验设置是用生成数据对 Qwen3-8B 做监督微调，得到 GenesisFunc-8B，然后在 BFCL、API-Bank、ACEBench 上做 zero-shot 评测。作者强调了两个维度：一是 in-domain，即工具来源相关的 BFCL；二是 out-of-domain，即 API-Bank 和 ACEBench，用来看泛化。全文给出的结论是，GenesisFunc-8B 在统一评测协议下持续超过同规模开源基线，并且和若干 API-based 闭源模型保持接近竞争力。就论文提供的信息看，最重要的不是某一个绝对分数，而是三类实验信号。其一，数据质量控制确实有用：多阶段过滤后，训练样本的准确性和可执行性提升，模型最终 FC 成功率也随之上升。其二，多智能体生成比单一生成器更能覆盖多轮和多任务场景，尤其在需要历史依赖和参数补全的样本上更明显。其三，作者还验证了生成数据可继续用于 RL，进一步改善多轮对话中的 function-calling 表现，这说明数据格式和环境接口设计不是只服务于一次性 SFT。遗憾的是，当前给出的全文片段没有完整保留所有表格数字，因此无法在这里精确复述每个 benchmark 的具体分数、提升幅度和样本规模；精读时需要直接核对实验表与附录。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看三处。第一是 Introduction 和方法总览图，先确认作者到底把问题定义成“数据生成”还是“工具学习算法”；这决定了阅读预期。第二是多智能体生成模块，尤其是各 agent 的职责划分、历史感知机制、参数槽位选择策略，以及它们如何具体增加多样性而不牺牲正确性。第三是 evaluation pipeline 和消融实验，要看清楚规则校验、模型打分、人工审核各自拦住了什么类型的坏样本。实验部分建议优先看 BFCL→API-Bank/ACEBench 的迁移结果，以及单轮/多轮、多工具/单工具的拆分表现。如果时间有限，30–40 分钟足够抓住主线；如果要判断是否能复用到自己的数据合成流程，再补看附录中的 prompt、过滤规则和人工评审协议。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a data bottleneck rather than a new function-calling model. The central question is how to build training data for tool use that is executable, diverse, multi-turn, and scalable across tools. Existing synthetic pipelines often fail for four recurring reasons: unreliable APIs, poor tool scalability, shallow scenario coverage, and weak quality control. As a result, models may learn output format compliance but still fail in realistic settings involving clarification turns, parameter completion, multi-tool composition, and history-dependent interaction. GenesisFunc is designed as an end-to-end pipeline that turns tool selection, dialogue synthesis, execution checking, and data filtering into a more controlled production process.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense; it sits closer to post-training data construction. Still, it matters for foundation-model researchers because tool use is increasingly the interface between pretrained models and external environments. The contribution is practical rather than paradigm-shifting. First, it pushes FC data generation beyond single-turn schema matching toward multi-turn, multi-task, history-aware dialogues. Second, it treats API reliability and executability as first-class constraints, instead of relying mainly on model-side self-evaluation. Third, it shows that the resulting data can support both SFT and subsequent RL for multi-turn tool use, which is relevant to the pretrain-to-posttrain loop. The paper is best read as a fairly complete recipe for synthetic FC data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three stages. Stage one is tool seed selection. Instead of scraping arbitrary APIs or handcrafting toy tools, the pipeline starts from curated tools in BFCL. The motivation is straightforward: if the API layer is noisy, later data generation only amplifies that noise. Stage two is the multi-agent dialogue generation module, which is the main technical component. The key idea is not merely to let several agents write a conversation, but to assign differentiated roles with history-aware coordination and parameter-slot control. In practice, different agents handle user intent construction, tool-use planning, parameter and unit filling, and dialogue continuation such as clarification, correction, or task switching. This makes the generated samples structurally richer: not just one user utterance followed by one tool call, but multi-turn interactions with context carryover and compositional tool usage. Stage three is a multi-stage evaluation module that combines rule-based checks, model-based scoring, and targeted human review. Rule-based checks focus on schema conformity, argument validity, and executability; model-based scoring covers dialogue quality and tool-use plausibility; human review is used as a final safeguard. The important design choice is to separate linguistic plausibility from actual executable correctness.
summary_en.experiments: The main setup fine-tunes Qwen3-8B on GenesisFunc-generated data and evaluates the resulting GenesisFunc-8B in zero-shot mode on BFCL, API-Bank, and ACEBench. The benchmark choice is deliberate: BFCL tests in-domain performance because the tool seeds come from there, while API-Bank and ACEBench probe transfer to unseen tool settings. The headline result is that GenesisFunc-8B consistently beats open-source baselines of similar scale under a unified evaluation protocol and remains competitive with API-based proprietary systems. The most useful experimental signals are qualitative in structure. First, stronger filtering improves both data executability and downstream FC success. Second, multi-agent generation yields better coverage of multi-turn and multi-task scenarios than simpler generation pipelines, especially when history tracking and parameter completion matter. Third, the generated data is not limited to SFT; the paper also reports that it can be used in an RL stage to further improve multi-turn function-calling behavior. The full text excerpt provided here does not include all tables and exact numbers, so the precise benchmark scores, gains, and dataset sizes should be checked directly in the experimental section and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the pipeline overview to pin down the problem formulation: this is a data-generation paper, not a new tool-learning architecture. Second, inspect the multi-agent generation module, especially role decomposition, history-aware generation, and parameter-slot selection, because that is where most of the novelty sits. Third, read the evaluation pipeline and ablations to see which failure modes are removed by rule checks, model scoring, and human review respectively. In the experiments, prioritize BFCL versus API-Bank/ACEBench transfer, and any breakdown by single-turn vs multi-turn or single-tool vs multi-tool settings. Around 30–40 minutes should be enough for the main ideas; read the appendix only if you want to reuse the prompts, filtering rules, or annotation protocol.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“FC 数据工厂”配方看：重点盯多阶段评估/过滤怎么做、失败样例是什么；若无强消融，结论当中等强度信号。
recommendation.en: Read it as a function-calling data-factory recipe: focus on the multi-stage eval/filtering and failure cases; without strong ablations, treat gains as medium-strength evidence.

paper.title: The Strongest Teacher Is Not Always the Best Teacher: Student-Centric Answer Selection
paper.abstract: LLM training increasingly relies on teacher-generated supervision, from synthetic responses to reasoning traces and tool-use demonstrations. Current practice often chooses the highest-performing teacher to generate student training data, implicitly treating teacher test performance as a proxy for teaching quality. We show that this assumption can fail: even when multiple teachers provide correct answers to the same question, the answer from the strongest teacher is not necessarily the best super

summary.core_problem: 在“多教师生成、答案都正确”的前提下，如何为特定学生模型选择更合适的监督答案：教师越强并不必然越会教，强教师生成的正确答案可能对当前学生的学习更新代价更高、反而学得更差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在数据合成/蒸馏与持续训练接口：1）把“合成数据质量”从 teacher-centric（看教师测评分）改成 student-centric（看学生当前参数状态下的学习成本）；2）提供一个可计算、近似前向的打分指标，适合在大规模合成数据管线里做在线/迭代式筛选；3）对多教师混合、self-distill、curriculum、以及 mid-train 阶段的“数据配比与难度控制”有直接可用的机制。它更偏 post-train/蒸馏 recipe，但方法论上能反哺 continual pretrain 的数据选择。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 SCAS（Student-Centric Answer Sampling）。设每个问题 q 有一组“已验证正确”的教师答案集合 A(q)，训练时不是固定选某个最强教师，而是在候选答案里按“学生中心学习成本”采样。
关键在于如何定义并高效估计学习成本：
- 从监督微调的梯度出发，考虑对学生某个权重矩阵 W 的梯度 ∂L/∂W 的平方 Frobenius 范数，作为该 (q,a) 序列对学生造成的更新负担。
- 将 token 位置划分为问题 token（conditioning, Q）与答案 token（A），把梯度范数展开成 token 两两内积的和，并分解成 AA（答案-答案）、AQ/QA（答案-问题交互）、QQ（问题-问题）三块。这个分解解释了“同样正确的答案”也会因为 token 交互结构不同而对学生产生不同更新压力。
- 为避免对每个候选答案都做反向传播，作者推导了一个 forward-only 的代理指标来近似上述学习成本（核心是用前向可得的表征与误差信号去估计梯度交互项），从而能在大候选池里快速打分。
- 训练时按该成本进行采样：优先选择低成本、与当前学生更匹配的答案，而不是默认选择最强教师的答案。整体是一个可迭代的过程：学生更新后，成本估计也随之变化，形成隐式 curriculum。
summary.experiments:
实验设置强调“控制变量”：比较不同教师的教学效果时，只在“九个教师都答对”的最大公共子集上生成训练数据，从而把差异尽量归因于答案作为监督的可学性，而不是正确率。
作者在 DeepScaleR、GSM8K、MATH 等任务上，用 Qwen2.5 不同尺寸学生做对比，观察到教师测试准确率与学生最终准确率不单调对应。
更大规模实验：从约 30 个开源/闭源模型收集候选答案，在 6 个学生基座、6 个任务上评估 SCAS。论文摘录未包含具体提升数字与统计显著性细节；需要在结果表中核对：
- SCAS 相对“选最强教师/随机选/按 teacher 分数选”的提升幅度；
- forward-only 代理与真实梯度成本的相关性；
- 采样温度/成本归一化等超参敏感性；
- 是否存在偏向短答案或模板化答案的副作用（这会影响泛化）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 45–60 分钟）：
- 先看引言里的 controlled comparison（九教师公共正确子集）与 Figure 2：这是“强教师不一定会教”的核心证据。
- 然后精读方法 2.2：forward-only 代理怎么从梯度分解落到可计算打分，哪些近似假设最关键。
- 最后看实验消融：代理相关性、不同学生规模下的收益、以及候选池大小对收益的影响。
如果只想拿来用：重点关注实现细节（验证正确性的流程、候选答案去重/过滤、以及在线更新时的计算开销）。

summary_en.core_problem: Given multiple verified-correct teacher answers per question, how to select supervision that best teaches a specific student model—since the highest-performing teacher’s answer is not necessarily the most learnable or beneficial for that student.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly to synthetic-data distillation and continual training pipelines: it reframes supervision quality as student-dependent, introduces a scalable scoring proxy that can be used in large answer pools, and implicitly implements a curriculum that adapts as the student changes. This is closer to post-training / distillation recipe work than core pretraining, but the data-selection principle is directly reusable in mid-training and continual pretraining where synthetic instruction data is mixed in.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SCAS (Student-Centric Answer Sampling) operates in a candidate-answer setting: for each question q, there is a set of verified-correct teacher answers A(q). Instead of picking the strongest teacher, SCAS samples answers according to an estimated student-centric learning cost.
The cost is motivated by gradient mechanics in SFT:
- Consider the squared Frobenius norm of the gradient on a student weight matrix W induced by the concatenated sequence x=[q;a].
- Expand the gradient norm into pairwise token interaction terms, then partition token indices into question (Q) and answer (A) positions, yielding AA (answer–answer), AQ/QA (answer–conditioning interactions), and QQ (conditioning–conditioning) blocks.
- This decomposition explains why two correct answers can differ in how much parameter change they demand from the current student.
- To avoid per-candidate backprop, the paper derives a forward-only proxy to approximate the learning cost using signals available from forward passes (representations and error-related quantities), enabling efficient scoring over large candidate pools.
Training then samples lower-cost answers more often, aligning supervision with the student’s current capabilities and effectively creating an adaptive curriculum.
summary_en.experiments:
A key design is a controlled teacher comparison: when evaluating “teaching quality,” they restrict training to the largest common subset of questions where all compared teachers are correct, so differences are not driven by answer correctness.
They test across reasoning tasks such as DeepScaleR, GSM8K, and MATH with Qwen2.5 students of multiple sizes, showing teacher test accuracy does not monotonically predict student gains.
They also collect candidate answers from ~30 open/closed models and evaluate across 6 student base models and 6 tasks. The provided excerpt does not include the exact deltas; in the full paper, the critical checks are: SCAS vs strongest-teacher selection, correlation between the proxy and true gradient cost, sensitivity to sampling hyperparameters, and whether the method implicitly favors shorter/more templated answers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes):
- Start with the controlled comparison setup (and the main figure showing non-monotonic teacher→student transfer). That is the empirical motivation.
- Then read the derivation of the forward-only proxy (Section 2.2): identify the approximations and what signals are required from the student forward pass.
- Finally, scan ablations: proxy-vs-true-cost correlation, gains across student sizes, and scaling with candidate pool size.
If you want to implement it, focus on the “verified correct” filtering pipeline, candidate deduplication, and the runtime overhead of scoring during iterative training.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它直接挑战“强教师=好监督”这个偷懒 prior；先看方法推导和多教师对比表，若 proxy 与真实学习收益相关性站得住，内部数据筛选策略该立刻重做。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it directly challenges the lazy prior that the strongest teacher gives the best supervision; check the proxy derivation and multi-teacher tables first—if the correlation with actual student gain is clean, your synthetic data selection pipeline likely needs revision.

paper.title: CUA-Gym: Scaling Verifiable Training Environments and Tasks for Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven breakthroughs in domains such as math, tool-use, and software engineering, yet its extension to computer-use agents (CUAs) has been bottlenecked by the scarcity of scalable training data with deterministic rewards. Constructing such data for CUAs requires consistent task instruction, executable environment, and verifiable reward. However, hand-curated benchmarks achieve high reward fidelity but cover few applications and LLM-as-jud

summary.core_problem: 计算机使用代理（CUA）的可验证强化学习（RLVR）训练存在结构性数据瓶颈：手工构建的基准应用覆盖范围窄，LLM打分的数据集奖励信号不可靠，代码原生环境管道规模有限。没有现有方法能同时满足CUA RLVR的三个核心要求：确定性可验证奖励、广泛应用覆盖、可扩展任务多样性，导致CUA无法复刻数学、代码领域RLVR带来的能力跃升。
summary.importance: 将RLVR的规模化数据合成范式拓展到CUA领域，打通了CUA能力 scaling 的核心数据瓶颈；提出环境多样性是独立于任务数据量的新增scaling轴，补充了现有智能体scaling law的研究维度；生成的数据集和可复用环境池可直接支撑开源CUA基座的RL后训练，验证了小参数量MoE模型通过RLVR可匹配10倍参数的未训练基座性能，为低资源智能体训练提供了可落地的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 多代理协同的任务三元组联合生成管道：Generator代理构造初始环境和任务完成后的黄金环境，Discriminator代理仅基于任务描述编写奖励函数，Orchestrator代理驱动二者迭代验证，直到奖励函数能在执行时准确区分两种环境状态；2. 采用严格信息隔离机制防止奖励黑客，最后通过LLM多数投票+代理轨迹回放过滤不合格样本；3. 环境规模化方案：基于O*NET职业分类和Anthropic经济指数的软件使用分布选择目标应用，通过多代理合成自包含的模拟网页应用并做自动化交互测试，形成可复用、可重置的CUA-GYM-HUB环境池，将环境构建与任务生成解耦，每个环境可生成数千个不同任务。
summary.experiments: 生成32112个经过验证的RLVR训练三元组，覆盖110个环境（16个桌面应用+94个模拟网页应用）；使用GSPO算法在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B和Qwen3.5-397B-A17B两个MoE基座上做RLVR训练，在OSWorld-Verified基准上分别达到62.1%和72.6%的准确率，35B模型的性能与未训练的397B基座相当，参数量仅为后者的1/10左右；训练后的模型在WebArena基准上也有性能提升，验证了模拟环境到真实浏览器的迁移性；性能随数据量和环境池规模平滑提升，环境池从10个扩展到80个带来的收益无法通过单纯增加轨迹数量覆盖；RL训练自发涌现多动作工具调用能力，相同任务性能下轨迹长度压缩33%-45%。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第3章的多代理生成管道设计细节，重点关注信息隔离和迭代验证机制；精读第4章的环境规模化方法和CUA-GYM-HUB的实现逻辑；重点看第5章的scaling实验结果，尤其是环境多样性与数据量的scaling曲线对比，以及RL训练涌现多动作调用的消融分析；附录的环境列表和数据过滤规则可作为实际构建训练数据的参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Scalable verifiable reinforcement learning (RLVR) training data for computer-use agents (CUAs) faces a structural bottleneck: hand-curated benchmarks have narrow application coverage, LLM-as-judge datasets produce unreliable reward signals, and code-native environment pipelines lack sufficient scale. No existing approach simultaneously meets the three core requirements for CUA RLVR: deterministic verifiable rewards, broad application coverage, and scalable task diversity, preventing CUAs from replicating the capability gains RLVR has delivered in math and code domains.
summary_en.importance: It extends the scalable RLVR data synthesis paradigm to the CUA domain, removing the core data bottleneck for CUA capability scaling. It identifies environment diversity as an independent scaling axis complementary to task volume, expanding existing research on agent scaling laws. The released dataset and reusable environment pool directly support RL post-training for open-source CUA base models, and validates that smaller MoE models can match the performance of 10x larger untrained base models via RLVR, providing actionable guidance for low-resource agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. A multi-agent collaborative pipeline for joint generation of task tuples: a Generator agent constructs the initial environment state and golden post-task state, a Discriminator agent writes reward functions solely based on task descriptions, and an Orchestrator agent drives iterative refinement until the reward function reliably distinguishes the two states during execution. 2. Strict information isolation prevents reward hacking, and a final filtering step combining LLM majority voting and agent rollouts removes low-quality tuples. 3. An environment scaling framework: target applications are selected based on O*NET occupational taxonomies and Anthropic Economic Index software usage distributions. Multi-agent synthesis builds self-contained mock web applications with automated interactive testing, forming the reusable, resettable CUA-GYM-HUB environment pool that decouples environment construction from task generation, enabling thousands of distinct tasks per environment.
summary_en.experiments: The pipeline produces 32,112 verified RLVR training tuples across 110 environments (16 desktop applications + 94 synthetic mock web applications). RLVR training with GSPO on two open-source MoE backbones (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) reaches 62.1% and 72.6% accuracy respectively on OSWorld-Verified, with the 35B model matching the performance of the untrained 397B base at ~1/10 the parameter count. Trained checkpoints also show improvements on the WebArena benchmark, demonstrating transfer from synthetic mock environments to real browser settings. Performance scales smoothly with both data volume and environment pool size; expanding the environment pool from 10 to 80 delivers gains that cannot be replicated by increasing trajectory volume alone. RL training also spontaneously induces multi-action tool calls, reducing trajectory length by 33-45% at matched task performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for details of the multi-agent generation pipeline, especially the information isolation and iterative verification mechanisms. Read Section 4 for the environment scaling methodology and CUA-GYM-HUB implementation logic. Prioritize Section 5's scaling experiment results, specifically the comparison of environment diversity vs. data volume scaling curves, and ablation analysis of emergent multi-action tool calls. The appendix environment list and data filtering rules serve as a practical reference for building custom training datasets.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法和过滤 ablation；它把 RLVR 的瓶颈从“有没有题”推进到“奖励函数能否被程序化合成”。
recommendation.en: Read the method and filtering ablations; it shifts the RLVR bottleneck from task availability to whether reward functions can be programmatically synthesized.

paper.title: AnE: Pushing the Reasoning Frontier of Multimodal LLMs via Anchor Evolution
paper.abstract: Post-training via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) is crucial for enhancing reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet existing paradigms often reach a performance bottleneck due to the limitations of static data. While current methods leverage self-reflection or self-evolution to push these boundaries, they still suffer from cognitive drift and hallucinated reasoning paths caused by low-quality synthetic data. To address these challenges, we propose A

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多模态推理模型在后训练阶段很容易遇到的一个具体瓶颈：静态 SFT/RL 数据很快被模型吃干，后续提升缺少针对性；而纯自演化合成数据虽然能持续扩展难度，却容易把错误推理路径、幻觉知识和教师分布偏差一并放大。论文想解决的不是单次训练技巧，而是如何让后训练数据随着模型能力一起演化，同时又不把训练过程带偏。它把问题落在“失败前沿”上：先找出模型当前最容易出错、但又最有提升空间的区域，再用可验证的真实知识作为锚点去扩展训练样本，最后把外部提示逐步蒸馏成模型自身能力。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它虽然是多模态 post-train 工作，但核心关切其实是训练信号质量与数据闭环设计，这和预训练里的数据配比、数据清洗、持续训练中的分布漂移问题是同一类问题。第二，它给出了一种比“模型自己造数据再自己学”更稳的演化路线：用真实数据库检索到的 truth anchors 约束数据生成，再用 SFT+RL 分工完成能力注入与模板去除。这个思路对 reasoning continual training、mid-train curriculum、以及 RL 不能凭空创造新能力的讨论都有直接参考价值。贡献量级上，它更像一个扎实的训练框架与数据构造范式，而不是新的基础模型架构。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三个环节组成，而且三者是串起来的。第一步是 Failing-Frontier Discovery。作者不是直接在全量种子集上做扩充，而是先让当前模型对种子数据做多次 rollout，观察哪些题目稳定失败、哪些推理轨迹暴露出明显短板。随后再用教师模型对这些失败样本做诊断，抽取失败相关的关键词、知识点和提示信息。这样做的目的，是把后续数据构造对准模型当前能力边界，而不是泛泛增加训练量。

第二步是 Truth Anchor Expansion。这是全文最关键的设计。作者不信任闭环自生成数据的事实性和逻辑一致性，因此引入外部真实数据库，从失败样本对应的知识点出发检索“truth anchors”。这些 anchor 不是直接当答案，而是作为高保真参考，用来构造新的训练样本、补充背景知识、校正推理链中的事实节点。和常见 self-evolution 不同，这里数据扩展的约束来自外部可验证知识，而不是教师模型自由发挥。这样可以减少 synthetic QA 中常见的逻辑错配、答案漂移和越迭代越偏的问题。

第三步是 Scaffold-Stripping Mechanism。作者把教师提示显式写进训练样本，先形成 scaffold-augmented supervision，让模型在带脚手架的条件下学会正确推理路径；然后再通过 RL 去掉这些脚手架，让模型不依赖固定提示模板也能完成推理。这里的分工很清楚：SFT 负责把新知识和正确轨迹灌进去，RL 负责把外显提示内化成行为习惯。这个设计背后有一个明确判断：如果直接用 RL 从稀疏正确率奖励里学复杂多模态推理，信号太弱；如果只做 SFT，模型又容易记住模板而不是形成稳定能力。

从方法定位看，AnE 不是单纯的数据检索增强，也不是普通 teacher-student 蒸馏。它更像一个面向 reasoning frontier 的迭代式训练循环：失败诊断决定学什么，truth anchor 决定学的内容是否可信，scaffold stripping 决定能力能否脱离外部支架独立存在。
summary.experiments:
论文以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 为底座，在 8 个多模态推理 benchmark 上评测。文中给出的总结果是：相对 base model，AnE 多轮迭代后平均提升 10.3%。作者特别强调在 MathVision 和 EMMA 这类较难数据集上保持了领先表现，说明收益不只来自简单题或分布内题目。

从实验结构看，最值得注意的不是单个分数，而是“持续提升”这一点。作者把 AnE 和静态数据后训练、以及纯 self-evolution 路线做比较，结论是静态数据方法很快进入平台期，而 AnE 在多轮迭代中还能继续涨，说明 failing frontier 驱动的数据更新确实在不断对准新短板。另一组关键对比是 truth anchor 的作用：去掉真实锚点后，性能提升会变弱，而且更容易出现 reasoning drift，说明外部可验证知识不是锦上添花，而是闭环演化能否稳定的核心条件。

脚手架机制的消融也很重要。只做 scaffold SFT 而不做后续 RL，模型会更依赖提示格式，泛化和自由生成能力不足；只做 RL 而没有前面的 scaffold supervision，则很难稳定学到正确轨迹。两者结合时效果最好，和作者在引言里对 SFT 与 RL 分工的判断一致。

受限于给出的全文片段，部分 benchmark 的逐项数字、迭代轮数细节、以及各消融的精确幅度没有完全展开；但从正文描述可以确认，实验重点是验证三件事：一是相对静态数据的持续增益，二是相对纯合成演化的数据质量优势，三是 SFT 注入 + RL 内化这一训练分工的必要性。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只花一小时，优先看三处。第一是方法总览图和 Failing-Frontier Discovery 部分，理解作者如何定义“失败前沿”，以及为什么要用多次 rollout 而不是单次错误样本筛选。这里关系到整个框架是不是在做真正的 targeted training。第二是 Truth Anchor Expansion 的实现细节，重点看 anchor 的来源、检索条件、如何从 anchor 构造成新样本，以及它和教师生成内容各自承担什么角色。这里决定这篇工作的含金量。第三是 scaffold-stripping 的训练流程和消融表，判断 RL 到底是在提升正确率，还是在做模板去除与行为内化。

图表上建议重点看：总框架图、不同迭代轮次的性能曲线、truth anchor 与无 anchor 的对比、以及 scaffold/RL 相关消融。如果有案例分析，优先看失败样本如何被诊断、检索、再构造成训练数据，这能直接看出方法是否真的避免了 synthetic drift。

值得深挖的点有三个。其一，truth anchor 的质量上限由外部数据库覆盖率决定，这会不会把方法限制在可检索知识密集的任务上。其二，教师模型在失败诊断和提示生成中仍然扮演重要角色，教师偏差是否会通过 scaffold 间接注入。其三，这套框架能否迁移到纯文本 reasoning continual pretrain，或者更一般的 mid-training data refresh 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in multimodal reasoning post-training: static SFT/RL datasets saturate quickly, while self-evolving synthetic data can keep expanding but often amplifies logical errors, hallucinated reasoning paths, and teacher-distribution mismatch. The real problem is not just data scarcity. It is how to keep training data adaptive to the model’s current failure frontier without letting the optimization loop drift away from reliable knowledge. AnE frames this as a closed-loop evolution problem: identify where the model currently fails, retrieve verified external anchors around those failures, and then convert teacher-guided reasoning into internalized capability.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the value is less about multimodal benchmark chasing and more about training-signal design. The paper is a useful case study in how data quality, adaptivity, and distribution alignment interact in iterative training. It also reinforces a view that has become increasingly important in reasoning work: SFT is better at injecting new patterns and knowledge, while RL is better at consolidating and de-scaffolding behavior. In that sense, AnE is relevant to continual pretraining, mid-training curriculum refresh, and any setting where synthetic data loops risk compounding model errors. The contribution is a practical training paradigm rather than a new base architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AnE consists of three tightly coupled stages.

First, Failing-Frontier Discovery. Instead of expanding data uniformly, the model is rolled out multiple times on a seed set to expose unstable or consistently failing regions. A teacher model then analyzes these failures and extracts failure-relevant keywords, hints, and diagnostic signals. This makes the next round of training target the model’s current capability boundary rather than a generic task distribution.

Second, Truth Anchor Expansion. This is the central idea. Rather than trusting synthetic QA pairs generated inside a self-evolution loop, the method retrieves verified samples from an external real-world database as truth anchors. These anchors are used as high-fidelity references for constructing new training examples, enriching missing knowledge, and correcting factual or logical nodes in reasoning chains. The key distinction from standard self-evolution is that data growth is constrained by externally grounded evidence, not only by teacher generations. That directly addresses cognitive drift and hallucinated trajectories.

Third, Scaffold-Stripping Mechanism. Teacher hints are first injected explicitly into training examples, producing scaffold-augmented supervision for SFT. This gives the student a guided path toward correct reasoning. RL is then used to remove the scaffolds, so the model learns to reproduce the behavior without depending on explicit templates or hints. The division of labor is deliberate: SFT introduces the reasoning pattern and missing knowledge; RL turns externally visible guidance into an internalized policy.

Conceptually, AnE is not just retrieval augmentation and not just distillation. It is an iterative reasoning-training loop where failure diagnosis decides what to learn, truth anchors decide what can be trusted, and scaffold stripping decides whether the learned behavior survives after the support is removed.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the base model and evaluate on eight multimodal reasoning benchmarks. The headline result reported in the paper is an average improvement of 10.3% over the base model after multiple AnE iterations. The paper also highlights strong performance on difficult benchmarks such as MathVision and EMMA.

The more interesting result is the shape of improvement over iterations. Static-data post-training reaches a plateau relatively early, while AnE continues to improve across rounds, which supports the claim that failure-frontier targeting keeps exposing useful new supervision. Another important comparison is the role of truth anchors. Removing the anchor mechanism weakens gains and makes the evolution loop more prone to reasoning drift, suggesting that verified external grounding is not optional but central to stability.

The scaffold mechanism is also tested through ablations. Scaffolded SFT without the RL stripping stage tends to leave the model dependent on prompt-like support. RL without prior scaffold supervision struggles to learn stable reasoning from sparse answer rewards alone. The combination works best, matching the paper’s broader argument about the complementary roles of SFT and RL.

The provided full-text excerpt does not expose every benchmark-level number or all ablation magnitudes, but the experimental logic is clear: sustained gains over iterative rounds, better stability than synthetic-only evolution, and a meaningful benefit from the SFT-then-RL decomposition.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the method overview figure and the section on Failing-Frontier Discovery. The key question is whether the paper is truly doing targeted training or just relabeling hard-example mining. Then read Truth Anchor Expansion carefully. Focus on where anchors come from, how retrieval is conditioned on failures, and how anchors are turned into new supervision. That is the part that determines whether the framework is genuinely more reliable than synthetic self-evolution.

After that, read the scaffold-stripping section together with its ablations. The main thing to verify is what RL is actually contributing: better reasoning, better template removal, or both. If the paper includes case studies, inspect examples where a failed trajectory is diagnosed, linked to an anchor, and reconstructed into a training sample. Those examples are often more revealing than aggregate scores.

The most useful figures and tables are the iterative performance curves, anchor vs. no-anchor comparisons, and scaffold/RL ablations. For deeper follow-up, three questions matter: how dependent the method is on database coverage, how much teacher bias still enters through failure diagnosis and hints, and whether the same recipe could transfer to text-only reasoning continual training.

recommendation.zh: 后训练里少见地把“失败前沿定位 + 真值锚定”讲成了可执行 recipe；先看数据构造部分，若 setup 干净，值得迁到 reasoning data pipeline 里试。
recommendation.en: One of the few post-training papers that turns 'failure-frontier mining + ground-truth anchoring' into an actionable recipe; read the data-construction part first and port it if the setup is clean.

paper.title: QUEST: Training Frontier Deep Research Agents with Fully Synthetic Tasks
paper.abstract: Deep research agents extend the role of search engines from retrieving keyword-matched pages to synthesizing knowledge, fundamentally changing how humans interact with information. However, frontier systems remain proprietary, while existing open agents often generalize poorly across different task types, leaving unclear how to train a broadly capable deep research agent. We release QUEST, a family of open models (ranging from 2B to 35B) that serve as general-purpose deep research agents designe

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单点能力，而是“通用 deep research agent 怎么训练”这个配方问题。作者把任务拆成三类彼此相关但训练信号不同的能力：fact seeking、citation grounding、report synthesis。难点在于，这三类能力横跨客观可验证任务和开放式主观任务，现有开源工作通常只覆盖其中一类，或者只有 SFT，没有把中期训练、长轨迹上下文管理、rubric 驱动的 RL 放进同一套流程里。Quest 试图回答的是：在完全开源、且大量依赖合成任务的条件下，能否训练出一个在长时程检索、证据归因和报告写作上都比较均衡的研究代理。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发大于对纯 pretrain 本身的直接推进。它的重要性主要有三点。第一，它把 deep research agent 的训练拆成可复现的 recipe：mid-training → SFT → RL，而不是只给一个 agent scaffold。第二，它强调“任务可验证性结构”本身就是训练信号设计的核心，尤其是 tree-structured rubric 这一层，把开放式报告任务也部分转成了可优化的分层奖励。第三，它给出一个比较清楚的结论：如果目标是长时程信息搜集与综合，单靠 instruction tuning 不够，模型需要在中期训练阶段先适应搜索式轨迹和外部证据读写，再用 rubric 奖励做能力整合。对做通用 agent pretraining、tool-use mid-training、以及 synthetic curriculum 的人，这篇比单纯 benchmark paper 更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三根主线。第一是数据合成。作者构建 Quest-8K，一条样本不是简单的 query-answer，而是“复杂查询 + task-specific rubric tree”。这个 rubric tree 用来刻画完成任务需要覆盖的子问题、证据要求和输出结构，因此它既是监督信号，也是后续 RL 的奖励依据。相比只合成最终答案，这种做法更适合长时程任务，因为 agent 的中间行为和最终报告都能被分层评估。

第二是上下文管理。长轨迹 web research 的典型问题是上下文爆炸：搜索结果、网页片段、已发现事实、未解决子问题会迅速堆积。Quest 引入 compact summary 式的 context management，在轨迹推进过程中持续维护压缩后的信息状态，而不是把完整历史无差别塞回上下文。这个设计的意义不只是省 token，更是在训练时显式鼓励“记忆抽象”而不是“原文堆叠”。对 agent 来说，这比普通 RAG 式拼接更接近真实工作流。

第三是训练流程。论文强调完整配方是 MT、SFT、RL 三阶段，而不是任选其一。mid-training 用来让底座模型适应 deep research 相关分布和行为模式；SFT 负责把任务格式、工具调用、报告输出对齐到目标接口；RL 则利用 rubric-based signal 做最后的能力整合，尤其补 report synthesis 和 citation grounding 这类难以靠 exact match 学好的目标。与已有开源系统相比，Quest 的差异不在某个单独模块，而在于把三类能力放进统一训练目标，并且让客观任务和开放任务共享一套 rubric 驱动优化框架。
summary.experiments:
从文中给出的主结果看，Quest 覆盖 2B 到 35B 多个尺度，并在 8 个 benchmark 上评估三类能力。最关键的几个数字是：Quest-35B 在 BrowseComp 上 64.6%，在 Mind2Web 2 上 30.7%，在 DeepResearch Bench 上 48.2%，作者声称超过 OpenAI DeepResearch 等强闭源系统。这个结果如果按论文设定成立，说明统一 recipe 没有明显牺牲某一类能力来换另一类能力。

更有信息量的是训练阶段消融。图 2 和正文都在强调，已有开源方法往往只做 fact seeking 或 report synthesis，且常缺 mid-training 或 rubric RL。Quest 的对比意图很明确：只做 SFT 的系统能力覆盖不完整；加入 MT 后，模型对搜索式任务和长轨迹状态管理更稳；再加 RL，开放式报告和引用约束进一步提升。虽然当前给出的全文片段没有完整消融表数字，但作者明确把 controlled studies 作为主要贡献之一，并且指出小模型也能受益：Quest-2B-SFT、Quest-4B-SFT 已经有“impressive performance”。这说明收益不只来自大模型容量，也来自训练信号设计。

另一个值得注意的实验结论是 scaling。作者覆盖 2B、4B、9B 到 35B，意图展示 deep research agent 能力随模型规模提升，但不是只有大模型才可用。对隐私敏感场景，本地可部署的小模型 research agent 被单独点出，这意味着他们观察到 recipe 在小尺度上也有较好的 sample efficiency 或任务迁移性。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐段细抠。建议先看 Introduction 里对三类能力的定义，以及 Figure 2 的训练配方对比，先建立作者到底在补什么缺口。然后重点看数据合成部分，尤其 Quest-8K 和 rubric tree 的构造方式；这里决定了后面 RL 信号是否可信。再看 context management 章节，关注它维护了什么状态、压缩频率如何、是否会丢失证据链。最后看训练与消融，重点确认三件事：MT 到底喂了什么数据；RL 的 reward 如何从 rubric tree 落到可执行打分；不同能力上哪一阶段贡献最大。

如果时间只有 20–30 分钟，建议顺序是：Figure 1/2 → 数据合成章节 → 训练 recipe 章节 → 主结果表。若要深挖，优先看 rubric-based RL 的实现细节，因为这部分最接近可迁移的方法论；其次看小模型结果，判断这套配方到底是在“放大底座能力”，还是主要依赖大模型先验。
summary.authors_note: OSU NLP 团队；从正文页眉可见为 Ohio State University 相关工作。当前给出的全文片段未包含完整作者列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a recipe question rather than a single capability: how to train a broadly capable deep-research agent in an open and reproducible way. The authors frame the problem around three coupled abilities with different supervision regimes: fact seeking, citation grounding, and report synthesis. Existing open systems usually cover only one slice of this space, or rely on SFT alone, leaving unclear how to combine long-horizon search behavior, evidence tracking, and open-ended writing into one trainable pipeline. Quest is an attempt to build that unified recipe under fully synthetic task generation.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is at the pretrain/post-train boundary, not in core language-model pretraining alone. Three points matter. First, it turns deep-research-agent training into a concrete stack: mid-training, then SFT, then RL, instead of presenting only an agent framework. Second, it argues that task structure itself should be part of the training signal; the tree-structured rubric is not just an evaluator, but a way to make open-ended report writing partially optimizable. Third, it suggests that instruction tuning alone is insufficient for long-horizon evidence-seeking agents. Models benefit from an intermediate adaptation stage to search-style trajectories and external evidence handling, followed by rubric-based RL to integrate capabilities. That makes the paper relevant to tool-use mid-training, synthetic curricula, and agent-oriented continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. The first is synthetic data construction. Quest-8K is built as more than query-answer pairs: each instance couples a complex research query with a task-specific rubric tree. The rubric encodes subgoals, evidence requirements, and output structure, so it serves both as supervision and as the basis for downstream reward design. Compared with synthesizing only final answers, this is better aligned with long-horizon tasks because both intermediate behavior and final reports can be assessed in a structured way.

The second component is context management. Long web-research trajectories quickly run into context bloat: search results, snippets, discovered facts, unresolved subproblems, and partial drafts all accumulate. Quest maintains compact summaries of the evolving information state instead of naively replaying the full history into the context window. This is not only a token-saving trick. It pushes the model toward abstraction and state tracking, which is closer to how a practical research agent should operate than simple retrieval concatenation.

The third component is the training pipeline itself. The paper emphasizes a full MT → SFT → RL recipe. Mid-training adapts the base model to the distribution and behavior patterns of deep-research tasks. SFT aligns the model to the target interfaces for tool use, task formatting, and report generation. RL then uses rubric-based signals to improve the harder objectives, especially report synthesis and citation grounding, where exact-match supervision is weak or unavailable. The novelty is less about a single module and more about unifying objective and open-ended tasks under one rubric-driven optimization framework.
summary_en.experiments:
The reported results span model sizes from 2B to 35B and evaluate across eight benchmarks covering the three capability groups. The headline numbers are Quest-35B reaching 64.6% on BrowseComp, 30.7% on Mind2Web 2, and 48.2% on DeepResearch Bench, with the paper claiming it surpasses strong proprietary systems including OpenAI DeepResearch. If these results hold under the paper’s setup, the important point is that the unified recipe does not appear to trade away one capability class to gain another.

The more informative part is the stage-wise ablation story. Figure 2 and the surrounding discussion make a clear argument: prior open systems often support only fact seeking or only report synthesis, and many omit either mid-training or rubric-based RL. Quest is designed to show that SFT alone gives incomplete coverage; adding mid-training improves adaptation to search-style tasks and long-horizon state handling; adding RL further improves open-ended report quality and citation-constrained behavior. The excerpt provided here does not include the full ablation tables, but the paper explicitly positions controlled studies as a core contribution.

Another notable result is scaling behavior. The study covers 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B models, aiming to show that deep-research-agent capability scales with model size but is not exclusive to large models. The authors also highlight strong small-model results, including Quest-2B-SFT and Quest-4B-SFT, suggesting that the gains come not only from model capacity but also from better training signals and task structure.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, so read for recipe design rather than implementation minutiae. Start with the introduction and Figure 2 to understand the gap the authors are trying to fill: unified support for fact seeking, citation grounding, and report synthesis. Then read the synthetic data section carefully, especially how Quest-8K and the rubric trees are built, because that determines whether the later RL signal is meaningful. After that, inspect the context-management section and ask what state is preserved, how aggressively it is compressed, and whether evidence chains are lost. Finish with the training and ablation sections, focusing on three questions: what exactly is used in mid-training, how rubric trees are converted into executable rewards, and which stage contributes most to each capability.

If time is limited to 20–30 minutes, the best path is Figure 1/2, then the data synthesis section, then the training recipe, then the main result tables. If you want one part to study more deeply, choose the rubric-based RL design. That is the most transferable idea in the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: OSU NLP / Ohio State University. The provided excerpt does not include the full author list.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“全合成任务+可验证奖励”这条训练接口，不一定改变 agent prior，但很可能给 post-train 数据工厂和 mid-train 设计提供可复用模板；先看数据管线和 RL reward 定义。
recommendation.en: Read it for the synthetic-task plus verifiable-reward training interface; it may not change agent priors, but it is a plausible template for post-training data factories and mid-training design.

paper.title: RankJudge: A Multi-Turn LLM-as-a-Judge Synthetic Benchmark Generator
paper.abstract: As interactive LLM-based applications are created and refined, model developers need to evaluate the quality of generated text along many possible axes. For simpler systems, human evaluation may be practical, but in complicated systems like conversational chatbots, the amount of generated text can overwhelm human annotation resources. Model developers have begun to rely heavily on auto-evaluation, where LLMs are also used to judge generation quality. However, existing LLM-as-a-judge benchmarks l

summary.core_problem: RankJudge 解决的是 LLM-as-a-Judge 自身如何被可靠评测的问题，重点放在多轮、基于参考文档的对话场景。现有 judge benchmark 多数只评单轮问答，难以暴露跨轮矛盾、约束遗失、引用依据错误等真实助手系统中的常见失败。更关键的是，只看判哪边更好，会把“判断正确”和“理由正确”混在一起。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 和模型发布评测很有用。judge 模型现在常被用于偏好数据筛选、checkpoint 选择、自动打分和 leaderboard 排名。如果 judge 的能力边界不清，训练信号会被污染，模型选择也会偏移。RankJudge 的价值在于把 judge 评测从 verdict accuracy 推到更细粒度的诊断：不仅要选对更好的对话，还要指出错误发生在哪一轮、属于哪类失败。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是一个合成 benchmark generator。每个样本包含两段基于同一参考文档生成的多轮对话，其中较差的一段只在一个指定轮次注入一种指定失败类型。生成时同时控制两个轴：用户行为 archetype 和助手失败类型。这样 ground truth 在生成提示中已经确定，包括 better conversation、flawed turn 和 failure category。评测时，judge 需要联合预测三元组，只有三项都正确才算正确。这比只做 pairwise preference 更严格，可以过滤掉凭整体印象猜对 verdict 的情况。为降低合成数据噪声，RankJudge 使用三层自动 verifier 检查对话一致性、指令遵循和文档 grounding，并要求非目标错误之外的内容都被参考文档支持。之后再用 Bradley-Terry / Elo 对 item 难度建模，剔除最高难度尾部，因为这部分在人工审计和 held-out fine-tuning 实验中都更容易对应标签噪声。
summary.experiments: 实验构造了三个知识密集领域的评测集：Machine Learning、Biomedicine 和 Finance。作者评测了 21 个 proprietary 和 open-weight judge。leaderboard 在 Elo 尺度上拉开接近 1200 分的差距，说明该任务对 judge 能力有较强区分度。部分 open-weight checkpoint 排在一些 proprietary judge 之前。排名在 match subsampling、较粗粒度 correctness criterion、EIP cross-check 下保持稳定。弱 judge 还表现出系统性类别偏置：预测会塌缩到少数 failure category，而不是在错误类型空间内合理分布。对一个中等排名的 frontier judge 做 targeted prompt rewrite，也未能把它推到 accuracy-cost Pareto frontier，说明某些差距不是简单提示词能补上的。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，样本生成部分，尤其是如何把 user behavior 和 assistant failure 解耦；第二，joint correctness 设计，它决定了这个 benchmark 和普通 pairwise judge benchmark 的差异；第三，Elo-based curation 和 human audit / held-out fine-tuning 的对应关系，这部分关系到合成评测集的可信度。leaderboard 结果可以快速扫读，重点关注弱 judge 的 failure category collapse 和 prompt rewrite 失败的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: RankJudge targets the evaluation of LLM-as-a-judge systems in multi-turn, reference-grounded conversations. Most existing judge benchmarks focus on isolated single-turn answers, so they miss failures that arise over interaction: contradictions across turns, dropped constraints, and unsupported document-grounded claims. A second issue is diagnostic ambiguity. A judge may pick the better conversation while attributing the error to the wrong turn or the wrong failure type.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining method, but it matters for the training and release pipeline. Judge models are increasingly used to filter preference data, compare checkpoints, score model outputs, and build leaderboards. If the judge is weak, downstream optimization can reward the wrong behavior. RankJudge is useful because it evaluates not only the final preference decision, but also whether the judge can localize and classify the underlying failure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is generated synthetically. Each item contains two multi-turn conversations grounded in the same reference document. One branch contains exactly one injected flaw at a known turn, with a known failure category. The generator conditions on two axes: a user behavior archetype and a targeted assistant failure type. This makes the ground-truth tuple—better conversation, flawed turn, and failure category—available before any judge sees the item. At evaluation time, a judge must predict all three components, and credit is given only when the full tuple matches. This is stricter than pairwise preference accuracy and separates correct reasoning from lucky verdicts. To control label noise, the pipeline uses a three-layer verifier cascade for coherence, adherence, and grounding, then applies Bradley-Terry / Elo modeling to estimate item difficulty and remove the highest-difficulty tail. Human audit and a held-out fine-tuning experiment both identify this tail as a noisier slice.
summary_en.experiments: The authors instantiate RankJudge in three knowledge-intensive domains: machine learning, biomedicine, and finance. They evaluate 21 proprietary and open-weight judge models. The resulting leaderboard spans nearly 1200 Elo points, indicating strong separation among judges. Some open-weight checkpoints rank above proprietary judges. The ranking remains stable under match subsampling, a coarser correctness criterion, and an EIP cross-check. The analysis also shows a capability ceiling for weaker judges: their predictions collapse onto a small set of failure categories instead of distributing across the taxonomy. Prompt rewrites for a mid-ranked frontier judge do not move it onto the accuracy-cost Pareto frontier, suggesting that the gap is not only a prompting issue.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. The most useful parts are the item construction procedure, the joint correctness formulation, and the verifier-plus-Elo curation pipeline. The leaderboard can be read selectively; the more informative pieces are the failure-category collapse analysis and the prompt-rewrite experiment, because they show where judge capability fails beyond simple verdict accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 读生成协议和 flaw taxonomy 即可；它比普通 judge 榜单更干净，适合拿来压测 reward/eval 模型。
recommendation.en: Skim the generation protocol and flaw taxonomy; it is cleaner than typical judge leaderboards and useful for stress-testing reward or eval models.

paper.title: SynAE: A Framework for Measuring the Quality of Synthetic Data for Tool-Calling Agent Evaluations
paper.abstract: Today, tool-calling agents are commonly evaluated or tested on static datasets of execution traces, including input commands, agent responses, and associated tool calls. However, internal production datasets are often insufficient or unusable for testing; for example, they may contain sensitive or proprietary data, or they may be too sparse to support comprehensive testing (especially pre-deployment). In these settings, practitioners are increasingly replacing or augmenting real datasets with sy

summary.core_problem: 当真实的 agent 轨迹数据（多轮指令-响应、工具调用、工具输出、最终答案）因为隐私/稀缺无法用于测试时，团队会用合成数据替代或补充；但缺少一套量化方法来回答“这份合成 benchmark 到底有多像真实数据、覆盖了哪些空白、会不会误导评测”。论文要解决的是：给出一个面向 tool-calling agent 评测数据的质量度量框架，而不是评测 agent 本身。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的间接价值在于“评测数据与合成数据质量控制”的工程化框架：它把合成数据质量拆成 validity/fidelity/diversity 三类属性，并把工具调用与多轮依赖纳入度量对象。对做 post-train 数据合成、或做 agent 能力回归测试的团队，这类框架能减少“合成数据看起来合理但评测结论漂移”的风险。但它不直接触及预训练 recipe/优化动态，更多属于 eval/agent 测试基础设施。
summary.technical_approach:
SynAE 输入：真实基准数据集、合成数据集、可选的度量配置与一个或多个 LLM agent（用于对比 real vs synthetic 的下游表现，agent 本身不一定是被评测对象）。输出三类指标：
- Validity：合成轨迹里的工具调用与输出是否真的满足指令；默认用 LLM-as-a-judge，也支持有规则检查器时用规则。
- Fidelity：真实与合成在多种统计/表示上的相似度；做法是对两边分别计算一组指标，再比较其一致性。
- Diversity：用熵等度量衡量合成数据在指令、响应、工具调用、输出等表征空间的覆盖度。
指标覆盖对象不仅是自然语言指令/回复，还包括 tool calls、final outputs，以及“下游评测表现是否保持一致”（即用 agent 跑两套数据看排名/成功率差异）。论文还用定制的合成策略模拟常见坑（保真度下降、模式坍塌导致多样性不足），用来验证指标敏感性。
summary.experiments:
以三个近期 agent benchmark 作为“真实数据”来源：T1、BFCL、ACP；再用 NVIDIA NeMo 等工具生成合成数据，并构造带缺陷的合成集（例如降低 fidelity、限制 diversity）。实验结论是：
- SynAE 的 validity/fidelity/diversity 指标能区分这些受控退化；
- 单一指标不足以刻画合成数据质量，需要组合视角；
- 通过加入“下游评测一致性”可以发现某些表面相似但会改变 agent 评测结论的合成偏差。
（你提供的正文片段未包含完整结果表与具体数值，因此无法可靠复述每个 benchmark 上的定量提升幅度或阈值设置。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看框架定义：validity/fidelity/diversity 各自覆盖哪些对象（指令/回复、tool call、工具输出、最终输出、下游表现）。
- 重点看 fidelity 的“先算两边指标再比相似度”的设计，以及 diversity 的表示选择（在哪些层面算熵）。
- 快速扫实验里“人为注入缺陷”的合成策略：这些最像真实工程里会踩的坑。
- 如果你做的是预训练/后训练数据合成，把它当作“合成数据 QA checklist”，而不是新的建模方法。

summary_en.core_problem: When real multi-turn tool-calling traces are unavailable (privacy, sparsity), teams rely on synthetic datasets for agent evaluation—but lack quantitative ways to tell whether the synthetic benchmark truly matches and/or usefully extends the real distribution, or whether it will distort evaluation outcomes. The paper proposes a framework to measure synthetic benchmark quality for tool-calling agents, rather than proposing a better agent.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model work is indirect: it provides an engineering-style quality-control layer for synthetic evaluation data, explicitly accounting for tool calls and multi-step dependencies. This is useful for post-training data generation and regression testing of agentic systems, reducing the risk that synthetic benchmarks look plausible yet shift model rankings or success rates. It does not contribute to core pretraining recipes or optimization dynamics; it is closer to evaluation infrastructure for agents.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SynAE takes a real baseline dataset, a synthetic dataset, and optional metric configs plus one or more LLM agents (used only to compare downstream behavior on real vs synthetic). It reports three properties:
- Validity: whether synthetic tool calls/outputs actually satisfy the instructions (LLM-as-judge by default; rule-based checkers when available).
- Fidelity: how similar real and synthetic datasets are, computed by extracting metrics on each side and comparing their agreement.
- Diversity: entropy-based measures over representations of instructions/responses, tool calls, outputs, etc.
Metrics are computed across multiple trajectory components (instructions/responses, tool calls, final outputs) and also include downstream evaluation consistency (running an agent on both datasets to see whether performance conclusions are preserved). The paper also creates synthetic datasets with controlled failure modes (reduced fidelity, limited diversity) to test metric sensitivity.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
- Read the formal definitions of validity/fidelity/diversity and which trajectory components each covers.
- Focus on the fidelity design (compute metrics on both datasets, then compare) and the diversity representation choices (where entropy is computed).
- Skim the synthetic “pitfall injection” setups; they map well to real-world failure modes.
- Treat it as a synthetic-data QA checklist for agent evaluation, not as a modeling contribution.

recommendation.zh: 只看 metric taxonomy 和 failure cases；对预训练没直接动作，但能校准 agent eval 合成数据的可信边界。
recommendation.en: Read the metric taxonomy and failure cases; no direct pretraining action, but it calibrates how much to trust synthetic agent-eval data.

paper.title: The Economics of Model Collapse: Equilibrium, Welfare, and Optimal Provenance Subsidies in Synthetic Data Markets
paper.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the supply side of training data: an increasing share of new tokens, images, and structured records is produced by previous-generation models rather than by human originators. Recursive training on such synthetic content induces a measurable and often irreversible loss of distributional fidelity, a phenomenon known as model collapse. We develop the first unified microeconomic theory of synthetic data markets under model collapse. We intr

summary.core_problem: 缺少针对合成数据市场中模型塌缩现象的统一微观经济学理论，无法量化其对社会福利的影响及最优监管策略。
summary.importance: 首次建立合成数据市场在模型塌缩下的微观经济均衡框架，属于交叉领域原理分析，为数据治理政策提供理论参考。
summary.technical_approach: 定义合成数据污染均衡（SDCE）并证明其存在性与唯一性，推导包含模型塌缩损失的福利分解，给出福利最大化的来源补贴与水印强度的闭式解。
summary.experiments: 论文为纯理论经济模型工作，无针对LLM预训练的实证实验，所有结论均通过经济理论推导得出。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自斯德哥尔摩大学经济系，专注于AI相关的经济理论研究，无公开的LLM工程领域相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: There is no unified microeconomic theory for the model collapse phenomenon in synthetic data markets, making it impossible to quantify its impact on social welfare and the optimal regulatory strategy.
summary_en.importance: It is the first work to establish a microeconomic equilibrium framework for synthetic data markets under model collapse, belonging to cross-field principle analysis, and provides theoretical reference for data governance policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Define Synthetic Data Contamination Equilibrium (SDCE) and prove its existence and uniqueness, derive welfare decomposition including model collapse loss, and give closed-form solutions for welfare-maximizing provenance subsidy and watermark strength.
summary_en.experiments: This is a pure theoretical economic model work with no empirical experiments on LLM pretraining; all conclusions are derived through economic theory.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from the Department of Economics at Stockholm University, focusing on AI-related economic theory, with no publicly related work in the LLM engineering field.

recommendation.zh: 作为合成数据治理的交叉理论参考，预训练研究员无需深入正文，仅了解核心结论即可。
recommendation.en: It can be used as a cross-theoretical reference for synthetic data governance; pretraining researchers do not need to delve into the text, only understanding the core conclusions is sufficient.

paper.title: PlanningBench: Generating Scalable and Verifiable Planning Data for Evaluating and Training Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Planning is a fundamental capability for large language models (LLMs) because such complex tasks require models to coordinate goals, constraints, resources, and long-term consequences into executable and verifiable solutions. Existing planning benchmarks, however, usually treat planning data as fixed collections of instances rather than controllable generation targets. This limits scenario coverage, ties difficulty to surface-level proxies rather than structural sources, and offers limited suppo

summary.core_problem: PlanningBench 解决的是规划数据难以规模化生成、难以控制结构难度、难以自动验证的问题。它把规划 benchmark 从固定题集改成可控的数据生成框架，并同时服务评测和训练。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 和 reasoning 数据构造有参考价值。关键启发是：规划能力的训练信号应尽量来自可执行、可验证的约束系统，而不是只依赖自然语言答案或人工偏好。它也提供了一个较清晰的思路：用领域专家抽象任务结构，再用程序化约束生成实例和验证器，形成可扩展的 RL 训练数据。对预训练研究员来说，更有价值的部分是数据生成与验证信号设计，而不是具体规划任务本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是约束驱动的数据合成。PlanningBench 先从真实规划场景出发，由领域专家抽象出任务类型、子任务、约束族和难度因子。论文称其覆盖 30 多类规划任务，每类任务包含多个子任务和任务特定约束。生成时，系统先采样结构化的任务-约束配置，再实例化为自包含的规划问题。之后加入受控难度增强和质量过滤。难度不只由题目长度或要求数量决定，而是通过约束紧度、资源稀缺程度、目标冲突、子任务依赖、全局协调要求等因素控制。每个样本都配有自动验证规则，用于检查约束满足情况和目标质量。这一点和静态 benchmark 的差别较大：它不是收集一批题，而是定义一个能持续产出题目、答案检查器和训练奖励的生成系统。训练侧使用通过验证的数据做 GRPO，利用自动验证结果构造规划任务的强化学习反馈。
summary.experiments: 论文从评测和训练两条线验证 PlanningBench。评测侧覆盖开源和闭源前沿 LLM，结论是强模型在该 benchmark 上仍有明显未解空间。论文还分析了不同任务主题、prompt 长度、checklist item 数量对成功率的影响，用于定位模型在复杂约束和长程协调上的失败模式。训练侧用 PlanningBench 的可验证数据做 GRPO，并测试分布外迁移。结果显示，训练后的模型在 TravelPlanner 和 ChinaTravel 等未见规划 benchmark 上有提升，同时在 Multi-Challenge、Inverse IFEval、Collie 等更宽的指令遵循和复杂推理评测上也有收益。提供的正文片段没有包含具体模型规模、训练数据量、绝对分数和提升幅度，因此不宜补充未确认数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看三部分：第一，数据构造章节，尤其是任务 taxonomy、约束族、难度因子的定义；第二，自动验证规则如何表达约束满足和目标质量，这决定了它能否成为稳定的 RL 信号；第三，GRPO 训练和分布外评测结果，观察规划数据是否只提升同类任务，还是能迁移到更一般的 instruction-following 和 reasoning。若时间有限，可跳过大部分具体任务案例，保留对生成管线和验证机制的理解。

summary_en.core_problem: PlanningBench addresses a data problem in LLM planning: existing benchmarks are mostly fixed collections of instances, with limited controllability over structural difficulty, coverage, scalability, and automatic verification. The paper reframes planning evaluation as controllable generation of verifiable planning instances.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to post-training and reasoning data design. Its main value is the construction of executable and automatically verifiable planning signals. For researchers working on foundation-model training, the useful part is not the specific travel or workflow-style tasks, but the recipe for turning structured constraints into scalable evaluation data and RL rewards. This is a cleaner signal than free-form natural-language supervision or preference-only feedback when the target capability is constraint satisfaction and long-horizon coordination.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework starts from real planning scenarios and abstracts them into a taxonomy of task types, subtasks, constraint families, and difficulty factors. The paper states that the taxonomy covers more than 30 planning tasks, each with multiple subtasks and task-specific constraints. The generation pipeline samples structured task-constraint configurations, instantiates them as self-contained planning problems, applies controlled difficulty enhancement, and filters outputs after generation. Difficulty is controlled through structural factors such as constraint tightness, resource scarcity, objective conflicts, subtask dependencies, and global coordination requirements, rather than only through superficial proxies such as prompt length. Each instance is paired with automatic verification rules that check constraint satisfaction and objective quality. For training, the authors use verified PlanningBench data with GRPO, using the verifier as a source of planning-oriented feedback.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates both open-source and closed-source frontier LLMs and reports that even the strongest tested models have limited solve rates on PlanningBench, suggesting that the benchmark is not saturated. The analysis covers task topics, prompt length, and the number of checklist items, which helps diagnose how scenario structure and constraint complexity affect planning success. On the training side, GRPO with verified PlanningBench data improves transfer to unseen planning benchmarks such as TravelPlanner and ChinaTravel. The trained models also show gains on broader instruction-following and complex reasoning benchmarks, including Multi-Challenge, Inverse IFEval, and Collie. The provided full-content excerpt does not include concrete model sizes, data scale, absolute scores, or improvement numbers, so those details should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the data construction pipeline, especially the task taxonomy, constraint families, and difficulty factors. Then read the verifier design, since the verifier is what turns the benchmark into a potential RL training source. Finally, inspect the GRPO and out-of-distribution evaluation sections to see whether the generated planning data transfers beyond its own templates. Most individual task examples can be read selectively unless one is building a similar generator.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心可验证合成数据怎么服务推理训练，这篇可看；重点读 taxonomy、difficulty factor 和 verifier 设计，榜单本身价值不大。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care about how verifiable synthetic data can support reasoning training; focus on the taxonomy, difficulty factors, and verifier design, not the leaderboard.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: When Does Model Collapse Occur in Structured Interactive Learning?
paper.abstract: The proliferation of generative artificial intelligence has given rise to an interactive learning environment, where model parameters are continuously updated using not only data generated by natural processes, but also synthetic outputs produced by other models. This paradigm introduces two major challenges: (1) training data are no longer drawn exclusively from the target population, undermining a core assumption of classical statistical learning, and (2) model training processes become inhere

summary.core_problem: 结构化交互式学习场景下（多模型互相使用对方的合成输出迭代训练），经典统计学习的独立同分布假设失效，模型塌陷的发生条件与影响机制缺少严格的理论刻画。
summary.importance: 当前公共数据源中合成数据占比持续提升，多模型迭代训练的持续预训练场景越来越普遍，该研究给出了模型塌陷发生的边界条件，为合成数据治理、持续预训练的数据源设计提供了理论依据。
summary.technical_approach: 首先提出有向图框架建模多模型之间的交互式训练依赖关系，边A→B表示模型A的输出会作为模型B的训练数据。分别在线性回归和通用M估计的设置下，推导多轮交互式训练后模型参数的迭代更新方程，给出参数收敛到真实分布、出现偏差或完全塌陷的充分必要条件。
summary.experiments: 合成数据线性回归任务上，理论推导的参数收敛与塌陷条件得到验证：当交互式依赖图存在强连通分量且合成数据占比超过阈值时，模型参数会逐步偏离真实分布。MNIST和CIFAR-10图像分类任务上，多模型循环使用对方输出训练时，分类精度随训练轮数持续下降，与理论预测的塌陷趋势一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的场景定义与贡献、第2章的交互式有向图建模框架、第3和4章的核心结论、第5章的实验结果，跳过附录的所有证明部分，预计阅读时间40分钟。
summary.authors_note: 康奈尔大学运筹学与信息工程学院、哥伦比亚大学统计系、宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院统计与数据科学系

summary_en.core_problem: In structured interactive learning scenarios where multiple models are continuously trained on synthetic outputs generated by each other, the i.i.d. assumption of classical statistical learning is violated. There lacks rigorous theoretical characterization of the conditions and mechanisms leading to model collapse.
summary_en.importance: As synthetic data accounts for an increasing share of public data sources and iterative multi-model training becomes more common in continual pretraining, this work identifies the boundary conditions for model collapse, providing theoretical basis for synthetic data governance and data source design for continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first proposes a directed graph framework to model interactive training dependencies between multiple models, where an edge A→B indicates outputs of model A are used as training data for model B. It derives iterative update equations for model parameters after multiple rounds of interactive training under both linear regression and general M-estimation settings, and provides sufficient and necessary conditions for parameters to converge to the true distribution, incur bias, or experience complete collapse.
summary_en.experiments: The derived convergence and collapse conditions are first validated on synthetic linear regression tasks: when the interactive dependency graph contains strongly connected components and the proportion of synthetic data exceeds a threshold, model parameters gradually deviate from the true distribution. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 image classification show that classification accuracy degrades continuously as multiple models cyclically train on each other's outputs, consistent with the theoretically predicted collapse trend.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on scenario definition and contributions in Section 1, the directed interactive graph framework in Section 2, core conclusions in Sections 3 and 4, and experimental results in Section 5. Skip all proofs in the appendix. Estimated reading time: 40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Cornell University School of Operations Research and Information Engineering, Columbia University Department of Statistics, University of Pennsylvania Wharton School Department of Statistics and Data Science

recommendation.zh: 做合成数据预训练的研究员可参考其推导的模型坍缩边界，用于调整训练语料的合成数据占比约束
recommendation.en: Researchers using synthetic data for pretraining can refer to its derived model collapse boundary to adjust the proportion constraint of synthetic data in training corpus

paper.title: NOVA: Fundamental Limits of Knowledge Discovery Through AI
paper.abstract: Can AI systems discover genuinely new knowledge through iterative self improvement, and if so, at what cost? We introduce the NOVA framework, which models the common ``generate, verify, accumulate, retrain'' loop as an adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space. We identify sufficient conditions under which accumulated genuine knowledge eventually covers a finite domain, and show how their violations produce distinct failure modes: contamination, forgetting, exploration failure, and accept

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 AI 系统通过“生成候选、验证、累积、再训练”的循环能否发现新知识，以及发现成本如何随时间增长。它把自训练、形式化证明、自博弈和递归合成数据训练放到同一个抽象框架里，核心关注四个瓶颈：模型是否能采到目标知识、验证器是否能识别有效样本、训练后是否保留已发现知识、未知知识前沿是否会变得越来越稀薄。
summary.importance: 对预训练和自改进研究的启发在于，它把“用模型生成数据再训练模型”的问题从经验技巧提升到可分析的采样过程。结论比较克制但有用：自举发现并不只受模型能力限制，还受候选分布尾部、验证误报率、遗忘和支持集覆盖共同约束。尤其是污染陷阱值得关注。当前沿有效样本概率下降时，固定的 false positive rate 会变得不安全，错误样本可能比真实新知识更快进入知识库。这对 RL self-training、自动合成 reasoning data、形式化验证数据闭环都有直接警示。
summary.technical_approach: NOVA 将知识发现建模为有限或可数知识空间上的自适应采样。模型在环境候选空间中生成 artifact，验证器决定接受或拒绝，已接受样本进入知识库，并影响后续模型分布。论文分别刻画了成功覆盖有限知识域所需的充分条件，以及条件破坏后的失败模式：reachability 不足导致 exploration failure；验证器拒绝有效样本导致 acceptance failure；训练后概率质量从已发现知识上消失导致 forgetting；无效样本被接受导致 contamination。相比只讨论 model collapse 的工作，NOVA 不只看递归训练造成的分布退化，而是把生成分布、验证质量、知识保留和未知前沿同时纳入分析。论文还区分了 Good–Turing 的 batch unseen mass 和长期发现过程中的 historically undiscovered valid mass，并在尾部分布近似 Zipf、指数 α>1 的假设下推出发现 D 个不同真实 artifact 的累计生成成本为 Θ(c_gen D^α)。这给“越往后越难发现”的直觉提供了明确的成本律。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇理论建模论文，重点不是实证 benchmark。主要结果是若有限目标知识域中每个有效 artifact 在长期生成过程中保持正可达概率、验证器能接受有效 artifact、训练过程保留已发现知识，则知识覆盖可几乎必然发生。若存在 imperfect verification，论文分析有效样本和无效样本的增长率，得到局部污染阈值：当新有效知识的模型质量变小，验证器可容忍的误报率也必须同步下降；否则即使误报率很小，也会在后期积累污染。发现成本部分给出 R_cum(D)=Θ(c_gen D^α)，其中 c_gen 是单个候选生成成本，α 是有效发现前沿的 Zipf 尾指数。这个结果解释了为什么简单扩大采样预算在后期收益下降明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–45 分钟。重点看形式化定义、收敛条件和 imperfect verification 部分。对预训练研究更有用的是 contamination threshold 和 discovery-cost scaling，而不是符号细节。若正在做自动数据合成、proof/RL verifier、self-training 或持续预训练，应仔细看失败模式的划分：它能帮助区分是模型采不到、验证器太弱、训练忘掉，还是知识库被污染。人类专家 amplification 部分也值得扫读，它给出了为什么 frontier 阶段仍需要外部引导的形式化解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether an AI system can discover genuinely new knowledge through a repeated generate–verify–accumulate–retrain loop, and how the cost of discovery scales as the easy part of the domain is exhausted.
