It frames self-training, formal theorem proving, self-play, and recursive synthetic-data training as instances of the same adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution for pretraining research is a clean separation of the failure modes in model-driven data generation. Discovery is not limited only by model capacity. It also depends on support coverage, verifier quality, retention after retraining, and the probability mass assigned to the remaining unknown frontier. The contamination result is especially relevant for RL-based self-training and synthetic reasoning data pipelines: when valid new samples become rare, a fixed false-positive rate can become unsafe, because invalid artifacts may enter the retained corpus faster than genuine discoveries.
summary_en.technical_approach: NOVA models discovery as adaptive sampling from an ambient candidate space containing valid and invalid artifacts. A generator proposes candidates, a verifier accepts or rejects them, accepted candidates are accumulated, and retraining changes the future sampling distribution. The analysis gives sufficient conditions for almost-sure coverage of a finite target domain and maps violations of those conditions to forgetting, exploration failure, acceptance failure, and contamination. This is broader than standard model-collapse analyses, which mainly focus on distributional degradation under recursive training. The paper also separates Good–Turing batch unseen mass from the historically undiscovered valid mass that drives long-run discovery. Under a tail-equivalence assumption with a Zipf exponent α>1, the cumulative generation cost for discovering D distinct valid artifacts scales as Θ(c_gen D^α).
summary_en.experiments: This is a theoretical paper rather than an empirical benchmark paper. The main results are convergence guarantees under reachability, acceptance, and retention assumptions; failure characterizations when those assumptions break; and a contamination threshold under imperfect verification. The imperfect-verifier analysis shows that as the generator assigns less mass to new valid artifacts, the acceptable false-positive rate must also shrink. The cost law R_cum(D)=Θ(c_gen D^α) quantifies the diminishing return of brute-force sampling near the discovery frontier.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. The most relevant parts are the formal setup, the convergence and failure-mode results, the imperfect-verification analysis, and the discovery-cost scaling theorem. For readers working on synthetic data, verifier-guided RL, formal proof generation, or continual pretraining, the contamination and frontier-thinning sections are the parts to read carefully. The human-amplification discussion is also useful because it explains why expert guidance remains valuable when autonomous sampling assigns very low probability to undiscovered valid artifacts.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 self-training、synthetic data 或 model collapse，这篇值得读；它不直接给 recipe，但把“验证器稍差也会越训越脏”讲成了可推演的机制。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care about self-training or synthetic-data loops; it gives no recipe, but it turns “slightly noisy verification poisons the loop” into a clean mechanism worth stress-testing internally.

paper.title: MIND: Decoupling Model-Induced Label Noise via Latent Manifold Disentanglement
paper.abstract: The paradigm of learning from automatic annotations driven by pre-trained experts and Foundation Models dominates data-hungry applications. However, it introduces a critical challenge: model-induced label noise. Unlike stochastic noise in classical robust learning, this noise stems from annotator inductive biases, manifesting as systematic errors tightly coupled with local feature manifolds. Existing methods relying on global transition matrices underfit these structural patterns, while learning

summary.core_problem: 处理由预训练专家模型或基础模型自动标注带来的系统性标签噪声，而不是传统随机标签噪声。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据质量和噪声建模分析。它不直接研究LLM预训练，但“模型生成标注会携带标注器归纳偏置”这一问题对合成数据、蒸馏数据和自动标注数据的质量控制有弱相关性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Model-Induced Noise Decoupling，即 MIND。核心假设是高维噪声流形可通过 Latent Manifold Disentanglement 分解为若干子空间相关的误差模式。Latent Decoupling Estimator 动态把样本投影到具有一致错误模式的潜在结构簇中，再做噪声识别和处理。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据集、模型规模、基线和提升幅度。可确认的是方法针对由自动标注专家和基础模型产生的数据场景，并与全局转移矩阵或实例级转移矩阵路线形成对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses systematic label noise induced by pretrained experts and foundation-model annotators, rather than classical stochastic label noise.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a noise-modeling framework for machine-generated annotations. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the failure mode is relevant to synthetic data, distillation data, and automated labeling pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: MIND, or Model-Induced Noise Decoupling, assumes that high-dimensional model-induced noise can be decomposed into subspace-dependent components through latent manifold disentanglement. Its Latent Decoupling Estimator dynamically projects samples into latent structural clusters with consistent error modes to support noise identification.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify datasets, model sizes, baselines, or numerical improvements. The comparison target is the family of global transition-matrix methods and intractable instance-specific transition-matrix approaches.

recommendation.zh: 对合成标注数据有旁路价值；只看噪声随局部流形成簇这个假设，别期待LLM数据配方答案。
recommendation.en: Useful as a side signal for synthetic-label pipelines; read only the manifold-clustered noise assumption, not as an LLM data recipe.

paper.title: Towards Resource-Efficient LLMs: End-to-End Energy Accounting of Distillation Pipelines
paper.abstract: The rise in deployment of large language models has driven a surge in GPU demand and datacenter scaling, raising concerns about electricity use, grid stress, and the impacts of modern AI workloads. Distillation is often promoted as one of the most effective paths to obtain cheaper, more efficient models, yet these claims rarely account for the full end-to-end energy and resource costs, including crucial teacher-side workloads such as data generation, logit caching, and evaluation. We present a c

summary.core_problem: 评估蒸馏是否真的节省资源时，不能只看学生模型训练和推理成本，还要计入教师模型生成数据、logit caching、评测等完整流水线能耗。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工程测量与资源核算框架。它挑战了“蒸馏天然更省”的粗粒度叙事，对模型压缩、合成数据 SFT 和大规模部署成本评估有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出端到端 energy accounting framework，对蒸馏流水线各阶段进行 GPU device power consumption 的分阶段记录。比较两类常见蒸馏：logit-based knowledge distillation 和 synthetic-data supervised fine-tuning，并构造 energy-quality Pareto frontiers。
summary.experiments: 实验分离记录教师侧、学生侧、缓存、评测等阶段的经验能耗和排放。摘要未给出模型规模、GPU 类型、数据量、质量指标和 Pareto 数值，但明确覆盖经典 logit 蒸馏与合成数据 SFT 两条路线。
summary.authors_note: Sasha Luccioni 长期参与 AI 能耗、碳排和模型环境影响测量相关工作；论文信息未提供明确机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that claims about distillation efficiency must include the full pipeline cost, not just student training or inference, because teacher generation, logit caching, and evaluation can dominate the budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an engineering measurement and resource-accounting framework. It questions the coarse claim that distillation is automatically resource-efficient and is relevant to compression, synthetic-data SFT, and deployment cost analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose an end-to-end energy accounting framework that logs GPU device power stage by stage across distillation pipelines. They compare logit-based knowledge distillation with synthetic-data supervised fine-tuning and build energy-quality Pareto frontiers.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments empirically separate energy use and emissions across teacher-side work, student-side training, caching, and evaluation. The abstract does not provide model sizes, GPU types, dataset sizes, quality metrics, or exact Pareto numbers, but it covers both classic logit distillation and synthetic-data SFT.
summary_en.authors_note: Sasha Luccioni is known for work on AI energy use, carbon accounting, and environmental impact measurement. The provided paper metadata does not list a specific institution.

recommendation.zh: 结论不会改预训练方法，但会约束蒸馏项目立项；只看能耗分解表和 Pareto 曲线即可。
recommendation.en: It will not change pretraining methods, but it should constrain distillation project planning; read the stage-wise energy tables and Pareto curves.

paper.title: Know When To Fold 'Em: Token-Efficient LLM Synthetic Data Generation via Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection
paper.abstract: While synthetic data generation with large language models (LLMs) is widely used in post-training pipelines, existing approaches typically generate full outputs before applying quality filters, leading to substantial token waste on samples that are ultimately discarded. To address this, we propose Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection (MSIFR), a lightweight, training-free framework that detects and terminates low-quality generation trajectories at intermediate checkpoints before they reach full comple

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是合成数据生成里的 token 浪费问题。常见流程是先让模型把整条样本生成完，再做质量过滤；如果样本中途已经暴露出算术错误、格式错误或明显幻觉，后续 token 其实都是无效开销。作者要解决的是：能不能在生成过程中分阶段做轻量校验，尽早终止低质量轨迹，从而在不训练额外控制器的前提下，降低合成数据成本并维持数据质量。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练不是直接相关，更接近 post-train 数据管线优化，所以只适合 skim。但对做 SFT/RL 数据合成的人有现实意义：一是把“质量过滤”从生成后处理前移到生成过程中，二是把 token 预算视为可优化资源，而不是默认接受完整采样成本。对于依赖大规模合成数学/科学推理数据的团队，这种方法能直接影响数据生产效率，也会间接影响后续训练信号的噪声水平。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection，核心是把一条 problem-solution 生成轨迹拆成多个阶段，在阶段边界上运行快速、规则驱动的 validator。校验内容包括算术一致性、幻觉模式、格式约束等；一旦某阶段失败，就立刻停止后续生成。作者把这个过程形式化为 sequential decision problem，并给出 stage-wise token savings 分解，强调越早拒绝，节省越大。

和已有 early-exit 工作的区别在于，后者通常是针对单次推理，试图缩短本来正确的推理链；MSIFR 的目标不是让正确答案更短，而是尽早砍掉错误样本，避免把预算花在注定会被过滤掉的轨迹上。因此它是数据生成管线里的 rejection mechanism，而不是推理时的 reasoning truncation。作者还声称 conditional utility estimate 构成 martingale，因此早拒绝不会引入期望效用偏差；这个理论部分更像是为策略合理性提供解释，而不是方法成立的必要条件。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个 7B-8B 级指令模型：Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、DeepSeek-7B、Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B；任务覆盖 GSM8K、MATH500、SVAMP、MAWPS、MathQA、MMLU-Chem、DeepMind Mathematics。结果上，作为独立方法，MSIFR 相比完整生成流程可减少 11%-77% 的 token 消耗，文中提到在 GSM8K 上最高可到 42%；与已有 early-exit 方法结合时，最高可到 78.2% 的 token 节省，同时在各 benchmark 上保持或提升准确率。

这些结果说明它在“生成后再过滤”的低效场景里确实有用，但也要注意边界：收益高度依赖 validator 的质量和任务结构。数学、科学问答这类中间状态容易校验的任务更适合；开放式对话、创作类数据则未必有同样效果。论文如果没有报告误杀率、不同 validator 的单独贡献、以及被拒样本对最终训练收益的影响，那方法的泛化性仍需保留判断。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。先看方法总览，明确它不是训练新模型，而是改造 synthetic data generation pipeline。然后看理论部分里 sequential decision 和 martingale 的定义，理解作者想证明什么，不必在形式化细节上停留太久。实验部分重点看三类表：不同模型上的 token 节省幅度、与 early-exit 组合后的增益、以及准确率是否真的没有因早拒绝而下降。如果你关心的是 post-train 数据生产效率，20-25 分钟足够抓住主要信息；如果你关心 pretrain，本篇不需要深读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses token waste in synthetic data generation. In the standard pipeline, an LLM generates a full sample first and quality filters are applied only afterward. If the sample already shows arithmetic errors, hallucination patterns, or formatting failures halfway through generation, the remaining tokens are effectively wasted. The paper asks whether low-quality trajectories can be rejected during generation, stage by stage, without training an additional controller.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training data pipeline paper rather than a pretraining paper, so it belongs in skim territory. Its practical relevance is straightforward: if a team relies heavily on synthetic math or science data for SFT or RL, moving quality control into the generation loop can reduce token cost and improve the effective cleanliness of the retained dataset. The contribution is less about model capability and more about data production efficiency under a fixed inference budget.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed framework, Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection (MSIFR), decomposes generation into sequential stages and runs lightweight rule-based validators at intermediate checkpoints. These validators check arithmetic consistency, hallucination indicators, and formatting constraints. If a sample fails at any stage, generation is terminated immediately, preventing further token expenditure on a trajectory that would likely be discarded anyway.

The paper formulates this as a sequential decision problem and derives a stage-wise token-savings decomposition, emphasizing that earlier rejection yields larger savings. This is importantly different from prior early-exit methods, which usually try to shorten correct reasoning traces at inference time. MSIFR is not trying to make valid answers shorter; it is trying to stop invalid samples before they fully unfold. The authors also provide a theoretical argument that conditional utility estimates form a martingale, which is used to justify that early rejection preserves unbiased expected utility. That theory is more of a consistency argument than the core source of empirical gains.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans five instruction-tuned models in the 7B-8B range: Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, DeepSeek-7B, Phi-3-mini, and Mistral-7B. Benchmarks include GSM8K, MATH500, SVAMP, MAWPS, MathQA, MMLU-Chem, and the DeepMind Mathematics Dataset. As a standalone method, MSIFR reduces token consumption by 11% to 77% relative to full-generation pipelines, with up to 42% savings reported on GSM8K. When combined with existing early-exit methods, the savings reach as high as 78.2%, while maintaining or improving evaluation accuracy across the tested benchmarks.

The empirical message is clear for structured reasoning tasks with easy-to-check intermediate states. The main caveat is transferability: the method depends heavily on the availability and quality of validators. It is naturally better suited to math and science generation than to open-ended dialogue or creative writing. In the full paper, the most important details to inspect are false rejection rates, the contribution of each validator type, and whether the retained data actually improves downstream training quality rather than just lowering generation cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: A quick skim is enough. Start with the pipeline overview to understand that this is a training-free modification to synthetic data generation, not a new model or decoding algorithm in the usual sense. Then glance at the theoretical section on sequential decisions and the martingale argument to see what is being formalized, but do not spend too much time there unless you care about the decision-theoretic framing. In the experiments, focus on three things: token savings across models, gains when composed with early-exit baselines, and whether accuracy is preserved under aggressive rejection. If your main interest is post-training data efficiency, 20-25 minutes should be enough. If your focus is foundation-model pretraining, this paper is peripheral.

recommendation.zh: 无训练开销的合成数据降本方案，可直接集成到内部SFT数据生成 pipeline，重点看§2的规则校验器设计即可。
recommendation.en: This training-free synthetic data cost reduction framework can be directly integrated into SFT data generation pipelines, refer to §2 for rule validator design.

paper.title: NodeSynth: Socially Aligned Synthetic Data for AI Evaluation
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in generative AI facilitate large-scale synthetic data generation for model evaluation. However, without targeted approaches, these datasets often lack the sociotechnical nuance required for sensitive domains. We introduce NodeSynth, an evidence-grounded methodology that generates socially relevant synthetic queries by leveraging a fine-tuned taxonomy generator (TaG) anchored in real-world evidence. Evaluated against four mainstream LLMs (e.g., Claude 4.5 Haiku), NodeSynth el

summary.core_problem: NodeSynth 解决的是安全与社会技术评测数据生成的问题：普通合成提示词规模可扩展，但往往缺少敏感议题、地域、身份群体、使用场景和用户画像之间的细粒度交叉，导致评测很难触发真实部署中的失败模式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练目标或模型结构，而在评测数据生成。它的启发点是：模型安全和偏见评测不能只依赖宽泛 policy label 或人工少量样本，需要把抽象安全概念展开成可追踪的层级 taxonomy，再用真实证据约束提示词生成。对基座模型团队而言，这类方法可用于 pretrain/posttrain 数据审计、red-teaming 数据扩展，以及 guard model 的盲点定位。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是三步式数据生成管线。第一步，把目标概念 C 映射为三层 taxonomy T，包括 L1、L2、L3。系统先用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 生成 L1/L2，再由社会技术和语言专家审阅。第二步，用 2,576 条专家生成并审核的数据对 Gemini 2.5 Flash 做 SFT，得到 taxonomy generator，即 TaG，用来自动生成更细的 L3 扩展。训练数据包含生成式 AI 安全政策和敏感领域样本，字段包括目标概念、描述、L1-L3、国家和语言，覆盖英语、印尼语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语和墨西哥西班牙语。第三步，把 taxonomy 节点和外部证据源结合，生成带有敏感主题、地域、人口属性、场景和 persona 的评测 query。与直接让通用 LLM 生成测试问题相比，NodeSynth 的关键差异是先结构化地扩展概念空间，再把提示词锚定到现实材料上，而不是依赖模型自由发挥。
summary.experiments: 论文用四个主流模型做评测，包括 GPT o4-mini 和 Claude 4.5 Haiku。NodeSynth 生成的数据在特定测试架构下触发的失败率最高达到人工编写 benchmark 的 5 倍。消融结果显示，taxonomy 的细粒度扩展是失败率提升的主要来源，说明 L3 级别的具体社会语境和敏感交叉项比宽泛主题更容易暴露模型缺陷。专家审核部分有 11 位研究者参与，每个样本由 3 人审核，采用 2/3 多数决定，L1/L2 taxonomy 的一致性达到 90% 以上。论文还用独立验证检查 guard model，指出 Llama-Guard-3 这类安全分类器在细粒度社会语境下存在明显漏检。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20-30 分钟。重点看 NodeSynth Approach 中 taxonomy 构建、TaG SFT 数据设计和证据锚定流程。实验部分应关注三类结果：NodeSynth 与人工/普通合成数据的 failure rate 对比，taxonomy depth 的消融，guard model 验证。对预训练研究员更有用的是数据生成管线，而不是具体敏感领域结论。可特别检查 Appendix A/B 中 taxonomy prompt、训练字段和类别覆盖，因为这些细节决定方法是否能迁移到模型数据审计或对齐评测。

summary_en.core_problem: NodeSynth targets a data-generation problem in sociotechnical model evaluation. Generic synthetic prompts are scalable, but they often miss the fine-grained intersections among sensitive topics, geography, demographic attributes, use cases, and user personas. As a result, they under-sample the kinds of prompts that reveal failures in deployed systems.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model evaluation and data governance. Its main lesson is that safety and bias evaluation should not rely only on broad policy labels or small human-written sets. A structured taxonomy, grounded in external evidence, can expose failure modes that broad synthetic generation misses. For foundation-model teams, this is useful for red-teaming data generation, pretrain/posttrain data audits, and diagnosing blind spots in guard models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline first maps a target concept C into a three-level taxonomy T with L1, L2, and L3 nodes. Gemini 2.5 Flash is used to draft the L1/L2 taxonomy, which is then reviewed by domain experts. Since manual L3 annotation does not scale, the authors fine-tune Gemini 2.5 Flash into a taxonomy generator, TaG, using 2,576 expert-created and reviewed instances. Each instance contains the target concept, description, L1-L3 labels, country, and language. The data covers generative-AI safety policies and sensitive domains, with examples in English, Indonesian, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, and Mexican Spanish. The generated taxonomy nodes are then combined with external evidence sources to produce evaluation queries. The key distinction from ordinary LLM-based query generation is that NodeSynth first expands the concept space in a controlled hierarchy, then grounds prompts in documented real-world contexts.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers four mainstream models, including GPT o4-mini and Claude 4.5 Haiku. NodeSynth prompts elicit failure rates up to five times higher than human-authored benchmarks under the reported testing setup. Ablations show that granular taxonomic expansion is a major driver of the higher failure rate, suggesting that L3-level context and demographic intersections are more diagnostic than broad topic labels. The taxonomy validation involved 11 researchers; each sample was reviewed by three annotators with a two-out-of-three majority rule, and L1/L2 agreement was at least 90%. The paper also reports weaknesses in independent guard models such as Llama-Guard-3 when evaluated on these fine-grained sociotechnical prompts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20-30 minutes. Focus on the NodeSynth Approach section, especially taxonomy construction, TaG fine-tuning data, and evidence-grounded query generation. In the experiments, look for three results: failure-rate comparisons against human and generic synthetic baselines, ablations on taxonomy depth, and guard-model validation. For pretraining researchers, the reusable part is the evaluation-data pipeline rather than the domain-specific findings. Appendix A/B are worth checking for taxonomy prompts, training fields, and category coverage.

recommendation.zh: 安全评测数据合成比常规红队更系统；只看 taxonomy 扩展消融，别把失败率当训练收益。
recommendation.en: The safety-data synthesis is more systematic than ad hoc red-teaming; read the taxonomy ablation, but do not treat higher failure rates as training gains.

paper.title: Silent Collapse in Recursive Learning Systems
paper.abstract: Recursive learning -- where models are trained on data generated by previous versions of themselves -- is increasingly common in large language models, autonomous agents, and self-supervised systems. However, standard performance metrics (loss, perplexity, accuracy) often fail to detect internal degradation before it becomes irreversible. Here we identify a phenomenon we call silent collapse: under broad recursive conditions, model internal distributions -- predictive entropy, representational d

summary.core_problem: 递归学习系统（如用自身前版输出训练LLM、伪标签自监督、带偏置奖励的RL）会出现内部表征持续退化，但传统验证指标（损失、困惑度、准确率）无法在退化不可逆前检测到异常，此前的模型坍缩研究也未解决提前预警和无原始真实数据干预的问题。
summary.importance: 为LLM递归自训练、持续学习、RLHF迭代等常用训练范式的健康度监控提供了可落地的观测维度，打破了「验证指标稳定等于训练动态健康」的固有认知，为避免长期迭代过程中的隐性能力退化提供了预警和干预思路。
summary.technical_approach: 定义「静默坍缩」现象：系统内部预测熵、表征多样性、尾部分布覆盖率持续收缩的同时，传统验证指标仍保持稳定甚至提升；识别出三个早于指标恶化出现的轨迹层面前兆：锚点熵收缩、表征漂移冻结、尾部覆盖侵蚀；提出不需要持续接入原始真实数据的MTR框架，仅用初始checkpoint的少量固定锚点样本，通过监控轨迹统计量生成信任估计，自适应调节学习强度。
summary.experiments: 在TinyStories递归语言建模、CIFAR-10递归伪标注两个压力测试场景下验证，MTR比传统指标提前多代检测到坍缩前兆，有效阻止了困惑度的灾难性爆炸。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中静默坍缩与传统模型坍缩的差异部分、静默坍缩三个前兆的定义逻辑、MTR框架的设计思路，预计阅读时间20-25分钟，附录实验细节可按需查看。

summary_en.core_problem: Recursive learning systems, including LLMs trained on outputs of previous versions, self-supervised models with pseudo-labels, and RL agents with biased rewards, suffer from progressive internal representational degradation. Standard validation metrics (loss, perplexity, accuracy) cannot detect this degradation before it becomes irreversible, and prior model collapse research did not address early warning or intervention without continuous access to pristine real data.
summary_en.importance: It provides actionable observation dimensions for health monitoring of common LLM training paradigms such as recursive self-training, continual learning, and iterative RLHF. It challenges the default assumption that stable validation metrics equal healthy training dynamics, and offers a practical framework for early warning and intervention to avoid hidden capability degradation during long-term training iterations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work defines silent collapse, a dynamical regime where internal predictive entropy, representational diversity, and tail distribution coverage shrink progressively while standard validation metrics remain stable or even improve. It identifies three trajectory-level precursors that emerge long before visible metric degradation: anchor entropy contraction, representation drift freezing, and tail coverage erosion. It proposes the MTR framework, which requires no continuous access to pristine real data — only a small fixed set of anchor samples from the initial checkpoint — to monitor trajectory statistics, generate trust estimates, and adaptively adjust learning intensity.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on two stress test scenarios: recursive language modeling on TinyStories and recursive pseudo-labeling on CIFAR-10. MTR detects collapse precursors multiple generations earlier than standard metrics, and effectively prevents catastrophic perplexity explosion.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the difference between silent collapse and traditional model collapse in the introduction, the definition of the three collapse precursors, and the design logic of the MTR framework. Estimated reading time is 20-25 minutes. Appendix experiment details can be reviewed on demand.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做 synthetic data 回流或 continual pretrain，这篇至少该看监测指标定义；结论未必稳，但“内部先塌、外部后坏”这个警报值得立刻加进训练面板。
recommendation.en: If you run synthetic-data recursion or continual pretraining, at least inspect the proposed diagnostics; the claim may be setup-sensitive, but the idea that internals fail before metrics do is worth instrumenting immediately.

institutions: China Mobile GBA (Greater Bay Area) Innovation Institute

paper.title: KamonBench: A Grammar-Based Dataset for Evaluating Compositional Factor Recovery in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Kamon (family crests) are an important part of Japanese culture and a natural test case for compositional visual recognition: each crest combines a small number of symbolic choices, but the space of possible descriptions is sparse. We introduce KamonBench, a grammar-based image-to-structure benchmark with 20,000 synthetic composite crests and auxiliary component examples. Each composite crest is paired with a formal kamon description language - "kamon yōgo" - description, a segmented Japanese an

summary.core_problem: KamonBench 解决的是 VLM 是否真的能从图像中恢复可组合视觉因子的问题，而不是只做自由文本 caption 或记忆常见图文配对。家纹图像由 container、modifier、motif 三类因素组合而成，语言侧有相对形式化的 kamon description language。这个设定把“看懂图像”转成了“恢复结构化生成程序”的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在评测侧。它提供了一个低噪声、可控、可组合的 image-to-structure benchmark，用来检查 VLM 是否学到可复用视觉因子。相比常规 VQA 或 caption 指标，这类任务更接近对多模态表示的诊断：模型是否把 motif、容器、空间排列、形变这几类因素分开表示，是否能在少样本或未见组合上重组。对研究视觉 tokenizer、native multimodal pretraining、组合泛化评测有一定参考价值，但它不是新的预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是用语法生成合成家纹数据。每个样本从已知因子生成，包括容器、修饰/空间排列、基础 motif。每张合成 crest 配有多种目标表示：KDL 描述、日语分词分析、英文翻译、非语言 program code。这样做的取舍很清楚：不用真实网页家纹，是为了避免闭源 VLM 可能已经在预训练中见过常见家纹；使用合成语法，是为了拿到精确的生成因子，能做比 caption accuracy 更细的评估。论文强调家纹空间很稀疏：真实常见图样有限，但组合空间很大，当前非递归因子库存约有 77 万种组合。这使它适合测试模型是否掌握组合规则，而不是记住整图。
summary.experiments: 数据集规模为 20,000 个合成 composite crests，并提供辅助 component examples。评测不只看文本匹配，还支持 program-code factor metrics，即分别检查 container、modifier、motif 是否恢复正确；也支持受控的 factor-pair recombination，用来测试模型在未见组合上的泛化。提供内容里没有完整列出各 VLM 的具体分数，因此更应把实验部分理解为 benchmark 设计和评测协议，而不是模型方法的性能改进。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 kamon 因子结构的定义，以及 Kamon as a machine learning problem 对稀疏组合空间的论证。若关心多模态评测，优先看数据生成语法、program-code 指标、factor recovery 指标和重组测试设计。无需在文化背景部分停留太久，核心信息是：它把图像理解任务压成了可控的结构恢复任务。

summary_en.core_problem: KamonBench asks whether VLMs can recover compositional visual factors from an image, rather than produce a plausible caption or memorize frequent image-text pairs. A kamon crest is generated from factors such as container, modifier, and motif, and the target language is a constrained kamon description language. The task is therefore image-to-structure, not ordinary captioning.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. The benchmark gives a controlled way to test whether a multimodal model has learned reusable visual factors and can recombine them under sparse supervision. This is more informative than standard VQA or caption accuracy when the question is representation quality: whether the model separates motif identity, containment, spatial arrangement, and visual modification. It is relevant to studies of visual tokenization, native multimodal pretraining, and compositional generalization, but it is not a new pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset is generated by a grammar over kamon factors. Each synthetic crest has known latent factors and is paired with multiple outputs: a KDL description, segmented Japanese analysis, English translation, and a non-linguistic program code. The design choice is deliberate. Real web images would be hard to use for evaluating proprietary VLMs because common crests may already appear in their training data. Synthetic generation provides unseen combinations and exact factor labels. The paper also emphasizes sparsity: although common real crests are limited, the non-recursive factor inventory already yields roughly 770,000 combinations.
summary_en.experiments: KamonBench contains 20,000 synthetic composite crests plus auxiliary component examples. The evaluation supports more than caption-level scoring: direct program-code factor metrics can measure recovery of container, modifier, and motif separately, and controlled factor-pair recombination tests whether models generalize to unseen combinations. The provided content does not include full per-model scores, so the experimental contribution should be read mainly as a benchmark protocol and data construction pipeline.
summary_en.reading_guide: A light read is enough, about 15–25 minutes. Focus on the factor definition in the introduction and the argument in the machine-learning section for why kamon is a sparse compositional recognition task. For multimodal evaluation work, inspect the grammar, program-code target, factor-level metrics, and recombination tests. The cultural background is useful context, but the main technical point is the conversion of visual recognition into controlled structure recovery.

recommendation.zh: 读数据生成 grammar 和 factor metrics 就够；它对 VLM 预训练诊断有用，但合成家纹域的外推性要打折。
recommendation.en: Read the grammar and factor metrics; it is useful for VLM diagnostics, but the synthetic crest domain limits how far the conclusions travel.

paper.title: AcquisitionSynthesis: Targeted Data Generation using Acquisition Functions
paper.abstract: Data quality remains a critical bottleneck in developing capable, competitive models. Researchers have explored many ways to generate top quality samples. Some works rely on rejection sampling: generating lots of synthetic samples and filtering out low-quality samples. Other works rely on larger or closed-source models to extract model weaknesses, necessary skills, or a curriculum off of which to base data generation. These works have one common limitation: there is no quantitative approach to m

summary.core_problem: 合成数据生成里缺少“可量化、面向学生模型”的数据效用度量，导致常见的 generate-then-filter 或基于大模型诊断弱点的流程要么算力浪费、要么解释性弱，且很难证明某条合成样本对下游学习到底有没有增益。论文要解决的是：能否用简单、可解释、可计算的“数据效用”信号，直接驱动生成器产出对学生模型最有训练价值的数据，而不是先海量生成再筛。
summary.importance: 把主动学习里的 acquisition function 迁移成“合成数据生成的训练信号”，并用 critic-free 的 GRPO 直接优化生成器，让“数据是否有用”从事后评估变成训练时的可微（通过RL）目标。对预训练/持续学习的启发点在于：1）数据质量控制可以更模型中心（model-centric），不必依赖外部强模型或复杂课程；2）用学生模型的不确定性/梯度等信号做奖励，天然贴近“补短板”和“避免遗忘”的目标；3）提供了一套相对通用的、可解释的合成数据效用指标族，便于在不同任务/不同学生模型上复用与诊断。
summary.technical_approach:
框架是“生成器-学生”闭环：生成器（AcquisitionSynthesis）与学生通常是同架构的两个实例（学生多为未训练/或当前版本），生成器按任务提示生成一条训练样本（prompt+response），然后用学生模型计算 acquisition reward，把该 reward 作为 GRPO 的回报更新生成器。

奖励设计来自五类 acquisition function，并针对 LM 做了可计算化：
1）Confidence（不确定性/边际采样）：用学生在每个位置 top-1 与 top-2 token 概率差的序列平均作为置信度，奖励取其倒数，鼓励生成“学生最拿不准但仍可学习”的样本。
2）Proximity（贴近任务分布）：用语义相似度约束生成样本与任务训练分布的距离，避免不确定性奖励把生成推向离题/噪声区域。
3）Gradient Magnitude（影响函数/梯度范数风格）：用学生在该样本上的梯度强度近似“这条样本会推动参数更新多少”，鼓励高训练信号样本。
4）Diversity（覆盖性）：鼓励批内/组内样本多样，降低模式坍塌与重复。
5）Answer Variance（答案方差/分歧）：用学生对同一问题的多次采样或分布分歧度量不确定性与歧义性，偏向能暴露推理薄弱点的样本。

训练细节上，论文强调用少量（文中提到 500 条）样本作为 in-context 示例来稳定生成任务格式；用 group-based 的相对优势归一化（GRPO 风格）来降低方差，使奖励可直接用于更新生成器，而不需要额外 critic。
summary.experiments:
评测采用“用生成器造数据→训练学生→看学生提升”的闭环指标，任务覆盖可验证领域（数学、医疗 QA、代码）。核心结论：
- 用 AcquisitionSynthesis 生成的数据训练学生，相比基线合成/筛选策略，学生提升约 2–7%，且模型越大收益越明显（文中给出区间结论）。
- 持续/分布外设置下，训练后遗忘更轻；在 OOD 上可额外提升约 3%（文中给出量级）。
- 生成器更大时，学到的“效用驱动生成策略”更能跨学生模型家族与尺寸泛化。
- 生成数据可适配不同训练范式（文中以多种训练设置验证可用性）。

从全文片段能确认的具体数字主要是提升区间（2–7%）与 OOD（~3%）；更细的表格数字需要对照 Section 5 各子节与附录。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Figure 1/2，把“生成器-学生-奖励”闭环和评测协议搞清楚，否则容易把它误读成普通 rejection sampling。
- 重点看 Methodology 里五种 acquisition reward 的定义与实现细节：哪些是纯不确定性，哪些是分布约束/多样性约束，哪些近似“影响力”。
- 看 Section 5.2（遗忘与 OOD）与 5.3（跨模型泛化）：这是它相对常规合成数据工作的差异点。
- 如果要复现/迁移到预训练数据管线，优先深挖：奖励的尺度/归一化、组大小、学生是否在线更新、以及 proximity/diversity 如何与 uncertainty/gradient reward 做权衡。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟抓主线；想落地需要再花 1–2 小时对照附录实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Synthetic data generation for LLM training lacks a quantitative, student-model-centric notion of data utility. As a result, common pipelines either waste compute via generate-then-filter, or rely on heavyweight/opaque “model weakness discovery” using larger closed models. The paper asks whether simple, principled utility signals—computed from the student—can directly train a generator to produce samples that measurably improve the downstream learner.
summary_en.importance: It operationalizes active-learning acquisition functions as RL rewards for training a data generator (via critic-free GRPO). This turns “is this sample useful?” from an after-the-fact evaluation into a training objective. For pretraining and continual pretraining, the key takeaway is that uncertainty/gradient/diversity-style signals from the target model can guide targeted data synthesis, potentially improving data efficiency and reducing forgetting without depending on external stronger teachers.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AcquisitionSynthesis trains a generator–student loop. The generator produces a training example (prompt+response). A student model (often the same architecture, untrained or current snapshot) scores that example with an acquisition-inspired reward, and the generator is updated with GRPO.

Rewards are adapted from active learning:
- Confidence/uncertainty: based on the average top-1 vs top-2 token probability margin across the response; reward is inverse margin to favor samples the student is least confident about.
- Proximity: constrains samples to stay semantically close to the task distribution to prevent uncertainty rewards from drifting into irrelevant regions.
- Gradient magnitude: uses the student’s gradient strength on the sample as a proxy for training impact.
- Diversity: encourages coverage and reduces mode collapse.
- Answer variance: measures distributional disagreement/variance in the student’s answers to surface weak reasoning areas.

The method uses a small in-context seed set (the paper mentions 500 examples) to stabilize formatting, and relies on group-wise normalization (GRPO-style) to control variance without a learned critic.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluation is end-to-end: generate a dataset with the trained generator, train a student on it, and measure student gains on verifiable tasks (math, medical QA, coding). Reported outcomes include:
- Student improvements of roughly 2–7% over baselines, with larger students benefiting more.
- Reduced catastrophic forgetting; in OOD settings, gains of about 3% are reported.
- Larger generators yield policies that generalize better across student model families and sizes.
- Generated data works under multiple training paradigms (validated via several training setups).

The excerpted full text confirms the improvement ranges; exact per-benchmark numbers should be read from Section 5 tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path:
- Start with Figures 1–2 to internalize the generator–student–reward loop and the evaluation protocol.
- Read the Methodology section carefully for the five reward definitions and how they are computed for LMs.
- Focus on Section 5.2 (forgetting/OOD) and 5.3 (cross-model generalization), which are the most distinctive claims beyond “better synthetic data”.
Time budget: ~30–45 minutes for the main idea; add 1–2 hours if you plan to re-implement (reward scaling, grouping, proximity/diversity trade-offs, and whether the student is updated online matter).

recommendation.zh: 这个想法比结果更值得看：把 acquisition function 前置成生成 reward，若实验做得干净，会直接影响你设计合成数据 pipeline 的目标函数。
recommendation.en: The idea is more valuable than the headline numbers: if the setup is clean, using acquisition functions as generation rewards should directly change how you design synthetic-data objectives.

paper.title: L2P: Unlocking Latent Potential for Pixel Generation
paper.abstract: Pixel diffusion models have recently regained attention for visual generation. However, training advanced pixel-space models from scratch demands prohibitive computational and data resources. To address this, we propose the Latent-to-Pixel (L2P) transfer paradigm, an efficient framework that directly harnesses the rich knowledge of pre-trained LDMs to build powerful pixel-space models. Specifically, L2P discards the VAE in favor of large-patch tokenization and freezes the source LDM's intermedia

summary.core_problem: 如何在几乎不收集真实数据、低算力条件下，把预训练latent diffusion的生成能力迁移到像素空间扩散模型，并支持超高分辨率生成。
summary.importance: 提供一种“从latent到pixel”的迁移范式：冻结大部分预训练扩散网络、只学浅层映射，并用合成数据自举训练；对生成模型预训练/迁移与数据闭环有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出L2P：去掉VAE，改用大patch tokenization；冻结源LDM的中间层，仅训练浅层以学习latent-to-pixel变换；训练数据完全来自源LDM生成的合成图像，从“已平滑的流形”上快速收敛；去除VAE带来的显存瓶颈以解锁原生4K生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出关键指标与对比细节；宣称仅用8张GPU训练、可实现原生4K生成，并在多组实验中验证（具体baseline/提升幅度需看正文）。
summary.authors_note: Nanjing University；Tencent Youtu Lab。

summary_en.core_problem: How to transfer a pretrained latent diffusion model into a pixel-space diffusion model with minimal compute and no real-data collection, while enabling ultra-high-resolution generation.
summary_en.importance: A transfer paradigm from latent to pixel space: freeze most of a pretrained diffusion backbone, learn a shallow mapping, and bootstrap training purely from synthetic samples—useful as a reference for generative pretraining/transfer and synthetic-data loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: L2P removes the VAE and uses large-patch tokenization; freezes intermediate layers of the source LDM and trains only shallow layers to learn a latent-to-pixel transformation; trains solely on images synthesized by the source LDM to fit an already-smooth manifold; removing the VAE alleviates memory bottlenecks to unlock native 4K generation.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract lacks concrete metrics and baselines; claims training with 8 GPUs and native 4K generation, with extensive experiments (details require the paper).
summary_en.authors_note: Nanjing University; Tencent Youtu Lab.

recommendation.zh: 更像“扩散模型迁移/蒸馏”的工程范式：只看冻结策略+纯合成数据闭环是否真能不崩（重点查对比与失败案例）。
recommendation.en: An engineering-heavy diffusion transfer recipe; worth checking whether the freeze+synthetic-only loop is actually stable—focus on baselines and failure modes, not the narrative.

paper.title: Curated Synthetic Data Doesn't Have to Collapse: A Theoretical Study of Generative Retraining with Pluralistic Preferences
paper.abstract: Recursive retraining of generative models poses a critical representation challenge: when synthetic outputs are curated based on a fixed reward signal, the model tends to collapse onto a narrow set of outputs that over-optimize that objective. Prior work suggests that such collapse is unavoidable without adding real data into the mix. We revisit this conclusion from an alignment perspective and show that collapse can be mitigated through curation based on multiple reward functions. We formalize

summary.core_problem: 该工作讨论递归合成数据训练中的模式坍缩问题：如果每一代模型生成样本，再用固定奖励函数筛选高分样本继续训练，模型分布会逐步集中到少数高奖励区域。作者关心的是，当筛选信号不是单一偏好，而是来自多个相互竞争的偏好时，坍缩是否仍然不可避免。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在合成数据闭环和偏好驱动数据筛选。结论是，坍缩不只由“使用合成数据”决定，也由筛选机制决定。单一 reward 会持续放大同一方向的样本；多个 reward 交替参与筛选时，极限分布可以保留多个高奖励 basin 的质量。这对用 reward model、人工偏好、规则过滤器构造预训练或持续预训练数据有直接参考意义。不过贡献主要是理论模型，不涉及有限容量模型、真实优化器、token 级语言建模和大规模实验，不能直接推出工程配方。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把递归训练建模为一个分布动力系统。每轮从当前模型分布 p_t 采样 K 个候选，用 Bradley-Terry 选择模型按某个 reward 选择一个样本，然后假设重新训练是无约束 MLE，因此下一轮分布 p_{t+1} 等于被选样本的分布。关键推导是：当候选池 K 足够大时，BT 筛选近似等价于对当前分布做 exponential tilt，即按 exp(r_i(x)) 对 p_t 重新加权并归一化。多偏好设置下，每轮 reward 从固定混合分布中抽取，例如两个 reward 的采样权重为 q 和 1-q。作者定义每个 reward 的近最优 basin，并在 outside-basin gap 条件下证明，basin 外质量会逐步衰减，分布集中到多个近最优 basin 的并集。之后，basin 之间的质量分配由 leakage 控制：如果 reward r_1 在 r_2 的 basin 上也能给出较高分，这种交叉强化会改变最终混合比例；当 basin 分离更强、leakage 趋近于零时，最终权重接近 reward 的采样权重。硬分离和 plateau 条件下，极限分布有显式形式，并可解释为带权 Nash bargaining 解。
summary.experiments: 该工作没有常规机器学习实验，主要结果是定理和推论。可记录的技术结果包括：有限 K 的 BT 筛选更新可看作 K→∞ exponential-tilt 更新的扰动；在近最优集合上的偏差项量级为 O(sqrt(log K / K))。在 outside-basin gap 条件下，非近最优区域质量收缩。进入近最优 basin 并集后，任意非退化的双 basin 极限混合都会保持正的 reward 方差，作者还给出 basin 分离条件下的下界。M 个偏好的扩展也被讨论，但核心证明以两个 reward 为主。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 的问题设定，Theoretical Results 中从 BT 选择到 exponential tilt 的 Lemma 3.1/3.2，以及 basin concentration、leakage-controlled mixture、Nash bargaining interpretation 三段。需要判断适用性时，优先看假设：无约束 MLE、固定 reward mixture、bounded reward、large-K 近似、outside-basin gap、hard separation。这些假设决定了结论能否迁移到真实 LLM 合成数据流水线。附录证明可只看关键不等式和有限 K 扰动项，不必逐行细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies mode collapse in recursive synthetic-data training. Prior theory showed that repeatedly generating data, filtering it with a fixed reward, and retraining on the selected samples drives the model toward a narrow high-reward region. The question here is whether the same collapse is unavoidable when curation is driven by multiple, competing preferences rather than a single reward.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is synthetic-data governance. The result separates the risk of using synthetic data from the choice of curation signal. A single reward creates a one-directional amplification loop; a mixture of rewards can maintain probability mass across several high-reward basins. This is useful when thinking about reward-model filtering, rule-based data selection, preference mixtures, and continual pretraining loops. The contribution is theoretical and stylized. It does not model finite-capacity neural networks, token-level language modeling, optimizer dynamics, or large-scale data pipelines, so it should be read as a conceptual model rather than an engineering recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate recursive retraining as a distributional dynamical system. At each iteration, K candidates are sampled from the current model distribution p_t. One candidate is selected by a Bradley-Terry choice rule under a sampled reward, and retraining is idealized as unconstrained maximum likelihood, so p_{t+1} becomes the selected-sample distribution. In the large-candidate regime, the BT selection update becomes an exponential tilt of p_t by exp(r_i(x)), followed by normalization. With pluralistic preferences, the reward is sampled from a fixed mixture, for example with weights q and 1-q for two rewards. The analysis defines near-optimal basins for the rewards and proves that, under an outside-basin gap condition, mass outside the union of these basins decays. Once mass is concentrated inside the basin union, the final split is governed by leakage: how much one reward also reinforces the other reward’s basin. As leakage vanishes under stronger separation, the basin weights approach the reward sampling weights. In an idealized hard-separation and plateau regime, the limit has an explicit mixture form and matches a weighted Nash bargaining solution.
summary_en.experiments: There are no standard empirical experiments. The results are theorem-driven. Key quantitative statements include a finite-K approximation bound: on the near-optimal set, the deviation from the K→∞ exponential-tilt update is O(sqrt(log K / K)). Under the outside-basin gap assumption, probability mass contracts toward the union of near-optimal basins. For any nontrivial two-basin limiting mixture, reward variance remains strictly positive, with lower bounds under basin separation. The paper also sketches the extension from two preferences to M preferences, while the main exposition and proof structure focus on the two-reward case.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in roughly 25–35 minutes. Read the Introduction for the motivation, then focus on the Theoretical Results section: the Bradley-Terry-to-exponential-tilt derivation, the basin concentration argument, the leakage-controlled mixture result, and the Nash bargaining interpretation. For applicability, inspect the assumptions before the proofs: unconstrained MLE retraining, fixed reward mixture, bounded rewards, large-K approximation, outside-basin gap, and hard separation. The appendix is useful mainly for the finite-K perturbation bound and the exact conditions behind the mass-decay claims.

recommendation.zh: 从理论上证明多元奖励可缓解合成数据递归训练坍塌，做合成数据后训练循环的可参考核心证明章节
recommendation.en: Theoretically proves that pluralistic rewards mitigate collapse in synthetic data retraining loops, researchers working on synthetic data pipelines can refer to the core proof sections

institutions: Ali Falahati 1 Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri 2 Kate Larson 1 Lukasz Golab

paper.title: Mind the Gap? A Distributional Comparison of Real and Synthetic Priors for Tabular Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Tabular foundation models are pre-trained on one of three classes of corpus: curated datasets drawn from benchmark repositories, tables harvested at scale from the web, or synthetic tables sampled from a parametric generative prior. Despite the centrality of pre-training data to model performance, little is known about how these corpora relate to one another in distribution, and the impact this has on downstream performance. In this work we take three canonical, archetypal datasets used to train

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：表格基础模型的预训练语料到底覆盖了怎样的表格分布，真实表格、网页抓取表格、人工整理表格和合成先验之间是否真的相近。作者关心的不只是“合成数据能不能训练模型”，而是合成先验是否生成了真实表格空间中的样本，以及这种分布距离是否能解释下游性能。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对“预训练数据先验如何定义、如何验证”有参考价值。表格基础模型和语言模型共享一个问题：预训练语料不是越大越好，关键是覆盖哪些任务分布。该工作给出的启发是，合成预训练任务即使在机制上看似合理，也可能只覆盖真实数据空间中很小的区域；而分布相近与下游性能之间也未必存在简单单调关系。这对用程序化数据、合成任务、环境生成器训练基础模型有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把不同来源的表格映射到统一的表级特征空间，再比较分布。作者选取三类代表性语料：T4 代表网页抓取表格，TabFM 代表 Kaggle 等来源的人工整理表格，TabICL 代表公开参数的合成先验。由于表格没有固定结构，作者没有使用特定模型的 learned embedding 作为主分析工具，而是构造了表级、列级和列间关系的聚合特征，避免结论绑定到某个模型。主要特征集包括 Full 特征，维度为 70；Scalars 特征，维度为 9。列类型通过唯一值比例判断，唯一值比例低于 0.2 的列被视为类别列。分布比较用了两类指标：一类是训练判别器预测表格来源，若来源容易区分，则说明样本级分布差异明显；另一类是基于近邻的 coverage 指标，用来衡量一个数据源是否覆盖另一个数据源的区域。作者还尝试优化 TabICL 合成先验参数，希望让合成表格更接近真实语料，并用大规模网格搜索检验这种可调性。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三点。第一，TabICL 类合成先验只占据真实表格特征空间中很小的一块区域；反过来，真实表格能够较好覆盖合成表格空间。这说明合成先验的多样性在机制描述上可能很丰富，但落到观测特征空间后仍然偏窄。第二，网页抓取表格 T4 与人工整理表格 TabFM 在特征空间中有较大重叠，但单个表格仍能被判别器区分来源。这解释了为什么规模较小但质量较高的 curated 表格语料可以取得接近大规模网页语料的预训练效果。第三，作者对合成先验做了包括约 86k trial 网格搜索在内的参数优化，仍然难以提升对真实表格分布的覆盖，合成与真实样本接近可分。性能侧的初步结果显示，在作者构造的特征空间下，测试表格到合成先验的距离与下游性能没有清晰相关性。这一点很重要：分布覆盖不足是真问题，但简单的表级统计距离未必就是性能的充分解释变量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中四个研究问题，能快速把握作者对合成先验、网页语料和整理语料的比较逻辑。Method 部分重点看特征构造、判别器评估和 coverage 指标，尤其是为什么作者避免使用模型 embedding。实验部分建议关注三类结论：合成先验覆盖真实数据的程度、T4 与 TabFM 的重叠、合成先验参数搜索失败。对预训练研究更有用的是方法论，而不是具体表格模型结果：用可解释的分布诊断工具去审计预训练语料，而不是只用下游分数倒推数据质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the pretraining corpora used for tabular foundation models actually live in the same distributional space. It compares web-scraped tables, curated benchmark/Kaggle-style tables, and synthetic tables generated from a parametric prior, with a focus on whether the synthetic prior covers realistic tabular data and whether distributional proximity explains downstream behavior.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to text LLM pretraining is moderate, but the data-centric lesson is useful. The work is a concrete case study in auditing a pretraining prior before trusting it as a generator of tasks. It shows that a hand-designed synthetic task generator can be mechanistically plausible yet occupy only a narrow region of the real-data space. It also cautions against assuming that simple distributional proximity metrics will directly predict downstream performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare three archetypal corpora: T4 for web-scraped tables, TabFM for curated Kaggle-like tables, and TabICL for a synthetic prior with public parameters. Because tables have variable row counts, column counts, types, and order, they map each table into aggregate feature vectors rather than relying on model-specific learned embeddings. The main feature set has 70 dimensions, covering table-level, column-level, and inter-column statistics; a smaller scalar-only feature set has 9 dimensions. Categorical columns are identified using a uniqueness ratio threshold of 0.2. Two families of metrics are used. First, discriminators are trained to predict the source corpus of a table, measuring sample-level distinguishability. Second, nearest-neighbor coverage metrics estimate how much one corpus covers another in the constructed feature space. The paper also attempts to tune the synthetic prior parameters to better match real tables, including a large grid search.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is that the TabICL-style synthetic prior covers only a small part of the space occupied by real tables, while real tables broadly cover the synthetic region. Curated and web-scraped tables overlap substantially, although individual tables remain distinguishable by source. This helps explain why a smaller curated corpus can be competitive with a much larger web-derived corpus for pretraining. Attempts to reparameterize the synthetic prior do not close the gap: even after an extensive search of about 86k trials, synthetic and real tables remain close to separable. A preliminary downstream analysis finds no clear correlation between model performance and proximity to the synthetic prior under the proposed feature sets, suggesting that the chosen distributional statistics are diagnostic but not a complete account of transfer.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read the research questions in the introduction, then inspect the feature construction and the two evaluation tools: source discriminators and nearest-neighbor coverage. The most useful parts for pretraining researchers are the design choices around model-agnostic corpus diagnostics and the negative result from synthetic-prior optimization. The downstream-performance section should be read as preliminary evidence rather than a full causal explanation.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了表格数据预训练中合成数据与真实数据之间的分布鸿沟，对理解数据质量和合成数据在预训练中的局限性有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Reveals the distributional gap between synthetic and real data in tabular pre-training; valuable for understanding data quality and the limitations of synthetic data in pre-training.

authors: Telmo de Menezes e Silva Filho

paper.title: Model Spec Midtraining: Improving How Alignment Training Generalizes
paper.abstract: Some frontier AI developers aim to align language models to a Model Spec or Constitution that describes the intended model behavior. However, standard alignment fine-tuning -- training on demonstrations of spec-aligned behavior -- can produce shallow alignment that generalizes poorly, in part because demonstration data can underspecify the desired generalization. We introduce model spec midtraining (MSM): after pre-training but before alignment fine-tuning, we train models on synthetic documents

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 alignment fine-tuning 的泛化方向不可控问题。标准做法只用示范数据教模型“该怎么答”，但示范数据往往不能说明“为什么这样答”。当同一组行为可以由多种价值解释时，模型会选择哪一种解释并外推到新场景，训练者并不容易控制。论文提出的问题很具体：能否在 AFT 之前，用一段中间训练让模型先理解 Model Spec 的内容，从而改变后续对相同示范数据的泛化方式。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-training 接口有直接启发。MSM 不是常规 SFT，也不是偏好优化；它把 Model Spec 写成一批可学习的合成文档，在预训练之后、对齐微调之前注入模型。它的贡献不在于多加一批安全样本，而在于证明“规范文本的语义预热”可以改变后续示范学习的归纳偏置。这个结果对 mid-training、annealing/cooldown、continual pretrain 都有参考意义：如果 demonstration signal 欠约束，先训练模型理解规则背后的理由，可能比直接堆示范更有效。论文也把 Model Spec 从静态政策文档变成可实验的训练对象，可以比较不同 spec 写法对泛化的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含两个阶段。第一阶段是 Model Spec Midtraining。给定一个 Model Spec，用 Claude Opus 4.6 生成多样化合成文档，这些文档不只是列规则，而是讨论 spec 中的价值、边界、理由和行为含义。模型在这些文档上做中间训练，目标是让模型先掌握“应该成为什么样的助手”以及“为什么要这样做”。第二阶段是 Alignment Fine-Tuning，在 spec-aligned demonstrations 上训练模型执行相应行为。关键区别在于，AFT 仍然负责把原则落到行为模式上，但 MSM 负责设定解释框架和外推方向。论文的控制实验设计得比较干净：同一批 cheese preference AFT 数据可以同时被解释为 pro-America，也可以解释为 pro-affordability。只改变 MSM 中的 spec，不改变 AFT 数据，模型最后会朝不同价值方向泛化。这说明 MSM 改变的不是表层样本记忆，而是示范数据的解释方式。相对 Constitutional AI 或 deliberative alignment，MSM 更靠前，发生在对齐微调之前；相对单纯扩大 AFT 数据，它试图补充的是“示范数据没有写出来的原则”。
summary.experiments: 论文给出两类主要实验。第一类是受控价值泛化实验。模型只在 cheese preference 数据上做 AFT，例如偏好 cream cheese 而不是 brie。若 MSM spec 把这些偏好解释为亲美价值，模型会在相同 AFT 后泛化到更广泛的 pro-America 表达；若 MSM spec 把同一批偏好解释为 affordability，模型则泛化到 pro-affordability。论文报告该现象还覆盖另外 6 种 value setting，说明它不是单个玩具偏好的偶然结果。第二类是安全相关的 agentic misalignment 评测。对 self-preservation 和 goal-guarding 写入 Model Spec 后，MSM 明显降低不对齐行为比例：Qwen2.5-32B 从 68% 降到 5%，Qwen3-32B 从 54% 降到 7%。deliberative alignment baseline 分别为 48% 和 14%，MSM 在这两个模型上都更低。论文还比较了不同 AFT 数据规模：MSM 的收益在多个规模下存在，但 AFT 数据越多，边际收益越小。这符合直觉，因为更大规模示范本身也会提供更多外推线索。消融上，论文用 MSM 做 Model Spec science：解释规则背后价值的 spec、以及带有更细 subrules 的 spec，泛化效果更好；只写“要有好的价值和判断”这类很泛的规范，效果较差。这个结果说明 spec 的可操作性和解释密度比抽象口号更重要。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 §2、§3、§4、§5。§2 重点看 MSM 数据如何从 Model Spec 生成，以及它和 AFT 数据的职责分工；这里决定了方法是否可复现，也决定了是否会发生数据泄漏或目标混淆。§3 是核心机制实验，尤其是 Figure 1 的 cheese preference 设计：相同 AFT、不同 spec、不同泛化，是判断 MSM 是否真的改变归纳偏置的关键证据。§4 看 agentic misalignment 的设置、指标和 baseline，重点关注 Qwen2.5-32B 与 Qwen3-32B 的绝对降幅，以及不同 AFT scale 下收益变小的曲线。§5 值得细看，它把 spec 写法变成可优化对象：价值解释、细规则、泛化规范之间的差异，对真实 Model Spec 迭代很有用。深挖时应特别关注三点：合成文档是否覆盖了评测语义；MSM 是否会降低模型在 spec 外场景的灵活性；当 spec 内部冲突或过度具体时，模型会如何折中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a precise failure mode in alignment fine-tuning: demonstrations often specify the desired behavior but not the intended reason behind it. When the same demonstrations are compatible with several value-level explanations, the model may generalize along the wrong one. The question is whether a model can be trained, before alignment fine-tuning, to understand a Model Spec well enough that later demonstrations are interpreted through the intended principles.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at the pretrain–posttrain boundary. Model Spec Midtraining is not just another SFT dataset and not a preference-optimization method. It inserts a midtraining phase after pretraining and before alignment fine-tuning, using synthetic documents that explain the Model Spec. This changes the model’s inductive bias before it sees behavioral demonstrations. For pretraining researchers, the result is useful because it shows that document-style semantic training can shape downstream alignment generalization, especially when demonstration data is underdetermined. It also turns a Model Spec from a policy artifact into a trainable and experimentally testable object.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. First, Model Spec Midtraining trains the model on a diverse synthetic corpus generated from a Model Spec, using Claude Opus 4.6 for data creation. These documents discuss the assistant’s intended values, rules, motivations, and practical boundaries. The goal is to teach the model the content and rationale of the spec before behavioral fine-tuning. Second, Alignment Fine-Tuning trains the model on demonstrations of spec-aligned behavior. The important design choice is the separation of roles: MSM supplies the explanatory frame, while AFT supplies behavioral grounding. The controlled cheese-preference setup makes this clear. The same AFT data can be explained either by pro-America values or by pro-affordability values. Changing only the MSM spec changes how the model generalizes from the identical AFT data. Compared with standard SFT, MSM does not merely add more examples of desired behavior. Compared with deliberative alignment, it acts earlier, before the model is trained to produce aligned responses.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover both controlled generalization and safety-relevant behavior. In the controlled value experiments, models are fine-tuned only on cheese preferences such as preferring cream cheese over brie. With a pro-America spec during MSM, the model generalizes the same preference data toward broader pro-America values. With a pro-affordability spec, it generalizes toward affordability instead. The paper reports the same pattern across six additional values. In agentic misalignment evaluations, adding an MSM spec about self-preservation and goal-guarding sharply reduces misalignment rates: Qwen2.5-32B drops from 68% to 5%, and Qwen3-32B drops from 54% to 7%. A deliberative alignment baseline reaches 48% and 14%, respectively, so MSM is stronger in these settings. The gains persist across AFT data scales, but become smaller as AFT scale increases, which is consistent with larger demonstration sets being less underdetermined. The spec-ablation results are also informative: specs that explain the values behind rules, or include more detailed subrules, generalize better than a broad instruction to have good values and judgment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 2 for the data-generation pipeline and for the division of labor between MSM and AFT. This is where reproducibility and possible confounds should be checked. Section 3 is the key mechanism test: the cheese-preference setup, especially Figure 1, isolates whether MSM changes the interpretation of identical AFT data. Section 4 is the main safety result; focus on the exact agentic misalignment benchmark, the Qwen2.5-32B and Qwen3-32B numbers, and the dependence on AFT data scale. Section 5 is worth careful reading because it studies how different spec designs affect generalization. The most useful follow-up questions are whether the synthetic MSM documents overlap semantically with the evaluations, whether MSM makes behavior too rigid outside the covered spec, and how the method behaves when the spec is internally ambiguous or overly detailed.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该按“训练阶段设计”来读，不是普通对齐技巧；如果结果经得起复现，它会直接改变你对 SFT 前该不该插一段目标化 LM mid-train 的 prior，先看受控泛化实验和 misalignment 表。
recommendation.en: Read this as a training-stage paper, not just another alignment trick; if the results hold, it changes the prior on whether a targeted LM midtraining phase should sit before SFT—start with the controlled generalization setup and the misalignment table.

paper.title: Position: the Stochastic Parrot in the Coal Mine. Model Collapse is a Threat to Low-Resource Communities
paper.abstract: Model collapse, the degradation in performance that arises when generative models are trained on the outputs of prior models, is an increasing concern as artificially generated content proliferates. Related critiques of large language models have highlighted their tendency to reproduce frequent patterns in training data, their reliance on vast datasets, and their substantial environmental cost. Together, these factors contribute to data degradation, the reinforcement of cultural biases, and inef

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论生成内容进入训练语料后造成 model collapse，并指出这种分布退化会更严重地伤害低资源语言和边缘化群体。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是观点与风险分析，不是新的训练方法。它把 model collapse、数据尾部分布丢失、文化偏差和训练资源效率放在同一个问题框架里，提醒预训练数据治理不能只看主流语言和高频模式。
summary.technical_approach: 论文是 position paper，主要通过整合已有 model collapse 论文、随机鹦鹉批评、环境成本讨论和低资源社区风险来构造论证。它没有提出新的建模目标或数据过滤算法，而是强调合成数据污染对长尾分布的非均匀影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要未显示新的实证实验、模型规模或训练数据设置。主要证据来自已有研究和概念分析，结论适合作为数据治理议题的背景材料，而不是可直接复现的技术结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that model collapse from training on generated content disproportionately harms low-resource languages and marginalized communities.
summary_en.importance: This is a position and risk-analysis contribution rather than a new training method. It connects model collapse, tail-distribution loss, cultural bias, and inefficient resource use, making a data-governance point relevant to pretraining pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper synthesizes existing work on model collapse, stochastic-parrot critiques, environmental cost, and low-resource data scarcity. It does not introduce a new objective or filtering method; the central claim is that synthetic-data contamination has uneven effects across the data distribution.
summary_en.experiments: No new empirical setup, model scale, or training-data experiment is described in the abstract. The evidence appears to come from prior literature and conceptual argumentation, so the paper is best treated as background for data governance rather than a technical result to reproduce.

recommendation.zh: 作为 synthetic-data 风险备查即可；没有新实验，但低资源尾部退化这个 prior 值得放进数据审计清单。
recommendation.en: Use it as background on synthetic-data risk; no new experiments, but tail degradation for low-resource data belongs on a data-audit checklist.

paper.title: Rethinking Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Evaluating and Advancing Retrievers in Agentic Search Systems
paper.abstract: Reasoning-intensive retrieval aims to surface evidence that supports downstream reasoning rather than merely matching topical similarity. This capability is increasingly important for agentic search systems, where retrievers must provide complementary evidence across iterative search and synthesis. However, existing work remains limited on both evaluation and training: benchmarks such as BRIGHT provide narrow gold sets and evaluate retrievers in isolation, while synthetic training corpora often

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic search 中“检索要服务推理而非只做主题匹配”的问题，并补足这类检索器缺少合适 benchmark 与训练语料的缺口。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark + 合成训练数据 + 检索器微调，属于 agent/search 基础设施工作。对预训练研究员的价值在于：它把“证据组合”而非“单段相关性”明确成训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BRIGHT-Pro，扩展查询的多方面 gold evidence，并同时在静态检索和 agentic search 协议下评测；再构造 RTriever-Synth，把查询分解为 aspect，生成互补 positives 和 positive-conditioned hard negatives，并用它 LoRA 微调基于 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 的 RTriever-4B。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验覆盖多个检索器与两类搜索协议，并比较原始 embedding model、现有 retriever 与经合成数据微调后的 RTriever-4B。论文强调在 reasoning-intensive retrieval 上有稳定提升，但摘要未给出具体分数和增益幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Arman Cohan。若属 Yale NLP 相关团队，这条线在检索增强与长文档问答上有持续积累。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses retrieval for agentic search where the goal is to support downstream reasoning, not just topical matching, and fills the gap in both evaluation and training data for that setting.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly benchmark, synthetic data, and retriever fine-tuning. For pretraining researchers, the useful angle is the explicit shift from single-passage relevance to evidence portfolio construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces BRIGHT-Pro, which expands each query with multi-aspect gold evidence and evaluates retrievers under both static and agentic protocols. It also builds RTriever-Synth, an aspect-decomposed synthetic corpus with complementary positives and positive-conditioned hard negatives, then LoRA-tunes RTriever-4B based on Qwen3-Embedding-4B.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates comparisons across multiple retrievers and both static and agentic search settings, including the base embedding model and the fine-tuned RTriever-4B. It reports consistent gains on reasoning-intensive retrieval, though exact numbers are not exposed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Arman Cohan. If this is indeed from the Yale NLP line, the team has prior work in retrieval-augmented QA and long-context evidence use.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“检索单元”从相关段落改成证据组合，这个目标定义值得借去做 RAG-pretrain 或 synthetic curriculum；读 benchmark 设计和负例构造即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the move from passage relevance to evidence portfolios is a useful objective shift for RAG-style pretraining; read the benchmark design and negative construction.

paper.title: Self-Improvement for Fast, High-Quality Plan Generation
paper.abstract: Generative models trained on synthetic plan data are a promising approach to generalized planning. Recent work has focused on finding any valid plan, rather than a high-quality solution. We address the challenge of producing high-quality plans, a computationally hard problem, in sub-exponential time. First, we demonstrate that, given optimal data, a decoder-only transformer can generate high-quality plans for unseen problem instances. Second, we show how to self-improve an initial model trained

summary.core_problem: 研究如何让生成模型在规划任务中快速产生高质量计划，而不只是找到任意可行解。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用规划中的自改进训练流程，介于 Agent planning、合成数据训练和推理时搜索之间。它对 LLM 预训练不是直接贡献，但对“模型生成候选 + 搜索改进 + 再训练”的闭环有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 先验证 decoder-only transformer 在最优计划数据上能泛化到未见问题实例；再从次优数据训练初始模型，通过多次模型采样和图搜索生成更短、更优的计划，并把这些改进计划用于下一轮微调。推理时还可叠加搜索进一步提升计划质量。
summary.experiments: 在 Blocksworld、Logistics、Labyrinth、Sokoban 四个规划域上实验。摘要报告相对源符号规划器平均减少 30% 计划长度，在已知最优解的任务中超过 80% 计划达到最优；模型延迟随复杂度呈次指数增长。摘要未给出模型规模和训练数据量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how generative models can produce high-quality plans quickly, rather than merely finding any valid plan.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a self-improvement loop for generalized planning, sitting between agent planning, synthetic data generation, and inference-time search. It is not a direct pretraining paper, but the model-sample-search-retrain loop is relevant to training pipelines for reasoning agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first show that a decoder-only Transformer trained on optimal plans can generate high-quality plans for unseen instances. Starting from a model trained on suboptimal data, each self-improvement round uses multiple model calls plus graph search to produce improved plans, then fine-tunes the model on those plans. Additional inference-time search further improves quality.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers Blocksworld, Logistics, Labyrinth, and Sokoban. The abstract reports an average 30% reduction in plan length over the source symbolic planner and over 80% optimal plans where optima are known; model latency scales sub-exponentially with complexity. Model size and training-data scale are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座训练论文；可把自改进循环当 planning 数据合成模板，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper; keep the self-improvement loop as a planning-data synthesis template, but no need to read deeply.

paper.title: ScribbleEdit: Synthetic Data for Image Editing with Scribbles and Text
paper.abstract: Recent progress in generative models has significantly advanced image editing capabilities, yet precise and intuitive user control remains difficult. Specifically, users often struggle to communicate both exact spatial layouts and specific semantic details simultaneously. While natural language instructions effectively convey high-level semantics like texture and color, they lack spatial specificity. Conversely, freehand scribbles provide rough spatial boundaries but cannot express detailed visu

summary.core_problem: 为同时接受手绘 scribble 和文本指令的图像编辑模型构造专门训练数据，解决空间控制和语义控制难以兼得的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成数据集和合成数据管线。它补足了现有图像编辑数据中缺少“粗略空间约束 + 细粒度文本属性”组合监督的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ScribbleEdit，一个大规模合成数据集；其核心是用自动化合成流程生成图像编辑样本，并为每个样本配对自然语言编辑指令和自由手绘式 scribble 输入，使模型学习同时解析抽象空间边界和文本语义。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据集规模、使用的编辑基座模型、训练 token/图像数量或具体提升幅度；实验目标应包括联合 scribble-text 条件下的编辑精度、空间对齐和语义一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of California, Berkeley。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds training data for image editing models that jointly use freehand scribbles and text instructions, aiming to combine spatial and semantic control.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal generative dataset and synthetic data pipeline. It fills a data gap where existing editing datasets do not jointly supervise rough spatial constraints and fine-grained textual attributes.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScribbleEdit is a large-scale synthetic dataset. Its pipeline creates editing examples paired with natural-language instructions and freehand-like scribble inputs, so models can learn to interpret abstract spatial marks together with semantic edit requests.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify dataset size, base editing model, training scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation likely measures edit accuracy, spatial alignment, and semantic consistency under joint scribble-text conditioning.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with University of California, Berkeley.

recommendation.zh: 可作为多模态合成数据案例备查；预训练研究员看数据生成管线即可，不必跟编辑指标。
recommendation.en: Useful as a multimodal synthetic-data case study; for pretraining work, read the data pipeline and ignore most editing metrics.

paper.title: Embody4D: A Generalist 4D World Model for Embodied AI
paper.abstract: World models have made significant progress in modeling dynamic environments; however, most embodied world models are still restricted to 2D representations, lacking the comprehensive multi-view information essential for embodied spatial reasoning. Bridging this gap is non-trivial, primarily due to challenges from severe scarcity of paired multi-view data, the difficulty of maintaining spatiotemporal consistency in generated 3D geometries, and the tendency to hallucinate manipulation details. To

summary.core_problem: 解决具身AI世界模型只建模2D动态画面、缺少多视角4D空间一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成世界模型和数据合成管线；对预训练研究的间接价值在于如何用合成数据和几何约束补齐稀缺的多视角交互数据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Embody4D，一个面向具身场景的视频到视频世界模型，可从单目视频合成任意新视角。方法包括3D-aware compositional synthesis，用不同机械臂和背景组合构造异构数据；再用adaptive noise injection约束时空几何稳定，减少操作细节幻觉。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline和具体指标；声称能在跨具身形态的机器人场景中提升泛化，并保持生成3D几何的时空一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、中国科学技术大学、中国科学院自动化所、北京航空航天大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of multi-view 4D spatial consistency in embodied world models that mostly operate in 2D video space.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generative embodied world model and synthetic data pipeline. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is how synthetic composition and geometric constraints are used when paired multi-view interaction data is scarce.
summary_en.technical_approach: Embody4D is a video-to-video world model that synthesizes arbitrary novel views from a monocular video. It uses a 3D-aware compositional synthesis pipeline to combine robotic arms and backgrounds, and an adaptive noise injection strategy to improve spatiotemporal geometry stability and reduce manipulation hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims improved cross-embodiment generalization and more stable 3D geometry in generated embodied scenes.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Zhejiang University, University of Science and Technology of China, Institute of Automation CAS, and Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 只扫数据合成和noise injection即可；它不是LLM预训练，但多视角稀缺数据的处理方式可作多模态预训练备忘。
recommendation.en: Skim the data synthesis and noise-injection parts only; not LLM pretraining, but useful as a note on scarce multi-view data.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
Institute of automation, Chinese academy of science

paper.title: Model Spec Midtraining: Improving How Alignment Training Generalizes
paper.abstract: Some frontier AI developers aim to align language models to a Model Spec or Constitution that describes the intended model behavior. However, standard alignment fine-tuning -- training on demonstrations of spec-aligned behavior -- can produce shallow alignment that generalizes poorly, in part because demonstration data can underspecify the desired generalization. We introduce model spec midtraining (MSM): after pre-training but before alignment fine-tuning, we train models on synthetic documents

summary.core_problem: Model Spec Midtraining 解决的是 alignment fine-tuning 的泛化欠定问题。只用行为示范做对齐时，模型可能学到表面偏好，而没有学到这些行为背后的规则、价值和适用边界。同一批示范数据可以支持多种解释，模型最终泛化到哪一种解释，取决于训练前已有的表示和先验。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 pretrain/post-train 接口有直接启发。它把 Model Spec 从推理时提示或 SFT 数据说明，前移到预训练之后、对齐微调之前的 midtraining 阶段。贡献不在于又增加一批合成 SFT 数据，而在于用“解释性文档”改变模型对后续示范数据的归纳偏置。这个思路对持续预训练、annealing/cooldown 数据设计、constitution-style alignment、RL 前的行为先验塑形都有参考价值。量级上，它不是基座能力扩展论文，但在 alignment generalization 的训练流程上给出了清晰实验信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含两个阶段。第一阶段是 Model Spec Midtraining：给定一个 Model Spec，用 Claude Opus 4.6 生成一批讨论、解释、展开该 spec 的合成文档，让模型先学习“应该成为什么样的助手”以及规则背后的理由。第二阶段是常规 alignment fine-tuning，在行为示范数据上训练模型执行这些原则。它和普通 AFT 的区别是，AFT 只展示输入输出行为，容易让模型用错误的潜在价值解释训练样本；MSM 先写入 spec 的语义框架，再让相同示范数据落到指定解释上。它也不同于推理时 deliberative alignment：MSM 修改的是训练后的模型倾向，而不是只在测试时要求模型显式思考规则。论文还把 MSM 用作 Model Spec science 的工具，比较不同 spec 写法如何影响泛化：解释规则背后的价值、给出更细的子规则，效果好于只写“有良好价值和判断力”的泛化表述。
summary.experiments: 实验分三组。第一组是可控价值泛化实验。示范数据只包含奶酪偏好，例如偏好 cream cheese 而不是 brie；这类数据本身可以被解释为 pro-America，也可以被解释为 pro-affordability。对相同 AFT 数据，使用 pro-America spec 做 MSM 的模型会泛化到更广泛的亲美国价值；使用 pro-affordability spec 做 MSM 的模型会泛化到更广泛的可负担性价值。论文报告这种控制效果还出现在另外 6 个 value 设置中。第二组是安全相关的 agentic misalignment 评测。使用包含 self-preservation 和 goal-guarding 指导的 Model Spec 做 MSM 后，Qwen2.5-32B 的 misalignment rate 从 68% 降到 5%，Qwen3-32B 从 54% 降到 7%。它优于文中 deliberative alignment baseline，对应结果为 48% 和 14%。第三组考察 AFT 数据规模和 spec 内容。MSM 在不同 AFT 数据规模下都有效，但随着 AFT 数据增加，边际收益下降。spec ablation 显示，写清规则背后的价值或提供细粒度子规则，比只给宽泛道德要求更能改善泛化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，那里把“同一示范数据支持不同价值解释”的问题讲得很清楚，是理解 MSM 的关键。Method 需要关注 MSM 数据如何从 Model Spec 生成、synthetic document fine-tuning 与 AFT 如何衔接，以及训练阶段为什么放在 pretrain 之后、AFT 之前。实验部分重点看三类结果：奶酪偏好控制实验、agentic misalignment 数字、AFT 数据规模消融。还应细看 Model Spec ablation，因为它直接回答了 spec 应该写成原则解释、细则集合，还是宽泛价值声明。值得深挖的问题有三个：MSM 学到的是可迁移价值表示，还是合成文档带来的语义启动；MSM 与后续 RL 的相互作用；以及这种 midtraining 是否会引入新的 reward hacking 或 specification gaming 风险。

summary_en.core_problem: Model Spec Midtraining addresses under-specified generalization in alignment fine-tuning. When a model is trained only on demonstrations, the same behavior data can support multiple latent explanations. The model may learn surface preferences without learning the intended rules, values, and boundaries that should govern generalization.
summary_en.importance: The paper is directly relevant to the pretrain-to-post-train interface. It moves the Model Spec from inference-time prompting or demonstration annotation into a midtraining phase after pretraining and before alignment fine-tuning. The contribution is not simply adding more synthetic SFT data. The key idea is to use explanatory documents to shape the model’s inductive bias before it sees behavior demonstrations. This has implications for continual pretraining, annealing and cooldown data design, constitution-style alignment, and the initialization of behavior priors before RL. It is not a base-capability scaling paper, but it provides unusually clean evidence on alignment generalization through training-stage design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. First, Model Spec Midtraining trains the model on synthetic documents generated from a Model Spec, using Claude Opus 4.6 to produce documents that discuss, explain, and unpack the spec. This stage is intended to teach the model what kind of assistant it should be and why the rules matter. Second, standard alignment fine-tuning trains the model on demonstrations of spec-aligned behavior. The difference from ordinary AFT is that AFT only shows behavior and can leave the intended latent value ambiguous, while MSM installs a semantic frame that determines how the same demonstrations should generalize. It also differs from deliberative alignment at inference time: MSM changes the model’s trained tendencies rather than only asking the model to reason over rules during deployment. The paper further uses MSM as an empirical tool for Model Spec science, testing which spec properties affect generalization. Specs that explain the values behind rules or provide more detailed subrules outperform broad guidance such as having good values and judgment.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover three main settings. First, controlled value generalization: the AFT data contains only cheese preferences, such as preferring cream cheese over brie. These examples are compatible with a pro-America explanation and a pro-affordability explanation. With identical AFT data, a model midtrained on a pro-America spec generalizes toward broader pro-America values, while a model midtrained on a pro-affordability spec generalizes toward affordability-related values. The paper reports similar control across 6 additional values. Second, safety-relevant agentic misalignment: using a Model Spec covering self-preservation and goal-guarding, MSM reduces misalignment rates from 68% to 5% on Qwen2.5-32B and from 54% to 7% on Qwen3-32B. These results beat the deliberative alignment baseline reported in the paper, at 48% and 14% respectively. Third, data-scale and spec-content studies: MSM remains helpful across AFT data scales, but the gain shrinks as the amount of AFT data increases. Spec ablations show that explaining the underlying values or adding detailed subrules leads to better generalization than broad moral instruction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it closely. Start with the Introduction and Figure 1, which clearly isolate the core problem: the same demonstrations can imply different values. In the Method section, focus on how MSM data is generated from the Model Spec, how synthetic document fine-tuning connects to AFT, and why the phase is placed after pretraining but before alignment fine-tuning. In the experiments, prioritize the cheese-preference control setup, the agentic misalignment numbers, and the AFT data-scale ablations. The Model Spec ablations are also important because they address how a spec should be written: as value explanations, detailed subrules, or broad value statements. Three questions are worth further study: whether MSM learns transferable value representations or mainly produces semantic priming; how MSM interacts with later RL; and whether midtraining on specs creates new forms of specification gaming.

recommendation.zh: 这篇应看：它把 spec 从标签策略前移到 midtrain 语料，建议在内部 safety/spec ablation 复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing internally: it moves the spec from labeling policy into midtraining data, directly testing how specs steer generalization.

paper.title: Iterative Finetuning is Mostly Idempotent
paper.abstract: If a model has some behavioral tendency, such as sycophancy or misalignment, and it is trained on its own outputs, will the tendency be amplified in the next generation of models? We study this question by training a series of models where each model is finetuned on data generated by its predecessor, and the initial model is seeded with some persona or belief. We test three settings: supervised finetuning (SFT) on instruct models, synthetic document finetuning (SDF) on base models, and direct pr

summary.core_problem: 互联网上LLM生成内容占比持续提升，未来预训练数据将包含大量前代模型输出，需要明确在模型自身输出上迭代微调是否会放大已有行为倾向（如谄媚、错位）。
summary.importance: 明确了不同微调范式下迭代自训练的特质演化规律，为预训练数据过滤、对齐阶段的风险防控提供了实证依据，也为持续学习的安全边界提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构造7类不同特质（包括错位、厌世、谄媚等）的种子数据集，分别在有监督微调（SFT）、合成文档微调（SDF）、直接偏好优化（DPO）三种范式下开展多轮迭代自训练实验，每轮用当前模型生成的合成数据训练下一代模型，用LLM-as-judge评估特质强度与输出连贯性的变化。
summary.experiments: SFT与SDF场景下特质放大非常罕见，对超参数高度敏感，仅在极少量配置下出现，且放大伴随输出连贯性的显著下降；DPO场景下持续训练（不重新初始化模型）可稳定出现特质放大，若每轮重新初始化模型则特质保持或衰减；特质放大的阈值定义为连续4轮后特质得分较种子模型上升≥15分（满分100）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看实验设计与三类微调范式的结果对比部分，不需要深究单组实验的超参数细节，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The proportion of LLM-generated content on the internet keeps rising, so future pretraining corpora will include large volumes of outputs from predecessor models. It is necessary to clarify whether iterative fine-tuning on a model's own outputs will amplify existing behavioral tendencies such as sycophancy and misalignment.
summary_en.importance: It specifies the trait evolution rules of iterative self-training under different fine-tuning paradigms, provides empirical evidence for pretraining data filtering and risk control during alignment, and offers reference for the safety boundary of continual learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Seed datasets for 7 different traits (including misalignment, misanthropy, sycophancy, etc.) are constructed, and multi-round iterative self-training experiments are conducted under three paradigms: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Synthetic Document Fine-Tuning (SDF) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).
